16.75.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ śākalakaleśvaram ..
śākalyeśvaranairṛtye dhanuṣāṃ ṣaṣṭibhiḥ sthitam .. .. 1 ..
16.75.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि लिंगं शाकलकलेश्वरम् ..
शाकल्येश्वरनैरृत्ये धनुषां षष्टिभिः स्थितम् .. .. 1 ..
16.75.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the liṅga Śākalakaleśvara, / situated sixty bow-lengths to the southwest of Śākalyeśvara.

16.75.s:
taccaturyuganāmāḍhyaṃ smṛtaṃ pātakanāśanam ..
pūrvaṃ kāmeśvaraṃnāma tretāyāṃ pulaheśvaram .. 2 ..
16.75.d:
तच्चतुर्युगनामाढ्यं स्मृतं पातकनाशनम् ..
पूर्वं कामेश्वरंनाम त्रेतायां पुलहेश्वरम् .. 2 ..
16.75.m: It is remembered as enriched with names across the four ages, the destroyer of sins: / formerly, its name was Kāmeśvara; in the Tretā age, Pulaheśvara;

16.75.s:
dvāpare siddhināthaṃ tu nāradeśaṃ kalau smṛtam ..
tathā kalakaleśaṃ ca nāma tasyaiva kīrttitam .. 3 ..
16.75.d:
द्वापरे सिद्धिनाथं तु नारदेशं कलौ स्मृतम् ..
तथा कलकलेशं च नाम तस्यैव कीर्त्तितम् .. 3 ..
16.75.m: in the Dvāpara age, Siddhinātha; and in the Kali age, it is remembered as Nāradeśa; / likewise, Kalakaleśa is celebrated as its name.

16.75.s:
samudre ca mahāpuṇye yasminkāle sarasvatī ..
āgatā sā mahābhāgā hṛṣṭā tuṣṭā saridvarā ..
tasya toyasya śabdena sāgarasya mahātmanaḥ .. 4 ..
16.75.d:
समुद्रे च महापुण्ये यस्मिन्काले सरस्वती ..
आगता सा महाभागा हृष्टा तुष्टा सरिद्वरा ..
तस्य तोयस्य शब्देन सागरस्य महात्मनः .. 4 ..
16.75.m: And when the Sarasvatī, that highly fortunate and best of rivers, / arrived at the ocean of great religious merit, delighted and satisfied, / [it was then,] through the roaring sound of the water of that great-souled ocean,

16.75.s:
tato devāḥ sagandharvā ṛṣayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ ..
neduḥ kalakalaṃ tatra tumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam .. .. 5 ..
16.75.d:
ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वा ऋषयः सिद्धचारणाः ..
नेदुः कलकलं तत्र तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम् .. .. 5 ..
16.75.m: that the gods together with the gandharvas, the seers, siddhas, and cāraṇas, / raised a tumultuous clamor there that caused the hair to stand on end.

16.75.s:
tena śabdena mahatā mama mūrttiḥ samutthitā ..
kalkaleśvaranāmeti tato liṃgaṃ prakīrtitam .. 6 ..
16.75.d:
तेन शब्देन महता मम मूर्त्तिः समुत्थिता ..
कल्कलेश्वरनामेति ततो लिंगं प्रकीर्तितम् .. 6 ..
16.75.m: Through that great sound, my form arose; / therefore the liṅga was proclaimed by the name Kalakaleśvara.

16.75.s:
iti te pūrvavṛttāṃtaṃ kathitaṃ nāmakāra ṇam..
sāṃprataṃ tu yathā jātaṃ punaḥ kalakaleśvaram..
tatte'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ priye .. 7 ..
16.75.d:
इति ते पूर्ववृत्तांतं कथितं नामकार णम्..
सांप्रतं तु यथा जातं पुनः कलकलेश्वरम्..
तत्तेऽहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुष्वैकमनाः प्रिये .. 7 ..
16.75.m: Thus has the former account been told to you, the reason for its name. / But now, how it became Kalakaleśvara once again, / that I shall relate to you; listen with a single-minded focus, O beloved!

16.75.s:
purā dvāparasaṃdhau ca praviṣṭe tu kalau yuge ..
nāradastu samāgatya kṣetraṃ prābhāsikaṃ śubham..
saṃcakāra tapaścograṃ tatra liṃgasamīpataḥ .. 9 ..
tato varṣaśate pūrṇe samārādhya vṛṣadhvajam ..
gāṃdharvaṃ prāpya deveśi bhūṣitaṃ saptabhiḥ svaraiḥ .. 9 ..
16.75.d:
पुरा द्वापरसंधौ च प्रविष्टे तु कलौ युगे ..
नारदस्तु समागत्य क्षेत्रं प्राभासिकं शुभम्..
संचकार तपश्चोग्रं तत्र लिंगसमीपतः .. 9 ..
ततो वर्षशते पूर्णे समाराध्य वृषध्वजम् ..
गांधर्वं प्राप्य देवेशि भूषितं सप्तभिः स्वरैः .. 9 ..
16.75.m:
Formerly, at the junction of the Dvāpara age, when the Kali age had set in, / Nārada came to the auspicious sacred field of Prabhāsa / and performed severe austerity there near the liṅga.
Then, when a hundred years had elapsed, having worshipped the one whose banner bears the bull, / and having attained the musical lore of the gandharvas adorned with the seven notes, O ruler of gods,

16.75.s:
tato hṛṣṭamanā bhūtvā talliṃgasya samīpataḥ ..
sa cakāra mahāyajñaṃ pauṃḍarīkamiti śrutam .. 7.1.75.10 ..
16.75.d:
ततो हृष्टमना भूत्वा तल्लिंगस्य समीपतः ..
स चकार महायज्ञं पौंडरीकमिति श्रुतम् .. 7.1.75.10 ..
16.75.m: he, being delighted in mind, near that liṅga / performed the great sacrifice celebrated as the Pauṇḍarīka.

16.75.s:
devadevasya tuṣṭyarthaṃ sa sadā bhāvitātmavān ..
samāhūya ṛṣīṃstatra brahmalokātsahasraśaḥ .. 11 ..
16.75.d:
देवदेवस्य तुष्ट्यर्थं स सदा भावितात्मवान् ..
समाहूय ऋषींस्तत्र ब्रह्मलोकात्सहस्रशः .. 11 ..
16.75.m: For the satisfaction of the god of gods, he, ever self-controlled, / summoned thousands of seers from the world of Brahmā.

16.75.s:
tataḥ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāro yajñopakaraṇānvitaḥ ..
kṛtvā kuṇḍādikaṃ sarvaṃ samārebhe tataḥ kratum .. 12 ..
16.75.d:
ततः संभृतसंभारो यज्ञोपकरणान्वितः ..
कृत्वा कुण्डादिकं सर्वं समारेभे ततः क्रतुम् .. 12 ..
16.75.m: Then, having gathered the provisions and being equipped with the sacrificial implements, / having prepared the pits and all else, he began the sacrificial rite.

16.75.s: tataḥ saṃpūrṇatāṃ prāpte tasminkratau varānane .. 13 ..
16.75.d: ततः संपूर्णतां प्राप्ते तस्मिन्क्रतौ वरानने .. 13 ..
16.75.m: Then, when that sacrifice had reached completion, O fair-faced one,

16.75.s:
athāgamaṃstato viprāstatra kṣetranivāsinaḥ ..
dakṣiṇārthaṃ mahadevi śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ .. 14 ..
16.75.d:
अथागमंस्ततो विप्रास्तत्र क्षेत्रनिवासिनः ..
दक्षिणार्थं महदेवि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः .. 14 ..
16.75.m: the brahmins residing in the sacred field arrived there / for the sacrificial fee, O great goddess, by hundreds and thousands.

16.75.s:
tataḥ sa kautukāviṣṭasteṣāṃ yuddhārthameva hi ..
prākṣipattatra ratnāni suvarṇaṃ ca mahītale .. 15 ..
16.75.d:
ततः स कौतुकाविष्टस्तेषां युद्धार्थमेव हि ..
प्राक्षिपत्तत्र रत्नानि सुवर्णं च महीतले .. 15 ..
16.75.m: Then he, filled with curiosity, indeed for the purpose of their fighting, / cast jewels and gold down upon the ground.

16.75.s:
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve yudhyamānāḥ parasparam ..
kolāhalaṃ paraṃ cakrurbahudravyaparīpsayā .. 16 ..
16.75.d:
ततस्ते ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे युध्यमानाः परस्परम् ..
कोलाहलं परं चक्रुर्बहुद्रव्यपरीप्सया .. 16 ..
16.75.m: Then all those brahmins, fighting with one another / in their desire to seize much wealth, made a tremendous uproar.

16.75.s:
eke digaṃbarā devi tyaktayajñopavītinaḥ ..
vikacāḥ ke'pi dṛśyaṃte tvanye rudhiraviplavāḥ .. 17 ..
16.75.d:
एके दिगंबरा देवि त्यक्तयज्ञोपवीतिनः ..
विकचाः केऽपि दृश्यंते त्वन्ये रुधिरविप्लवाः .. 17 ..
16.75.m: Some were stripped naked, O goddess, having abandoned their sacrificial cords; / some were seen with disheveled hair, while others were bathed in blood.

16.75.s:
anye parasparaṃ jaghnurmuṣṭibhiścaraṇaistathā ..
evaṃ tatra tadā kṣiptaṃ yaddravyaṃ nāradena tu .. 18 ..
16.75.d:
अन्ये परस्परं जघ्नुर्मुष्टिभिश्चरणैस्तथा ..
एवं तत्र तदा क्षिप्तं यद्द्रव्यं नारदेन तु .. 18 ..
16.75.m: Others struck one another with their fists and feet; / so it was there when that wealth was scattered by Nārada.

16.75.s:
athābhāve tu vittasya ye ca viprā hyakiṃcanāḥ ..
vidyāvinayasaṃpannā brāhmaṇairjarjarīkṛtāḥ ..19..
16.75.d:
अथाभावे तु वित्तस्य ये च विप्रा ह्यकिंचनाः ..
विद्याविनयसंपन्ना ब्राह्मणैर्जर्जरीकृताः ..19..
16.75.m: Then, in the absence of wealth, those destitute brahmins / endowed with learning and modesty who were battered by the [other] brahmins,

16.75.s:
te tamūcurbhṛśaṃ śāṃtāḥ smayamānaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ..
kalahārthaṃ yato dānaṃ tvayā dattamidaṃ mune .. .. 7.1.75.20 ..
16.75.d:
ते तमूचुर्भृशं शांताः स्मयमानं मुहुर्मुहुः ..
कलहार्थं यतो दानं त्वया दत्तमिदं मुने .. .. 7.1.75.20 ..
16.75.m: exceedingly calm, said to him as he smiled again and again: / “Since this gift was given by you, O sage, for the sake of strife,

16.75.s:
vidyāyuktānparityajya vidhiṃ tyaktvā tu yājñikam ..
tasmādasya mune nāma khyātaṃ kalakaleśvaram .. 21 ..
16.75.d:
विद्यायुक्तान्परित्यज्य विधिं त्यक्त्वा तु याज्ञिकम् ..
तस्मादस्य मुने नाम ख्यातं कलकलेश्वरम् .. 21 ..
16.75.m: abandoning those endowed with learning and disregarding sacrificial injunction, / therefore, O sage, its name is renowned as Kalakaleśvara.

16.75.s:
tena nāmnā dvijaśreṣṭha liṃgametadbhaviṣyati ..
etasmātkāraṇāddevi jātaṃ kalakaleśvaram .. 22 ..
16.75.d:
तेन नाम्ना द्विजश्रेष्ठ लिंगमेतद्भविष्यति ..
एतस्मात्कारणाद्देवि जातं कलकलेश्वरम् .. 22 ..
16.75.m: By that name, O best of the twice-born, this liṅga shall be known.” / For this reason, O goddess, it became Kalakaleśvara.

16.75.s:
yastaṃ snāpya naro bhaktyā kurute triḥ pradakṣiṇam ..
sa gacchedrudralokaṃ tu tvatprasādādasaṃśayam .. 23 ..
16.75.d:
यस्तं स्नाप्य नरो भक्त्या कुरुते त्रिः प्रदक्षिणम् ..
स गच्छेद्रुद्रलोकं तु त्वत्प्रसादादसंशयम् .. 23 ..
16.75.m: The man who, after bathing it with devotion, circumambulates it thrice, / will go to the world of Rudra through your grace, without a doubt.

16.75.s:
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā gaṃdhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ ..
hemaṃ dattvā dvijātibhyaḥ sa gacchetparamaṃ padam .. 24 ..
16.75.d:
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या गंधपुष्पानुलेपनैः ..
हेमं दत्त्वा द्विजातिभ्यः स गच्छेत्परमं पदम् .. 24 ..
16.75.m: He who worships it with devotion, with perfumes, flowers, and unguents, / having given gold to the twice-born, shall go to the supreme abode.

16.75.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kalakaleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 75 .. ..
16.75.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कलकलेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः .. .. 75 .. ..
16.75.m: Thus ends the seventy-fifth chapter, named “The Description of the Māhātmya of Kalakaleśvara,” in the first [sub-section], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.76.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasyaiva devadevasya samīpasthaṃ virājate ..
liṃgadvayaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ lakulīśapratiṣṭhitam .. 1 ..
16.76.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्यैव देवदेवस्य समीपस्थं विराजते ..
लिंगद्वयं महापुण्यं लकुलीशप्रतिष्ठितम् .. 1 ..
16.76.m: Īśvara said: / Near that very god of gods there shines / a pair of highly sacred liṅgas established by Lakulīśa.

16.76.s:
lakule śvaranāmāsti tasya liṃgadvayasya vai ..
taddṛṣṭvā devadevasya liṃgadvayamanuttamam .. 2 ..
16.76.d:
लकुले श्वरनामास्ति तस्य लिंगद्वयस्य वै ..
तद्दृष्ट्वा देवदेवस्य लिंगद्वयमनुत्तमम् .. 2 ..
16.76.m: Indeed, the name of that pair of liṅgas is Lakulīśvara. / Seeing that unexcelled pair of liṅgas of the god of gods,

16.76.s:
mucyate sakalātpāpādājanmamaraṇāṃtikāt ..
tatra śuklacaturddaśyāṃ māsi bhādrapade priye .. 3 ..
16.76.d:
मुच्यते सकलात्पापादाजन्ममरणांतिकात् ..
तत्र शुक्लचतुर्द्दश्यां मासि भाद्रपदे प्रिये .. 3 ..
16.76.m: one is freed from all sin from birth to the end of life. / There, on the bright fourteenth day of the month of Bhādrapada, O beloved,

16.76.s:
upavāsaparo bhūtvā yaḥ karoti prajāgaram ..
mūrttimaṃtaṃ tu saṃpūjya lakulīśaṃ mahāprabham .. 4 ..
16.76.d:
उपवासपरो भूत्वा यः करोति प्रजागरम् ..
मूर्त्तिमंतं तु संपूज्य लकुलीशं महाप्रभम् .. 4 ..
16.76.m: whoever devotes himself to fasting and keeps a vigil, / having worshipped the illustrious Lakulīśa in embodied form,

16.76.s:
tataḥ saṃpūjya vidhinā tatra liṃgadvayaṃ pṛthak ..
samyakpūjāvidhānena stutimaṃtrairanukramāt ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ .. 5 ..
16.76.d:
ततः संपूज्य विधिना तत्र लिंगद्वयं पृथक् ..
सम्यक्पूजाविधानेन स्तुतिमंत्रैरनुक्रमात् ..
स याति परमं स्थानं यत्र देवो महेश्वरः .. 5 ..
16.76.m: and then having duly worshipped the pair of liṅgas separately there / according to the proper ritual rules, with hymns of praise and mantras in order, / goes to the supreme abode where God Maheśvara resides.

16.76.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye someśvaramāhātmye kalakaleśvarasamīpavarti lakulīśaliṃgadvayamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ..76..
16.76.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सोमेश्वरमाहात्म्ये कलकलेश्वरसमीपवर्ति लकुलीशलिंगद्वयमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्सप्ततितमोऽध्यायः..76..
16.76.m: Thus ends the seventy-sixth chapter, named “The Description of the Māhātmya of the Pair of Lakulīśa Liṅgas Situated Near Kalakaleśvara,” in the Someśvaramāhātmya, in the first [sub-section], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.77.s:
īśvara uvāca..
tato gacchenmahādevi uttaṃkeśvaramuttamam..
tasyaiva dakṣiṇe bhāge nātidūre vyavasthitam ..
sthāpitaṃ ca svayaṃ bhaktyā uttaṃkena mahātmanā .. 1 ..
16.77.d:
ईश्वर उवाच..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि उत्तंकेश्वरमुत्तमम्..
तस्यैव दक्षिणे भागे नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम् ..
स्थापितं च स्वयं भक्त्या उत्तंकेन महात्मना .. 1 ..
16.77.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the excellent Uttaṅkeśvara, / situated on the southern side of that very [shrine], not very far away, / and established personally with devotion by the high-souled Uttaṅka.

16.77.s:
taddṛṣṭvā tu mahādevi spṛṣṭvā ca susamāhitaḥ ..
saṃpūjya vidhivadbhaktyā mucyate sarvakilbiṣāt .. 2 ..
16.77.d:
तद्दृष्ट्वा तु महादेवि स्पृष्ट्वा च सुसमाहितः ..
संपूज्य विधिवद्भक्त्या मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषात् .. 2 ..
16.77.m: Having seen it, O great goddess, and touched it with concentrated mind, / worshipping it with devotion according to rule, one is freed from all guilt.

16.77.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya uttaṃkeśvaramāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 77 .. .. ..
16.77.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य उत्तंकेश्वरमाहात्म्य वर्णनंनाम सप्तसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः .. 77 .. .. ..
16.77.m: Thus ends the seventy-seventh chapter, named “The Description of the Māhātmya of Uttaṅkeśvara,” in the first [sub-section], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.78.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi devaṃ vaiśvānareśvaram ..
tasyaivāgneyakoṇasthaṃ dhanuṣāṃ paṃcake sthitam .. 1 ..
16.78.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि देवं वैश्वानरेश्वरम् ..
तस्यैवाग्नेयकोणस्थं धनुषां पंचके स्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.78.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the god Vaiśvānareśvara, / situated in the south-eastern corner of that very [shrine], at a distance of five bow-lengths.

16.78.s:
pāpaghnaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ darśanātsparśanādapi ..
tatra kaścicchukaḥ pūrvaṃ nīḍaṃ devi cakāra ha .. 2 ..
16.78.d:
पापघ्नं सर्वजंतूनां दर्शनात्स्पर्शनादपि ..
तत्र कश्चिच्छुकः पूर्वं नीडं देवि चकार ह .. 2 ..
16.78.m: It destroys the sins of all living beings through darśana and even through touch. / Formerly, a certain parrot made a nest there, O goddess.

16.78.s:
prāsāde bhāryayā sārddhaṃ nivasa nsuciraṃ sthitaḥ ..
tatastau daṃpatī nityaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ pracakratuḥ .. 3 ..
16.78.d:
प्रासादे भार्यया सार्द्धं निवस न्सुचिरं स्थितः ..
ततस्तौ दंपती नित्यं प्रदक्षिणं प्रचक्रतुः .. 3 ..
16.78.m: Residing in the temple with his wife, he stayed for a very long time; / then the pair continually made circumambulation [of the temple]

16.78.s:
kulāyasya vaśāddevi na tu bhaktyā kathaṃcana ..
kālena mahatā tau ca paṃcatvaṃ samupasthitau .. 4 ..
16.78.d:
कुलायस्य वशाद्देवि न तु भक्त्या कथंचन ..
कालेन महता तौ च पंचत्वं समुपस्थितौ .. 4 ..
16.78.m: due to the constraint of their nest, O goddess, and not by devotion at all. / In the course of long time, the two met their death.

16.78.s:
jātau tena prabhāvena uktau jātismarau bhuvi ..
lopāmudrāgastyanāmaprasiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatau .. 5 ..
16.78.d:
जातौ तेन प्रभावेन उक्तौ जातिस्मरौ भुवि ..
लोपामुद्रागस्त्यनामप्रसिद्धिं परमां गतौ .. 5 ..
16.78.m: By virtue of that, they were born on earth, remembering their former births, as it is told, / and achieved the supreme fame under the names Lopāmudrā and Agastya.

16.78.s:
atha gāthā purī gītā agastyena mahātmanā ..
smaratā pūrvadehaṃ tu vismayenānubhūtijā .. 6 ..
16.78.d:
अथ गाथा पुरी गीता अगस्त्येन महात्मना ..
स्मरता पूर्वदेहं तु विस्मयेनानुभूतिजा .. 6 ..
16.78.m: Then a song was formerly sung by the great-souled Agastya, / born of his experience in wonder as he recalled his previous body:

16.78.s:
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ samyagvahnīśaṃ yaḥ prapaśyati ..
nūnaṃ prasiddhimāpnoti itaścāhaṃ yathā purā .. 7 ..
16.78.d:
कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं सम्यग्वह्नीशं यः प्रपश्यति ..
नूनं प्रसिद्धिमाप्नोति इतश्चाहं यथा पुरा .. 7 ..
16.78.m: “Whoever gazes upon the Lord of Fire after duly performing circumambulation / surely attains renown, just as I did from this [place] formerly.”

16.78.s:
evaṃ devi tavākhyātaṃ māhātmyaṃ vahnidaivatam ..
śrutaṃ pāpaharaṃ nṛṇāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam .. 8 ..
16.78.d:
एवं देवि तवाख्यातं माहात्म्यं वह्निदैवतम् ..
श्रुतं पापहरं नृणां सर्वकामफलप्रदम् .. 8 ..
16.78.m: Thus, O goddess, the māhātmya dedicated to the god of fire has been told to you; / when heard, it removes the sins of mortals and grants the fruit of all desires.

16.78.s:
ghṛtena taṃ tu saṃsnāpya vidhinā vai samarcayet ..
hema dadyācca vipreṃdra samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ .. 9 ..
16.78.d:
घृतेन तं तु संस्नाप्य विधिना वै समर्चयेत् ..
हेम दद्याच्च विप्रेंद्र सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः .. 9 ..
16.78.m: Bathing him with clarified butter, one should worship him according to rule; / and endowed with perfect faith, one should give gold to an eminent brahmin, O prince of sages.

16.78.s:
evaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena samyagyātrāphalaṃ labhet ..
vahnilokaṃ tu saṃprāpya modate kālamakṣayam .. 7.1.78.10 ..
16.78.d:
एवं कृत्वा विधानेन सम्यग्यात्राफलं लभेत् ..
वह्निलोकं तु संप्राप्य मोदते कालमक्षयम् .. 7.1.78.10 ..
16.78.m: Having acted thus according to rite, he obtains the full fruit of the pilgrimage; / and reaching the realm of Agni, he rejoices for imperishable time.

16.78.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāharuyā saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vaiśvānareśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭasaptati tamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 78 ..
16.78.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहरुया संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये वैश्वानरेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टसप्तति तमोऽध्यायः .. 78 ..
16.78.m: Thus ends the seventy-eighth chapter, named ‘Description of the Māhātmya of Vaiśvānareśvara’, in the first Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya of the seventh Prabhāsa section, in the Skanda-Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.79.s:
.. īśvara uvāca.. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi lakulīśaṃ mahāprabham ..
tasya paścimadigbhāge dhanuṣāṃ saptake sthitam .. 1 ..
16.79.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच.. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि लकुलीशं महाप्रभम् ..
तस्य पश्चिमदिग्भागे धनुषां सप्तके स्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.79.m:
The Lord said:
Then, O great goddess, one should go to Lakulīśa of great splendour, / situated seven bows to the west of him,

16.79.s:
pāpaghnaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ śāṃtaṃ mūrtisthitaṃ prabhum ..
samāyātaṃ mahākṣetre tatra kāyāvarohaṇāt .. 2 ..
16.79.d:
पापघ्नं सर्वजंतूनां शांतं मूर्तिस्थितं प्रभुम् ..
समायातं महाक्षेत्रे तत्र कायावरोहणात् .. 2 ..
16.79.m: who destroys the sin of all creatures, peaceful, the Lord stationed in his image, / who arrived in this great sacred field from Kāyāvarohaṇa.

16.79.s:
kṛtvā tatra tapaścograṃ dīkṣayitvātmaśiṣya kān ..
kuśakādīṃśca catura uktvā śāstrāṇyanekaśaḥ .. 3 ..
16.79.d:
कृत्वा तत्र तपश्चोग्रं दीक्षयित्वात्मशिष्य कान् ..
कुशकादींश्च चतुर उक्त्वा शास्त्राण्यनेकशः .. 3 ..
16.79.m: Having performed severe austerity there and initiated his disciples— / Kuśaka and the rest, four [in all]—and taught numerous scriptures,

16.79.s:
nyāyavaiśeṣikādīni tataḥ siddhiṃ parāṃ gataḥ..
evaṃ jñātvā tu yaḥ samyaktaṃ samarcayate naraḥ .. 4 ..
16.79.d:
न्यायवैशेषिकादीनि ततः सिद्धिं परां गतः..
एवं ज्ञात्वा तु यः सम्यक्तं समर्चयते नरः .. 4 ..
16.79.m: beginning with Nyāya and Vaiśeṣika, he then attained supreme perfection. / Knowing this properly, the man who worships him,

16.79.s:
kārttikyāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa ayane cottarepi vā ..
vidyādānaṃ ca tatraiva dadyādviprāya śāline .. 5 ..
16.79.d:
कार्त्तिक्यां तु विशेषेण अयने चोत्तरेपि वा ..
विद्यादानं च तत्रैव दद्याद्विप्राय शालिने .. 5 ..
16.79.m: especially on the full moon day of Kārttika or during the northern course of the sun, / and who also gives the gift of knowledge there to a virtuous brahmin,

16.79.s:
saptajanmāni viprasya dhanāḍhyasya kule śubhe ..
jāyate matimāndhīmāñchrīmānevaṃ punaḥpunaḥ .. 6 ..
16.79.d:
सप्तजन्मानि विप्रस्य धनाढ्यस्य कुले शुभे ..
जायते मतिमान्धीमाञ्छ्रीमानेवं पुनःपुनः .. 6 ..
16.79.m: is born for seven births in the auspicious lineage of a wealthy brahmin, / intelligent, wise, and prosperous, again and again.

16.79.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsa kṣetramāhātmye lakulīśvaramāhātmya varṇanaṃnāmaikonāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 79 .. ..
16.79.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभास क्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये लकुलीश्वरमाहात्म्य वर्णनंनामैकोनाशीतितमोऽध्यायः .. 79 .. ..
16.79.m: Thus ends the seventy-ninth chapter, named ‘Description of the Māhātmya of Lakulīśvara’, in the first Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya of the seventh Prabhāsa section, in the Skanda-Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.80.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge liṃgaṃ pātakanāśanam ..
gautameśvaranāmāḍhyaṃ daityasūdanapaścime .. 1 ..
16.80.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्यैव पूर्वदिग्भागे लिंगं पातकनाशनम् ..
गौतमेश्वरनामाढ्यं दैत्यसूदनपश्चिमे .. 1 ..
16.80.m:
The Lord said:
To the east of that very [shrine] is a liṅga that destroys sin, / bearing the name Gautameśvara, to the west of Daityasūdana,

16.80.s:
dhanuṣāṃ paṃcake devi saṃsthitaṃ sarvakāmadam ..
śalyenārādhitaṃ yadvai madrarājena bhāmini .. 2 ..
16.80.d:
धनुषां पंचके देवि संस्थितं सर्वकामदम् ..
शल्येनाराधितं यद्वै मद्रराजेन भामिनि .. 2 ..
16.80.m: situated five bows away, O goddess, granting all desires, / which was worshipped, O spirited lady, by Śalya, the king of Madra.

16.80.s:
tataḥ kṛtaṃ tapaścograṃ samārādhya maheśvaram ..
anyo'pyevaṃ naro yastu taṃ samārādhayiṣyati .. 3 ..
16.80.d:
ततः कृतं तपश्चोग्रं समाराध्य महेश्वरम् ..
अन्योऽप्येवं नरो यस्तु तं समाराधयिष्यति .. 3 ..
16.80.m: Then, having worshipped Maheśvara, he performed severe austerity. / Any other person who worships him in like manner

16.80.s:
sa prāpsyati parāṃ siddhiṃ yathā śalyo mahāmanāḥ ..
caitra śuklacaturddaśyāṃ snāpayetpayasā tu yaḥ .. 4 ..
16.80.d:
स प्राप्स्यति परां सिद्धिं यथा शल्यो महामनाः ..
चैत्र शुक्लचतुर्द्दश्यां स्नापयेत्पयसा तु यः .. 4 ..
16.80.m: will attain supreme perfection, just like the high-minded Śalya. / He who bathes [the liṅga] with milk on the fourteenth day of the bright half of Caitra,

16.80.s:
gaṃdhodakena ca tataḥ pūjayetkusumottamaiḥ ..
tathaiva vidhivadbhaktyā so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 5 ..
16.80.d:
गंधोदकेन च ततः पूजयेत्कुसुमोत्तमैः ..
तथैव विधिवद्भक्त्या सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .. 5 ..
16.80.m: and then with fragrant water, and worships it with supreme flowers / according to rule with devotion in this way, obtains the fruit of an aśvamedha sacrifice.

16.80.s:
vācā kṛtaṃ ca yatpāpaṃ manasā karmaṇā'tha vā ..
tatsarvaṃ naśyate devi tasya liṃgasya darśanāt .. 6 ..
16.80.d:
वाचा कृतं च यत्पापं मनसा कर्मणाऽथ वा ..
तत्सर्वं नश्यते देवि तस्य लिंगस्य दर्शनात् .. 6 ..
16.80.m: Whatever sin has been committed by speech, by mind, or by action, / all of that is destroyed, O goddess, upon seeing that liṅga.

16.80.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekā śītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gautameśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 80 .. ..
16.80.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एका शीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये गौतमेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाशीतितमोऽध्यायः .. 80 .. ..
16.80.m: Thus ends the eightieth chapter, named ‘Description of the Māhātmya of Gautameśvara’, in the first Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya of the seventh Prabhāsa section, in the Skanda-Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.81.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi deveśaṃ daityasūdanam ..
pāpaghnaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ prabhāsakṣetravāsinām .. 1 ..
16.81.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि देवेशं दैत्यसूदनम् ..
पापघ्नं सर्वजंतूनां प्रभासक्षेत्रवासिनाम् .. 1 ..
16.81.m:
The Lord said:
Then, O great goddess, one should go to the Lord of the gods, Daityasūdana, / the destroyer of sins of all living beings residing in the Prabhāsa sacred field,

16.81.s:
anādiyugasaṃsthānaṃ sarva kāmapradaṃ śubham..
saṃsārasāgare ghore sthitaṃ nauriva tāraṇe .. 2 ..
16.81.d:
अनादियुगसंस्थानं सर्व कामप्रदं शुभम्..
संसारसागरे घोरे स्थितं नौरिव तारणे .. 2 ..
16.81.m: an abode without beginning through the ages, granting all desires, auspicious, / stationed like a boat for crossing over in the terrifying ocean of saṃsāra.

16.81.s:
anye sarve'pi naśyaṃti kalpāṃte brahmaṇo dine ..
etāni muktvā deveśi nyagrodhaṃ sapta kalpagama ..3..
16.81.d:
अन्ये सर्वेऽपि नश्यंति कल्पांते ब्रह्मणो दिने ..
एतानि मुक्त्वा देवेशि न्यग्रोधं सप्त कल्पगम ..3..
16.81.m: All other things perish at the end of a kalpa, on the day of Brahmā, / except these, O queen of gods: the banyan tree lasting seven kalpas,

16.81.s:
kalpavṛkṣaṃ tathā'gāraṃ vaiḍūryaṃ parvatottamam..
śrīdaityasūdanaṃ devaṃ mārkaṃḍeyaṃ mahāmunim..4..
16.81.d:
कल्पवृक्षं तथाऽगारं वैडूर्यं पर्वतोत्तमम्..
श्रीदैत्यसूदनं देवं मार्कंडेयं महामुनिम्..4..
16.81.m: likewise the wish-fulfilling tree, the house, the best mountain of beryl, / the divine Lord Daityasūdana, and the great sage Mārkaṇḍeya.

16.81.s:
akṣayāścāvyayāścaite saptakalpāni sundari ..
devi kiṃ bahunoktena varṇitena punaḥpunaḥ .. 5 ..
16.81.d:
अक्षयाश्चाव्ययाश्चैते सप्तकल्पानि सुन्दरि ..
देवि किं बहुनोक्तेन वर्णितेन पुनःपुनः .. 5 ..
16.81.m: These are imperishable and immutable for seven kalpas, O beautiful lady. / O goddess, what is the use of speaking much, of describing [this] again and again?

16.81.s:
śrīdaityasūdanāddevi nānyāsti bhuvi devatā ..
yavākāraṃ tu tasyaiva kṣetrapātakanāśanam.. 6 ..
16.81.d:
श्रीदैत्यसूदनाद्देवि नान्यास्ति भुवि देवता ..
यवाकारं तु तस्यैव क्षेत्रपातकनाशनम्.. 6 ..
16.81.m: Except for the holy Daityasūdana, O goddess, there is no other deity on earth. / His sacred field is shaped like a barleycorn and destroys sin,

16.81.s:
sevitaṃ carṣibhiḥ siddhairyakṣavidyādharoragaiḥ ..
tasya sīmāṃ pravakṣyāmi viṣṇukṣetrasya bhāmini .. 7 ..
16.81.d:
सेवितं चर्षिभिः सिद्धैर्यक्षविद्याधरोरगैः ..
तस्य सीमां प्रवक्ष्यामि विष्णुक्षेत्रस्य भामिनि .. 7 ..
16.81.m: frequented by seers, perfected beings, yakṣas, vidyādharas, and serpents. / I shall tell you the boundary of this Viṣṇu-kṣetra, O spirited lady:

16.81.s:
pūrve yameśvaraṃ yāvacchrīsomeśaṃ tu paścime ..
uttare tu viśālākṣī dakṣiṇe saritāṃ patiḥ .. 8 ..
16.81.d:
पूर्वे यमेश्वरं यावच्छ्रीसोमेशं तु पश्चिमे ..
उत्तरे तु विशालाक्षी दक्षिणे सरितां पतिः .. 8 ..
16.81.m: extending to Yameśvara in the east, to the holy Someśa in the west, / to Viśālākṣī in the north, and to the lord of rivers (the ocean) in the south.

16.81.s: etatkṣetraṃ yavākāraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ pāpanāśanam ..9..
16.81.d: एतत्क्षेत्रं यवाकारं वैष्णवं पापनाशनम् ..9..
16.81.m: This sacred field of Viṣṇu, shaped like a barleycorn, destroys sin.

16.81.s:
atra kṣetre mṛtā ye tu pāpino'pi narā dhruvam ..
svargaṃ gacchaṃti te sarve saṃtaḥ sukṛtino yathā ..7.1.81.10..
16.81.d:
अत्र क्षेत्रे मृता ये तु पापिनोऽपि नरा ध्रुवम् ..
स्वर्गं गच्छंति ते सर्वे संतः सुकृतिनो यथा ..7.1.81.10..
16.81.m: Those men who die in this sacred field, even if they are sinners, / certainly all go to heaven, just as good and virtuous men do.

16.81.s:
atra dattaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtaṃ hi yat ..
tatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ proktaṃ saptakalpāvadhi priye .. 11 ..
16.81.d:
अत्र दत्तं हुतं जप्तं तपस्तप्तं कृतं हि यत् ..
तत्सर्वं चाक्षयं प्रोक्तं सप्तकल्पावधि प्रिये .. 11 ..
16.81.m: Whatever is given here, offered into fire, muttered, or the austerity practiced, / all of that is declared to be imperishable for seven kalpas, O beloved.

16.81.s:
tatraikamapi yo devi brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayiṣyati ..
vidhinā viṣṇumuddiśya koṭirbhavati bhojitā .. 12 ..
16.81.d:
तत्रैकमपि यो देवि ब्राह्मणं भोजयिष्यति ..
विधिना विष्णुमुद्दिश्य कोटिर्भवति भोजिता .. 12 ..
16.81.m: Whoever feeds even a single brahmin there, O goddess, / according to rule for the sake of Viṣṇu, ten million [brahmins] are fed.

16.81.s:
tatropavāsaṃ yaḥ kuryānnaro bhaktisamanvitaḥ ..
ekenaivopavāsena upavāsāyutaṃ phalam ..
cakratīrthe naraḥ snātvā sopavāso jiteṃdriyaḥ .. 13 ..
16.81.d:
तत्रोपवासं यः कुर्यान्नरो भक्तिसमन्वितः ..
एकेनैवोपवासेन उपवासायुतं फलम् ..
चक्रतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा सोपवासो जितेंद्रियः .. 13 ..
16.81.m: A man who undertakes a fast there, endowed with devotion, / obtains the fruit of ten thousand fasts by a single fast alone. / Having bathed at Cakra-tīrtha, fasting, with senses subdued,

16.81.s:
dvādaśyāṃ kārttike māsi dadyādvipreṣu kāṃcanam ..
viṣṇuṃ saṃpūjya vidhivanmucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 14 ..
16.81.d:
द्वादश्यां कार्त्तिके मासि दद्याद्विप्रेषु कांचनम् ..
विष्णुं संपूज्य विधिवन्मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 14 ..
16.81.m: on the twelfth day in the month of Kārttika, a man should give gold to brahmins; / having worshipped Viṣṇu according to rule, he is freed from all sins.

16.81.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
daityasūdananāmeti kathaṃ tasya prakīrtitam ..
kasminkāle tu deveśa tanme vistarato vada .. 15 ..
16.81.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
दैत्यसूदननामेति कथं तस्य प्रकीर्तितम् ..
कस्मिन्काले तु देवेश तन्मे विस्तरतो वद .. 15 ..
16.81.m:
The goddess said:
Why was he proclaimed with the name ‘Daityasūdana’? / And at what time, O Lord of the gods? Tell me that in detail.

16.81.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
daityasūdanadevasya purā vṛttaṃ mahodayam .. 16 ..
16.81.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि माहात्म्यं पापनाशनम् ..
दैत्यसूदनदेवस्य पुरा वृत्तं महोदयम् .. 16 ..
16.81.m:
The Lord said:
Listen, O goddess; I will tell you the sin-destroying māhātmya, / the ancient and glorious event concerning the god Daityasūdana.

16.81.s:
devi tasyaiva nāmāni kalpekalpe bhavaṃti vai..
anādinidhanānyeva saṃbhavanti punaḥpunaḥ..17..
16.81.d:
देवि तस्यैव नामानि कल्पेकल्पे भवंति वै..
अनादिनिधनान्येव संभवन्ति पुनःपुनः..17..
16.81.m: O goddess, his names exist kalpa after kalpa; / they are truly without beginning and without end, arising again and again.

16.81.s:
pūrvakalpe śriyā vṛtto vāmanastu dvitīyake..
vajrāṃgastu tṛtīye vai turīye kamalāpriyaḥ..18..
16.81.d:
पूर्वकल्पे श्रिया वृत्तो वामनस्तु द्वितीयके..
वज्रांगस्तु तृतीये वै तुरीये कमलाप्रियः..18..
16.81.m: In the first kalpa he was surrounded by Śrī; in the second, Vāmana; / Vajrāṅga in the third; in the fourth, the beloved of Kamalā;

16.81.s:
paṃcame duḥkhaharttā ca ṣaṣṭhe tu puruṣottamaḥ..
śrīdaityasūdano devaḥ kalpe vai saptame smṛtaḥ..19..
16.81.d:
पंचमे दुःखहर्त्ता च षष्ठे तु पुरुषोत्तमः..
श्रीदैत्यसूदनो देवः कल्पे वै सप्तमे स्मृतः..19..
16.81.m: in the fifth, the remover of sorrow; in the sixth, Puruṣottama; / and in the seventh kalpa the god is remembered as the holy Daityasūdana.

16.81.s: tasyaiva nāma cotpattiṃ kathayāmi yathārthataḥ .. 7.1.81.20 ..
16.81.d: तस्यैव नाम चोत्पत्तिं कथयामि यथार्थतः .. 7.1.81.20 ..
16.81.m: I shall tell you the origin of his name precisely as it is.

16.81.s:
purā devāsure yuddhe dānavairdevakaṃṭakaiḥ ..
nirjitā devatāḥ sarve jagmuste śaraṇaṃ harim ..
kṣīrodavāsinaṃ devamastuvanpraṇatāḥ sthitāḥ .. 21 ..
16.81.d:
पुरा देवासुरे युद्धे दानवैर्देवकंटकैः ..
निर्जिता देवताः सर्वे जग्मुस्ते शरणं हरिम् ..
क्षीरोदवासिनं देवमस्तुवन्प्रणताः स्थिताः .. 21 ..
16.81.m: Formerly, in the battle between the gods and the asuras, when all the deities were vanquished / by the dānavas, the thorns of the gods, they went to Hari for refuge. / Standing prostrate before the god dwelling in the ocean of milk, they praised him.

16.81.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ.. ..
jaya deva jagannātha daityāsuravimarddana ..
vārāharūpamāsthāya uddhṛtā vasudhā tvayā .. 22 ..
16.81.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः.. ..
जय देव जगन्नाथ दैत्यासुरविमर्द्दन ..
वाराहरूपमास्थाय उद्धृता वसुधा त्वया .. 22 ..
16.81.m:
The gods said:
Victory, O God, Lord of the universe, crusher of daityas and asuras! / Having assumed the boar form, the earth was lifted up by you.

16.81.s:
uddhṛtā matsyarūpeṇa vedā udadhimadhyataḥ ..
kūrmarūpī tathā bhūtvā kṣīrodārṇavamaṃthanam .. 23 ..
16.81.d:
उद्धृता मत्स्यरूपेण वेदा उदधिमध्यतः ..
कूर्मरूपी तथा भूत्वा क्षीरोदार्णवमंथनम् .. 23 ..
16.81.m: The Vedas were rescued from the midst of the ocean in the form of a fish. / Likewise, having become the tortoise form, the churning of the ocean of milk [was done],

16.81.s:
kṛtvā tvayā jagannātha uddhṛtā śrīrnamo 'stu te ..
śrīpatiḥ śrīdharo deva ārttānāmartināśanaḥ .. 24 ..
16.81.d:
कृत्वा त्वया जगन्नाथ उद्धृता श्रीर्नमो ऽस्तु ते ..
श्रीपतिः श्रीधरो देव आर्त्तानामर्तिनाशनः .. 24 ..
16.81.m: and by you, O Lord of the universe, Śrī was raised up; homage to you! / Lord of Śrī, bearer of Śrī, the god who destroys the suffering of the afflicted!

16.81.s:
balirvāmanarūpeṇa tvayā baddho'surāriṇā ..
hiraṇyākṣo mahādaityo hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ .. 25 ..
16.81.d:
बलिर्वामनरूपेण त्वया बद्धोऽसुरारिणा ..
हिरण्याक्षो महादैत्यो हिरण्यकशिपुर्हतः .. 25 ..
16.81.m: In the form of Vāmana, Bali was bound by you, the enemy of the Asuras; / the great Daitya Hiraṇyākṣa and Hiraṇyakaśipu were slain.

16.81.s:
nārasiṃhena rūpeṇa antarikṣe dhṛtastvayā ..
devamūla mahādeva uddhṛtaṃ bhuvanaṃ tvayā .. 26 ..
16.81.d:
नारसिंहेन रूपेण अन्तरिक्षे धृतस्त्वया ..
देवमूल महादेव उद्धृतं भुवनं त्वया .. 26 ..
16.81.m: In the form of Narasiṃha he was held in the mid-air by you. / O source of the gods, O Mahādeva, the world was delivered by you!

16.81.s:
tvayā vinā jagannātha bhuvanaṃ niṣprabhī kṛtam ..
sūryeṇeva tu vikrāntaṃ tamobhiriva dānavaiḥ .. 27 ..
16.81.d:
त्वया विना जगन्नाथ भुवनं निष्प्रभी कृतम् ..
सूर्येणेव तु विक्रान्तं तमोभिरिव दानवैः .. 27 ..
16.81.m: Without you, O Lord of the World, the world was rendered lustreless, / as if overwhelmed by the sun [or rather] by darkness, by the Dānavas.

16.81.s:
śrutvā stotramidaṃ devi viṣṇuḥ kamalalocanaḥ ..
uvāca devānbrahmādyānkṣīrodārṇava bodhitaḥ .. 28 ..
16.81.d:
श्रुत्वा स्तोत्रमिदं देवि विष्णुः कमललोचनः ..
उवाच देवान्ब्रह्माद्यान्क्षीरोदार्णव बोधितः .. 28 ..
16.81.m: Hearing this hymn of praise, O goddess, the lotus-eyed Viṣṇu, / awakened on the ocean of milk, spoke to the gods headed by Brahmā:

16.81.s:
bhayaṃ tyajadhvaṃ vai devā dānavānprati sarvathā ..
acireṇaiva kālena ghātayiṣyāmi dānavān .. 29 ..
16.81.d:
भयं त्यजध्वं वै देवा दानवान्प्रति सर्वथा ..
अचिरेणैव कालेन घातयिष्यामि दानवान् .. 29 ..
16.81.m: "Cast off all fear, O gods, with regard to the Dānavas! / Within a short time indeed I shall destroy the Dānavas."

16.81.s:
evamuktvātha taiḥ sārddhamā jagāma janārddanaḥ ..
dānavānghātayāmāsa sa cakreṇa pṛthakpṛthak .. 7.1.81.30 ..
16.81.d:
एवमुक्त्वाथ तैः सार्द्धमा जगाम जनार्द्दनः ..
दानवान्घातयामास स चक्रेण पृथक्पृथक् .. 7.1.81.30 ..
16.81.m: Having spoken thus, Janārdana came forth together with them. / He destroyed the Dānavas individually with his discus.

16.81.s:
bhayārttā dānavāḥ sarve palāyanaparāyaṇāḥ ..
prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya samudrābhimukhā bhavan.. 31 ..
16.81.d:
भयार्त्ता दानवाः सर्वे पलायनपरायणाः ..
प्रभासं क्षेत्रमासाद्य समुद्राभिमुखा भवन्.. 31 ..
16.81.m: Afflicted with fear, all the Dānavas intent on flight / reached the sacred field of Prabhāsa and turned towards the ocean.

16.81.s:
naśyamānāstato dṛṣṭvā daityāndaityavināśanam ..
saṃjaghne tānsa cakreṇa niḥśeṣānsarvadānavān .. 32 ..
16.81.d:
नश्यमानास्ततो दृष्ट्वा दैत्यान्दैत्यविनाशनम् ..
संजघ्ने तान्स चक्रेण निःशेषान्सर्वदानवान् .. 32 ..
16.81.m: Then, seeing the Daityas perishing, he, the destroyer of the Daityas, / wiped out with his discus all those Dānavas without remainder.

16.81.s:
hateṣu sarvadaityeṣu devabrāhmaṇatāpasaiḥ ..
kalyāṇamabhavattatra jagatsvasthamanākulam .. 33 ..
16.81.d:
हतेषु सर्वदैत्येषु देवब्राह्मणतापसैः ..
कल्याणमभवत्तत्र जगत्स्वस्थमनाकुलम् .. 33 ..
16.81.m: When all the Daityas were slain, for the gods, brahmins, and ascetics / auspicious well-being ensued; the world became peaceful and free from turmoil.

16.81.s:
tatprabhṛtyeva devasya daityasūdananāma tat ..
etanmāhātmyamatulaṃ kathitaṃ tava sundari ..
daityasūdanadevasya mahābhāgyaṃ mahodayam .. 34 ..
16.81.d:
तत्प्रभृत्येव देवस्य दैत्यसूदननाम तत् ..
एतन्माहात्म्यमतुलं कथितं तव सुन्दरि ..
दैत्यसूदनदेवस्य महाभाग्यं महोदयम् .. 34 ..
16.81.m: From that time onwards, the god bore that name 'Daityasūdana' (Slayer of the Daityas). / This peerless māhātmya has been related to you, O lovely one: / the great glory and vast exaltation of Lord Daityasūdana.

16.81.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā na jaḍo nāṃdho na daridro na duḥkhitaḥ ..
jāyate sapta janmāni satyaṃsatyaṃ varānane .. 35 ..
16.81.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा न जडो नांधो न दरिद्रो न दुःखितः ..
जायते सप्त जन्मानि सत्यंसत्यं वरानने .. 35 ..
16.81.m: Upon seeing him, a person is not born dumb, blind, destitute, or suffering / for seven lifetimes; this is true, truly so, O fair-faced one!

16.81.s:
śravaṇadvādaśīṃ puṇyāṃ rohiṇyāṃ cāṣṭamīṃ śubhām ..
śayanotthāpanīṃ caiva naraḥ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ .. 36 ..
16.81.d:
श्रवणद्वादशीं पुण्यां रोहिण्यां चाष्टमीं शुभाम् ..
शयनोत्थापनीं चैव नरः कृत्वा प्रयत्नतः .. 36 ..
16.81.m: Observing with effort the meritorious Śravaṇadvādaśī and the auspicious Rohiṇī-aṣṭamī, / as well as the Śayanī and Utthāpanī [Ekādaśīs],

16.81.s:
ekaikenopa vāsena upavāsāyutaṃ phalam ..
labhate nātra sandeho daityasūdanasannidhau .. 37 ..
16.81.d:
एकैकेनोप वासेन उपवासायुतं फलम् ..
लभते नात्र सन्देहो दैत्यसूदनसन्निधौ .. 37 ..
16.81.m: a man attains the fruit of ten thousand fasts / from each single fast in the presence of Daityasūdana; there is no doubt in this.

16.81.s:
caṇḍālaḥ śvapaco vāpi tiryagyonigato'pi vā ..
prāṇatyāge kṛte tasminnācyutaṃ lokamāpnuyāt .. 38 ..
16.81.d:
चण्डालः श्वपचो वापि तिर्यग्योनिगतोऽपि वा ..
प्राणत्यागे कृते तस्मिन्नाच्युतं लोकमाप्नुयात् .. 38 ..
16.81.m: Even a Caṇḍāla or an outcaste dog-cooker, or one born in an animal womb, / when he yields his life there, shall reach the imperishable realm of Acyuta.

16.81.s:
kārtikyāṃ caiva vaiśākhyāṃ māsamekamupoṣayet ..
daityasūdanamadhyasthaḥ samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ .. 39 ...
16.81.d:
कार्तिक्यां चैव वैशाख्यां मासमेकमुपोषयेत् ..
दैत्यसूदनमध्यस्थः सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः .. 39 ...
16.81.m: And if one should fast for one month in the months of Kārttika and Vaiśākha, / abiding in the midst of Daityasūdana, endowed with full faith,

16.81.s:
ekaikenopavāsena koṭikoṭi pṛthakpṛthak ..
labhate tatphalaṃ sarvaṃ viṣṇukṣetraprabhāvataḥ .. 7.1.81.40 ..
16.81.d:
एकैकेनोपवासेन कोटिकोटि पृथक्पृथक् ..
लभते तत्फलं सर्वं विष्णुक्षेत्रप्रभावतः .. 7.1.81.40 ..
16.81.m: by each single fast one obtains ten million times [the reward] respectively; / he gains all that fruit by the power of Viṣṇu's sacred field.

16.81.s:
dīpaṃ dadāti yastatra māsaṃ vā pakṣameva vā ..
ekaika dīpadānena koṭidīpaphalaṃ labhet .. 41 ..
16.81.d:
दीपं ददाति यस्तत्र मासं वा पक्षमेव वा ..
एकैक दीपदानेन कोटिदीपफलं लभेत् .. 41 ..
16.81.m: Whoever offers a lamp there for a month or for a fortnight / obtains the fruit of ten million lamps by the gift of each single lamp.

16.81.s:
paṃcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya devadevaṃ caturbhujam ..
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ pūjayitvā'cyuto bhavet .. 42 ..
16.81.d:
पंचामृतेन संस्नाप्य देवदेवं चतुर्भुजम् ..
एकादश्यां निराहारः पूजयित्वाऽच्युतो भवेत् .. 42 ..
16.81.m: Having bathed the god of gods, the four-armed one, with the five nectars, / fasting on the Ekādaśī and worshipping him, one becomes imperishable.

16.81.s:
cāturmāsyaṃ vidhānena daityasūdanasannidhau ..
niyamena kṣipedyastu tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ .. 43 ..
16.81.d:
चातुर्मास्यं विधानेन दैत्यसूदनसन्निधौ ..
नियमेन क्षिपेद्यस्तु तस्य तुष्यति केशवः .. 43 ..
16.81.m: Whoever observes the four-month vow according to rule in the presence of Daityasūdana / with strict restraint, Keśava is pleased with him.

16.81.s:
anyakṣetreṣu yatkṛtvā cāturmāsyāni koṭiśaḥ ..
tatphalaṃ labhate sarvaṃ daityasūdanadarśanāt .. 44 ..
16.81.d:
अन्यक्षेत्रेषु यत्कृत्वा चातुर्मास्यानि कोटिशः ..
तत्फलं लभते सर्वं दैत्यसूदनदर्शनात् .. 44 ..
16.81.m: Whatever [merit] is gained by performing millions of four-month vows in other sacred fields, / all that fruit one obtains from the darśana of Daityasūdana.

16.81.s:
brahmāṇḍaṃ sakalaṃ dattvā yatpuṇyaphalamāpnuyāt ..
tatpuṇyaṃ labhate sarvaṃ daityasūdanadarśanāt.. 45..
16.81.d:
ब्रह्माण्डं सकलं दत्त्वा यत्पुण्यफलमाप्नुयात् ..
तत्पुण्यं लभते सर्वं दैत्यसूदनदर्शनात्.. 45..
16.81.m: Whatever meritorious fruit one may obtain by giving away the entire universe, / all that merit one obtains from the darśana of Daityasūdana.

16.81.s:
ekādaśyāṃ tu yastatra kurute jāgaraṃ naraḥ ..
gītanṛtyaistathā vādyaiḥ prekṣaṇīyaistathāvidhaiḥ ..
sa yāti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ yaṃ gatvā na nivarttate .. 46 ..
16.81.d:
एकादश्यां तु यस्तत्र कुरुते जागरं नरः ..
गीतनृत्यैस्तथा वाद्यैः प्रेक्षणीयैस्तथाविधैः ..
स याति वैष्णवं लोकं यं गत्वा न निवर्त्तते .. 46 ..
16.81.m: The man who keeps a night vigil there on an Ekādaśī / with songs, dances, musical instruments, and suitable spectacles, / goes to the realm of Viṣṇu, from which, having gone, he does not return.

16.81.s:
hatyā'yutānīha susaṃcitāni steyāni rukmasya na santi saṃkhyā ..
nihaṃti kenāpi purā kṛtāni sarvāṇi bhadrā niśi jāgareṇa .. 47..
16.81.d:
हत्याऽयुतानीह सुसंचितानि स्तेयानि रुक्मस्य न सन्ति संख्या ..
निहंति केनापि पुरा कृतानि सर्वाणि भद्रा निशि जागरेण .. 47..
16.81.m: Tens of thousands of killings accumulated here, and thefts of gold beyond count— / all those committed in the past by anyone are destroyed, O auspicious lady, by a vigil through the night.

16.81.s:
mārgā na te pretapurī na dūtā vanaṃ ca tatkhecarakhaḍgapatram ..
svapne na paśyaṃti ca te manuṣyā yeṣāṃ gatā jāgaraṇena bhadrā .. 48 ..
16.81.d:
मार्गा न ते प्रेतपुरी न दूता वनं च तत्खेचरखड्गपत्रम् ..
स्वप्ने न पश्यंति च ते मनुष्या येषां गता जागरणेन भद्रा .. 48 ..
16.81.m: Neither those paths, nor the city of the spirits of the dead, nor the messengers, nor that sky-ranging forest of sword-like leaves / do those men ever see even in a dream whose night, O auspicious lady, has passed in vigil.

16.81.s:
kanyāsahasraṃ vidhivaddadāti ratnairalaṃkṛtya svadharmabuddhyā ..
gavāṃ sahasraṃ kurujāṃgale tu teṣāṃ paraṃ jāgaraṇena viṣṇoḥ .. 49 ..
16.81.d:
कन्यासहस्रं विधिवद्ददाति रत्नैरलंकृत्य स्वधर्मबुद्ध्या ..
गवां सहस्रं कुरुजांगले तु तेषां परं जागरणेन विष्णोः .. 49 ..
16.81.m: If one gives a thousand maidens in marriage according to rule, adorned with jewels, with the thought of fulfilling one's duty, / or a thousand cows in the land of Kurujāṅgala, superior to those is keeping vigil for Viṣṇu.

16.81.s:
kṛtvā caivopavāsaṃ ca yo'śnāti dvādaśīdine ..
naivedyaṃ tulasīmiśraṃ hatyākoṭivināśanam .. 7.1.81.50 ..
16.81.d:
कृत्वा चैवोपवासं च योऽश्नाति द्वादशीदिने ..
नैवेद्यं तुलसीमिश्रं हत्याकोटिविनाशनम् .. 7.1.81.50 ..
16.81.m: And having observed a fast, whoever eats on the Dvādaśī day / food offering mixed with tulasī destroys ten million killings.

16.81.s:
iti te kathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
daityasūdanadevasya kimanyatparipṛcchasi .. .. 51 ..
16.81.d:
इति ते कथितं देवि माहात्म्यं पापनाशनम् ..
दैत्यसूदनदेवस्य किमन्यत्परिपृच्छसि .. .. 51 ..
16.81.m: Thus has been related to you, O goddess, the sin-destroying māhātmya / of Lord Daityasūdana; what else do you wish to ask?

16.81.s:
pītavastrāṇi devasya gāṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca dāpayet ..
snātvā cakravare tīrthe mucyate sarvapātakāt .. 52 ..
16.81.d:
पीतवस्त्राणि देवस्य गां हिरण्यं च दापयेत् ..
स्नात्वा चक्रवरे तीर्थे मुच्यते सर्वपातकात् .. 52 ..
16.81.m: One should offer yellow garments, a cow, and gold to the deity; / having bathed at the excellent sacred ford of the discus, one is released from all sin.

16.81.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathameprabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śrīdaityasūdanamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 81 .. .. ..
16.81.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमेप्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये श्रीदैत्यसूदनमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकाशीतितमोऽध्यायः .. 81 .. .. ..
16.81.m: Thus ends the eighty-first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Glorious Daityasūdana', in the first Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the Skandapurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses.

16.82.s:
..devyuvāca .. ..
cakratīrtheti kiṃ nāma tvayā proktaṃ vṛṣadhvaja ..
kutra tiṣṭhati tattīrthaṃ kiṃ prabhāvaṃ vadasva me .. 1 ..
16.82.d:
..देव्युवाच .. ..
चक्रतीर्थेति किं नाम त्वया प्रोक्तं वृषध्वज ..
कुत्र तिष्ठति तत्तीर्थं किं प्रभावं वदस्व मे .. 1 ..
16.82.m: The goddess said: / What is this name 'Cakratīrtha' that was mentioned by you, O bull-bannered Lord? / Where does that sacred ford lie, and what is its efficacy? Tell me!

16.82.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
purā devāsure yuddhe hatvā daityāñjanārddanaḥ ..
cakraṃ prakṣālayāmāsa tatra vai raktaraṃjitam.. 2 ..
16.82.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
पुरा देवासुरे युद्धे हत्वा दैत्याञ्जनार्द्दनः ..
चक्रं प्रक्षालयामास तत्र वै रक्तरंजितम्.. 2 ..
16.82.m: Īśvara said: / Anciently, in the war between the gods and the Asuras, Janārdana, having slain the Daityas, / washed there his discus stained with blood.

16.82.s:
aṣṭakoṭisutīrthāni tatrānīya svayaṃ hariḥ ..
tīrthe prakalpayāmāsa śuddhiṃ kṛtvā sudarśane ..
tīrthasya cakre nāmāpi cakatīrthamiti śrutam.. 3 ..
16.82.d:
अष्टकोटिसुतीर्थानि तत्रानीय स्वयं हरिः ..
तीर्थे प्रकल्पयामास शुद्धिं कृत्वा सुदर्शने ..
तीर्थस्य चक्रे नामापि चकतीर्थमिति श्रुतम्.. 3 ..
16.82.m: Hari himself, having brought eighty million excellent sacred fords there, / established them in that sacred ford, having purified Sudarśana; / and he made the name of the sacred ford famous as 'Cakratīrtha'.

16.82.s:
aṣṭāyutāni tīrthānāmaṣṭau koṭyastathaiva ca ..
tatra saṃti mahādevi cakratīrthe na saṃśayaḥ .. 4 ..
16.82.d:
अष्टायुतानि तीर्थानामष्टौ कोट्यस्तथैव च ..
तत्र संति महादेवि चक्रतीर्थे न संशयः .. 4 ..
16.82.m: Eighty thousand sacred fords and likewise eighty million [sacred fords] / are present there at Cakratīrtha, O great goddess; there is no doubt.

16.82.s:
yastatra kurute snānamekacitto narottamaḥ..
sarvatīrthābhiṣekasya sa prāpnotyakhilaṃ phalam..5 ..
16.82.d:
यस्तत्र कुरुते स्नानमेकचित्तो नरोत्तमः..
सर्वतीर्थाभिषेकस्य स प्राप्नोत्यखिलं फलम्..5 ..
16.82.m: The best among men who takes a ritual ablution there with a concentrated mind / obtains the entire fruit of bathing in all sacred fords.

16.82.s:
tīrthānāmaṣṭakoṭistu nivasaṃti varānane ..
ekādaśyāṃ viśeṣeṇa candrasūryagrahe tathā .. 6 ..
16.82.d:
तीर्थानामष्टकोटिस्तु निवसंति वरानने ..
एकादश्यां विशेषेण चन्द्रसूर्यग्रहे तथा .. 6 ..
16.82.m: Eighty million sacred fords reside [there], O fair-faced one, / especially on an Ekādaśī and during an eclipse of the moon or the sun.

16.82.s:
tatra snātvā mahādevi yajñakoṭiphalaṃ labhet ..
tasyaiva kalpanāmāni śṛṇu te kathayāmyaham .. 7 ..
16.82.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा महादेवि यज्ञकोटिफलं लभेत् ..
तस्यैव कल्पनामानि शृणु ते कथयाम्यहम् .. 7 ..
16.82.m: Having bathed there, O great goddess, one obtains the fruit of ten million sacrifices. / Listen to its various names through the aeons; I shall tell you:

16.82.s:
koṭitīrthaṃ pūrvakalpe śrīnidhānaṃ dvitīyake ..
tṛtīye śatadhāraṃ ca cakratīrthaṃ caturthake .. 8 ..
16.82.d:
कोटितीर्थं पूर्वकल्पे श्रीनिधानं द्वितीयके ..
तृतीये शतधारं च चक्रतीर्थं चतुर्थके .. 8 ..
16.82.m: Koṭitīrtha in the first kalpa; Śrīnidhāna in the second; / Śatadhāra in the third; and Cakratīrtha in the fourth.

16.82.s:
evaṃ te kalpanāmāni hyatītānyakhilāni vai ..
kathitānyevamanyāni jñeyāni vibudhaiḥ kramāt.. 9 ..
16.82.d:
एवं ते कल्पनामानि ह्यतीतान्यखिलानि वै ..
कथितान्येवमन्यानि ज्ञेयानि विबुधैः क्रमात्.. 9 ..
16.82.m: Thus all the names throughout the past aeons / have been told to you; other names are likewise to be known by the wise in sequence.

16.82.s:
tatra yaddīyate dānaṃ tasya saṃkhyā na vidyate ..
arddhakrośapramāṇaṃ hi viṣṇukṣetraṃ prakīrttitam .. 7.1.82.10 ..
16.82.d:
तत्र यद्दीयते दानं तस्य संख्या न विद्यते ..
अर्द्धक्रोशप्रमाणं हि विष्णुक्षेत्रं प्रकीर्त्तितम् .. 7.1.82.10 ..
16.82.m: There is no reckoning of whatever gift is given there; / Viṣṇu's sacred field is proclaimed to extend for half a krośa.

16.82.s:
brahmahatyā nopasarpetsatyametanmayoditam ..
māsopavāsī tatkṣetre agnihotrī yatavrataḥ .. 11 ..
16.82.d:
ब्रह्महत्या नोपसर्पेत्सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् ..
मासोपवासी तत्क्षेत्रे अग्निहोत्री यतव्रतः .. 11 ..
16.82.m: The sin of killing a brahmin shall not draw near; this is the truth spoken by me. / One who fasts for a month in that sacred field, maintains the sacred fire, observes vows,

16.82.s:
svādhyāyī yajñayājī ca tapaścāṃdrāyaṇā dikam ..
tilodakaṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca śrāddhaṃ ca vidhipūrvakam .. 12 ..
16.82.d:
स्वाध्यायी यज्ञयाजी च तपश्चांद्रायणा दिकम् ..
तिलोदकं पितॄणां च श्राद्धं च विधिपूर्वकम् .. 12 ..
16.82.m: studies the sacred texts, performs sacrifices, undertakes austerities such as the cāndrāyaṇa penance, / and properly offers sesame-water and funeral rites to the ancestors,

16.82.s:
ekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā kṛcchraṃ sāṃtapanaṃ tathā ..
māsopavāsaṃ taccaiva anyadvā puṇyakarma tat .. 13 ..
16.82.d:
एकरात्रं त्रिरात्रं वा कृच्छ्रं सांतपनं तथा ..
मासोपवासं तच्चैव अन्यद्वा पुण्यकर्म तत् .. 13 ..
16.82.m: [Whether it be a fast of] one night or three nights, or a kṛcchra, or a sāṃtapana penance, / a one-month fast, or any other meritorious act:

16.82.s:
daityārikṣetramāsādya yatkiṃcitkurute naraḥ ..
anyakṣetrātkoṭiguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ bhūyānna saṃśayaḥ .. 14 ..
16.82.d:
दैत्यारिक्षेत्रमासाद्य यत्किंचित्कुरुते नरः ..
अन्यक्षेत्रात्कोटिगुणं पुण्यं भूयान्न संशयः .. 14 ..
16.82.m: Whatever a man performs after reaching the sacred field of the Enemy of the Daityas, / his merit becomes ten-millionfold greater than in any other sacred field; there is no doubt.

16.82.s:
sudarśane vare tīrthe godānaṃ tatra dāpayet ..
samyagyātrāphalaprepsuḥ sarvapāpaviśuddhaye .. 15 ..
16.82.d:
सुदर्शने वरे तीर्थे गोदानं तत्र दापयेत् ..
सम्यग्यात्राफलप्रेप्सुः सर्वपापविशुद्धये .. 15 ..
16.82.m: There, at the excellent Sudarśana sacred ford, one seeking the full fruit of pilgrimage / should make a gift of cows for the purification of all sins.

16.82.s:
caṃḍālaḥ śvapaco vā'pi tiryagyonigatastathā ..
tasmiṃstīrthe mṛtaḥ samyagācyutaṃ lokamāpnuyāt .. 16 ..
16.82.d:
चंडालः श्वपचो वाऽपि तिर्यग्योनिगतस्तथा ..
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे मृतः सम्यगाच्युतं लोकमाप्नुयात् .. 16 ..
16.82.m: Even an outcaste, a dog-cooker, or an animal / who dies in that sacred ford attains the realm of Acyuta.

16.82.s:
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ cakratīrthasamudbhavam ..
māhātmyaṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam .. 17 ..
16.82.d:
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं चक्रतीर्थसमुद्भवम् ..
माहात्म्यं सर्वपापघ्नं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् .. 17 ..
16.82.m: Thus has been declared in brief the origin of Cakra sacred ford, / a māhātmya that destroys all sins and grants the fruit of all desires.

16.82.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye daityasūdana māhātmyaprasaṃgena cakratīrthotpattivṛttāntamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 82 ..
16.82.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये दैत्यसूदन माहात्म्यप्रसंगेन चक्रतीर्थोत्पत्तिवृत्तान्तमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्व्यशीतितमोऽध्यायः .. 82 ..
16.82.m: Thus ends the eighty-second chapter, entitled 'Description of the Origin and Māhātmya of Cakra Sacred Ford on the Occasion of the Māhātmya of Daityasūdana,' in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa Sacred Field, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the great Purāṇa of Śrī Skanda consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.83.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tasya pūrveṇa saṃsthitām ..
yogeśvarīṃ mahādevīṃ yogasiddhiphalapradām .. 1 ..
16.83.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तस्य पूर्वेण संस्थिताम् ..
योगेश्वरीं महादेवीं योगसिद्धिफलप्रदाम् .. 1 ..
16.83.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to Yogeśvarī, the great goddess situated to the east of it, / who bestows the fruit of yogic perfection.

16.83.s:
tadutpattiṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu śraddhāsamanvitā ..
purā dānavaśārdūlo mahiṣākhyo mahābalaḥ .. 2 ..
16.83.d:
तदुत्पत्तिं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु श्रद्धासमन्विता ..
पुरा दानवशार्दूलो महिषाख्यो महाबलः .. 2 ..
16.83.m: I shall relate her origin; listen endowed with faith. / Long ago, there was a tiger among the Dānavas named Mahiṣa, possessed of great strength,

16.83.s:
babhūva pravaro devi sarvadevabhayaṃkaraḥ ..
kāmarūpī sa lokāṃstrīnvaśīkṛtvā'bhavatsukhī .. 3 ..
16.83.d:
बभूव प्रवरो देवि सर्वदेवभयंकरः ..
कामरूपी स लोकांस्त्रीन्वशीकृत्वाऽभवत्सुखी .. 3 ..
16.83.m: an eminent one, O goddess, who brought terror to all the gods. / Changing forms at will, having subjugated the three worlds, he lived happily.

16.83.s:
kasmiṃścidatha kāle tu brahmaṇā lokakāriṇā ..
sṛṣṭā manoharā kanyā rūpeṇāpratimā divi .. 4 ..
16.83.d:
कस्मिंश्चिदथ काले तु ब्रह्मणा लोककारिणा ..
सृष्टा मनोहरा कन्या रूपेणाप्रतिमा दिवि .. 4 ..
16.83.m: Then, at a certain time, by Brahmā, the creator of the worlds, / a captivating maiden of peerless beauty was created in heaven.

16.83.s:
atapatsā tapo ghoraṃ kanyā rūpavatī satī ..
nāradena tato dṛṣṭā sā kadācidvarānane .. 5 ..
16.83.d:
अतपत्सा तपो घोरं कन्या रूपवती सती ..
नारदेन ततो दृष्टा सा कदाचिद्वरानने .. 5 ..
16.83.m: That beautiful, chaste maiden performed severe austerity. / Then she was once seen by Nārada, O fair-faced one.

16.83.s:
tataḥ sa sahasā devi vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ..
aho rūpamaho dhairyamaho kāntiraho vayaḥ .. 6 ..
16.83.d:
ततः स सहसा देवि विस्मयं परमं गतः ..
अहो रूपमहो धैर्यमहो कान्तिरहो वयः .. 6 ..
16.83.m: Thereupon he was suddenly struck with great astonishment, O goddess: / 'Ah, what beauty! Ah, what fortitude! Ah, what radiance! Ah, what youth!'

16.83.s:
ityevaṃ cintayaṃstatra nārīṃ vacanamabravīt ..
kuruṣvātmapradānaṃ me na me dāraparigrahaḥ ..
tavāhaṃ darśanāddevi kāmavāṇena pīḍitaḥ ..7..
16.83.d:
इत्येवं चिन्तयंस्तत्र नारीं वचनमब्रवीत् ..
कुरुष्वात्मप्रदानं मे न मे दारपरिग्रहः ..
तवाहं दर्शनाद्देवि कामवाणेन पीडितः ..7..
16.83.m: Thinking thus, he said these words to the woman there: / 'Surrender yourself to me; I have taken no wife. / O goddess, from the sight of you I am afflicted by the arrow of desire.'

16.83.s:
sā'bravīnna hi me kāryaṃ kāmadharmeṇa sattama..
kaumāraṃ vratamāsādya sādhayiṣye yathepsitam ]. 8 ..
16.83.d:
साऽब्रवीन्न हि मे कार्यं कामधर्मेण सत्तम..
कौमारं व्रतमासाद्य साधयिष्ये यथेप्सितम् ]. 8 ..
16.83.m: She said: 'I have no concern with the way of passion, O best of men. / Undertaking the vow of celibacy, I will achieve what I desire.

16.83.s:
na ca manyustvayā kāryo hyasminnarthe kathaṃcana ..
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā sa munirnāradaḥ priye .. .. 9 ..
16.83.d:
न च मन्युस्त्वया कार्यो ह्यस्मिन्नर्थे कथंचन ..
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा स मुनिर्नारदः प्रिये .. .. 9 ..
16.83.m: And you must by no means be angry in this matter.' / Hearing those words of hers, the sage Nārada, O beloved,

16.83.s:
samudrānte'gamaddivyāṃ purīṃ mahiṣapālitām ..
arcito hi munistena mahiṣeṇa mahātmanā .. 7.1.83.10 ..
16.83.d:
समुद्रान्तेऽगमद्दिव्यां पुरीं महिषपालिताम् ..
अर्चितो हि मुनिस्तेन महिषेण महात्मना .. 7.1.83.10 ..
16.83.m: went to the divine city on the sea coast, ruled by Mahiṣa. / The sage was honored by that great-souled Mahiṣa.

16.83.s:
pṛṣṭvā hyanāmayaṃ devi dattvā cārghyamanuttamam ..
so'bravītprāñjalirbhūtvā kimāgamanakāraṇam ..
brūhi yatte vyavasitaṃ sarvaṃ karttāsmi nārada..11..
16.83.d:
पृष्ट्वा ह्यनामयं देवि दत्त्वा चार्घ्यमनुत्तमम् ..
सोऽब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा किमागमनकारणम् ..
ब्रूहि यत्ते व्यवसितं सर्वं कर्त्तास्मि नारद..11..
16.83.m: Having inquired about his well-being, O goddess, and offered excellent guest-water, / [Mahiṣa] said with folded hands: 'What is the reason for your coming? / Speak of what you have determined; I will do it all, O Nārada.'

16.83.s:
athovāca munistatra mahiṣaṃ dānaveśvaram..
kanyāratnaṃ samutpannaṃ jaṃbūdvīpe mahāsura ..12 ..
16.83.d:
अथोवाच मुनिस्तत्र महिषं दानवेश्वरम्..
कन्यारत्नं समुत्पन्नं जंबूद्वीपे महासुर ..12 ..
16.83.m: Then the sage spoke there to Mahiṣa, the lord of the Dānavas: / 'A jewel of a maiden has appeared in Jambudvīpa, O great Asura!

16.83.s:
svarge martye ca pātāle na dṛṣṭaṃ na ca me śrutam ..
tādṛgrūpamahaṃ yena kāmabāṇavaśīkṛtaḥ .. 13 ..
16.83.d:
स्वर्गे मर्त्ये च पाताले न दृष्टं न च मे श्रुतम् ..
तादृग्रूपमहं येन कामबाणवशीकृतः .. 13 ..
16.83.m: Such beauty has neither been seen nor heard of by me in heaven, on earth, or in Pātāla, / by which I have been subjugated by the arrows of desire.'

16.83.s:
sa śrutvā vacanaṃ tasya kāmasyotpādanaṃ param..
jagāma yatra sā sādhvī kṣetre prābhāsike sthitā .. 14 ..
16.83.d:
स श्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य कामस्योत्पादनं परम्..
जगाम यत्र सा साध्वी क्षेत्रे प्राभासिके स्थिता .. 14 ..
16.83.m: Hearing his speech, which greatly aroused desire, / he went to where that virtuous woman was residing in the Prabhāsa sacred field.

16.83.s:
tāmeva prārthayāmāsa balena mahatā vṛtaḥ ..
bhāryā bhava tvaṃ me bhīru bhuṃkṣva bhogānmanoramān..
etattapo mahābhāge viruddhaṃ yauvanasya te .. 15 ..
16.83.d:
तामेव प्रार्थयामास बलेन महता वृतः ..
भार्या भव त्वं मे भीरु भुंक्ष्व भोगान्मनोरमान्..
एतत्तपो महाभागे विरुद्धं यौवनस्य ते .. 15 ..
16.83.m: Surrounded by a vast army, he wooed her: / 'Become my wife, O timid one, and enjoy delightful pleasures! / This austerity, O fortunate one, is contrary to your youth.'

16.83.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā jahāsa varavarṇinī ..
tasyā hasaṃtyā deveśi śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ .. 16 ..
16.83.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा जहास वरवर्णिनी ..
तस्या हसंत्या देवेशि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः .. 16 ..
16.83.m: Hearing his speech, the fair-complexioned woman laughed. / As she laughed, O ruler of the gods, by the hundreds and thousands,

16.83.s:
niśvāsātsahasā nāryaḥ śastrahastā bhayānakāḥ ..
tābhirvidhvaṃsitaṃ sainyaṃ mahiṣasya durātmanaḥ ..17..
16.83.d:
निश्वासात्सहसा नार्यः शस्त्रहस्ता भयानकाः ..
ताभिर्विध्वंसितं सैन्यं महिषस्य दुरात्मनः ..17..
16.83.m: terrific women with weapons in hand suddenly [emerged] from her breath; / by them the army of the wicked Mahiṣa was destroyed.

16.83.s:
tasminnipātyamāne tu sainye dānavasattamaḥ ..
krodhaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ śīghraṃ tāmevābhimukho yayau ..18..
16.83.d:
तस्मिन्निपात्यमाने तु सैन्ये दानवसत्तमः ..
क्रोधं कृत्वा ततः शीघ्रं तामेवाभिमुखो ययौ ..18..
16.83.m: When that army was being struck down, the best of Dānavas, / having flown into a rage, then rushed straight toward her.

16.83.s:
vidhunvansa hi te tīkṣṇaśṛṃge'bhīkṣṇaṃ bhayānake ...
tayā sārdhaṃ ca sumahatkṛtvā yuddhaṃ mahāsuraḥ ..19..
16.83.d:
विधुन्वन्स हि ते तीक्ष्णशृंगेऽभीक्ष्णं भयानके ...
तया सार्धं च सुमहत्कृत्वा युद्धं महासुरः ..19..
16.83.m: Constantly shaking his sharp, terrifying horns, / the great Asura fought an immense battle with her.

16.83.s:
śṛṃgābhyāṃ jagṛhe devīṃ sā tasyopari saṃsthitā ..
padbhyāmākramya śūlena nihato daityapuṃgavaḥ ..7.1.83.20..
16.83.d:
शृंगाभ्यां जगृहे देवीं सा तस्योपरि संस्थिता ..
पद्भ्यामाक्रम्य शूलेन निहतो दैत्यपुंगवः ..7.1.83.20..
16.83.m: He caught the goddess with his two horns; standing upon him / and trampling him with her feet, the bull of Daityas was slain with her pike.

16.83.s:
chinne śirasi khaṅgena tadrūpo niḥsṛtaḥ pumān ..
raudro'pi sa gataḥ svargaṃ daityo devyastrapātitaḥ ..21..
16.83.d:
छिन्ने शिरसि खङ्गेन तद्रूपो निःसृतः पुमान् ..
रौद्रोऽपि स गतः स्वर्गं दैत्यो देव्यस्त्रपातितः ..21..
16.83.m: When his head was severed with a sword, a man of that form came forth. / Though dreadful, that Daitya, struck down by the weapon of the goddess, went to heaven.

16.83.s:
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve mahiṣaṃ vīkṣya nirjitam ...
maheṃdrādyāḥ stutiṃ cakrurdevyāstuṣṭena cetasā..22..
16.83.d:
ततो देवगणाः सर्वे महिषं वीक्ष्य निर्जितम् ...
महेंद्राद्याः स्तुतिं चक्रुर्देव्यास्तुष्टेन चेतसा..22..
16.83.m: Then all the hosts of gods, Mahendra and the others, beholding Mahiṣa defeated, / praised the goddess with a satisfied mind.

16.83.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ..
namo devi mahābhāge gambhīre bhīmadarśane..
nayasthite susiddhāṃte trinetre viśvatomukhi .. 23 ..
16.83.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः..
नमो देवि महाभागे गम्भीरे भीमदर्शने..
नयस्थिते सुसिद्धांते त्रिनेत्रे विश्वतोमुखि .. 23 ..
16.83.m: The gods said: / 'Salutations to you, O goddess, highly fortunate, profound, of terrible aspect, / abiding in justice, of true tenets, three-eyed, facing all directions;

16.83.s:
vidyāvidye jaye jāpye mahiṣāsuramardini ..
sarvage sarvavidyeśe devi viśvasvarūpiṇi ..24..
16.83.d:
विद्याविद्ये जये जाप्ये महिषासुरमर्दिनि ..
सर्वगे सर्वविद्येशे देवि विश्वस्वरूपिणि ..24..
16.83.m: knowledge and ignorance, victorious, worthy of recitation, crusher of the demon Mahiṣa, / omnipresent, ruler of all knowledge, O goddess whose form is the universe;

16.83.s:
vītaśoke dhruve devi padmapatrāyatekṣaṇe ..
śuddhasattve vratasthe ca caṇḍarūpe vibhāvari ..25..
16.83.d:
वीतशोके ध्रुवे देवि पद्मपत्रायतेक्षणे ..
शुद्धसत्त्वे व्रतस्थे च चण्डरूपे विभावरि ..25..
16.83.m: free from grief, steadfast, O goddess whose long eyes are like lotus petals, / of pure being, established in vows, of fierce form, O night;

16.83.s:
ṛddhisiddhiprade devi kālanṛtye dhṛtipriye ..
śāṃkari brāhmaṇi brāhmi sarvadevanamaskṛte ..26..
16.83.d:
ऋद्धिसिद्धिप्रदे देवि कालनृत्ये धृतिप्रिये ..
शांकरि ब्राह्मणि ब्राह्मि सर्वदेवनमस्कृते ..26..
16.83.m: bestower of prosperity and perfection, O goddess who dances at the end of time, fond of firmness, / Śāṃkarī, Brāhmaṇī, Brāhmī, saluted by all the gods;

16.83.s:
ghaṃṭāhaste śūla haste mahāmahiṣamardini ..
ugrarūpe virūpākṣi mahāmāye'mṛte śive .. 27 ..
16.83.d:
घंटाहस्ते शूल हस्ते महामहिषमर्दिनि ..
उग्ररूपे विरूपाक्षि महामायेऽमृते शिवे .. 27 ..
16.83.m: with a bell in hand, with a pike in hand, crusher of the great Mahiṣa, / of terrible form, odd-eyed, great illusion, immortal, Śivā;

16.83.s:
sarvage sarvade devi sarvasattvamayodbhave ..
vidyāpurāṇaśalyānāṃ janani bhūtadhāriṇi .. 28 ..
16.83.d:
सर्वगे सर्वदे देवि सर्वसत्त्वमयोद्भवे ..
विद्यापुराणशल्यानां जननि भूतधारिणि .. 28 ..
16.83.m: omnipresent, bestower of all, O goddess whose origin consists of all beings, / mother of the sacred arts, the Purāṇas, and the darts, bearer of creatures;

16.83.s:
sarvadevarahasyānāṃ sarvasattvavatāṃ śubhe ..
tvameva śaraṇaṃ devi vidyā'vidye śriye'śriye .. 29 ..
16.83.d:
सर्वदेवरहस्यानां सर्वसत्त्ववतां शुभे ..
त्वमेव शरणं देवि विद्याऽविद्ये श्रियेऽश्रिये .. 29 ..
16.83.m: O auspicious one among all divine secrets and among all that possesses being, / you alone are the refuge, O goddess, knowledge and ignorance, fortune and misfortune.'

16.83.s:
evaṃ stutā surairdevi praṇamya ṛṣibhistathā ..
uvāca hasatī vākyaṃ vṛṇudhvaṃ varamuttamam .. 7.1.83.30 ..
16.83.d:
एवं स्तुता सुरैर्देवि प्रणम्य ऋषिभिस्तथा ..
उवाच हसती वाक्यं वृणुध्वं वरमुत्तमम् .. 7.1.83.30 ..
16.83.m: Praised thus by the gods, O goddess, and bowed down to by the seers, / she said smilingly: 'Choose an excellent boon.'

16.83.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ ..
stavenānena ye devi stuvantyatra narottamāḥ ..
te saṃtu kāmaiḥ saṃpūrṇā varavarṣā niraṃtaram .. 31 ..
16.83.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः ..
स्तवेनानेन ये देवि स्तुवन्त्यत्र नरोत्तमाः ..
ते संतु कामैः संपूर्णा वरवर्षा निरंतरम् .. 31 ..
16.83.m: The gods said: / 'O goddess, may the best of men who praise [you] here with this hymn / be constantly filled with desires and with showers of boons.

16.83.s: asminkṣetre tvayā vāso nityaṃ kāryaḥ śucismite .. 32 ..
16.83.d: अस्मिन्क्षेत्रे त्वया वासो नित्यं कार्यः शुचिस्मिते .. 32 ..
16.83.m: You must continually take up residence in this sacred field, O fair-smiling one.'

16.83.s:
evamastviti sā devī devānuktvā varānane ..
visṛjya ṛṣisaṃghāṃśca tatraiva niratā'bhavat .. 33 ..
16.83.d:
एवमस्त्विति सा देवी देवानुक्त्वा वरानने ..
विसृज्य ऋषिसंघांश्च तत्रैव निरताऽभवत् .. 33 ..
16.83.m: Saying 'So be it' to the gods, O fair-faced one, / the goddess dismissed the hosts of seers and remained delighting right there.

16.83.s:
āśvayukchuklapakṣasya navamyāṃ yo varānane ..
upavāsaparo bhūtvā tāṃ prapaśyati bhaktitaḥ ..
tasya pāpaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā .. 34 ..
16.83.d:
आश्वयुक्छुक्लपक्षस्य नवम्यां यो वरानने ..
उपवासपरो भूत्वा तां प्रपश्यति भक्तितः ..
तस्य पापं क्षयं याति तमः सूर्योदये यथा .. 34 ..
16.83.m: Whoever, O fair-faced one, intent on fasting on the ninth day of the bright fortnight of Āśvina, / beholds her with devotion, / his sin vanishes like darkness at sunrise.

16.83.s:
ya etatpaṭhati stotraṃ prātarutthāya mānavaḥ ..
na bhīḥ saṃpadyate tasya yāvajjīvaṃ narasya vai .. 35 ..
16.83.d:
य एतत्पठति स्तोत्रं प्रातरुत्थाय मानवः ..
न भीः संपद्यते तस्य यावज्जीवं नरस्य वै .. 35 ..
16.83.m: The man who recites this hymn upon waking in the morning— / no fear arises for that man as long as he lives.

16.83.s:
āśvayukchuklapakṣe yā aṣṭamī mūlasaṃyutā ..
sā mahānāmikā prāṇā yeṣāṃ tasyāṃ gatāḥ śubhe .. 36 ..
16.83.d:
आश्वयुक्छुक्लपक्षे या अष्टमी मूलसंयुता ..
सा महानामिका प्राणा येषां तस्यां गताः शुभे .. 36 ..
16.83.m: The eighth day of the bright fortnight of Āśvina that is conjoined with the asterism Mūla / is called the Mahānāmikā; those whose breaths depart on it, O auspicious one,

16.83.s: teṣāṃ svarge dhruvaṃ vāso vīrāste'psarasāṃ priyāḥ .. 37 ..
16.83.d: तेषां स्वर्गे ध्रुवं वासो वीरास्तेऽप्सरसां प्रियाः .. 37 ..
16.83.m: For them, dwelling in heaven is certain; those heroes are dear to the apsarases.

16.83.s:
manvantareṣu sarveṣu kalpādiṣu sureśvari ..
eṣa eva kramaḥ prokto viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu sāṃpratam ..38..
16.83.d:
मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु कल्पादिषु सुरेश्वरि ..
एष एव क्रमः प्रोक्तो विशेषं शृणु सांप्रतम् ..38..
16.83.m: In all the Manvantaras and at the beginnings of Kalpas, O ruler of the gods, / this very order has been declared; listen now to its specific detail.

16.83.s:
āśvayukchuklapakṣe yā paṃcamī pāpanāśinī ..
tasyāṃ saṃpūjayedrātrau khaḍgamaṃtrairvibhūṣitam .. 39 ..
16.83.d:
आश्वयुक्छुक्लपक्षे या पंचमी पापनाशिनी ..
तस्यां संपूजयेद्रात्रौ खड्गमंत्रैर्विभूषितम् .. 39 ..
16.83.m: On the fifth day in the bright fortnight of Āśvina, which destroys sins, / one should worship at night the sword adorned with mantras.

16.83.s:
maṃḍapaṃ kārayettatra navasaptakaraṃ tathā ..
prāgudakpravaṇe deśe patākābhiralaṃkṛtam ..
yogeśvaryāḥ saṃnidhāne vidhinā kārayeddvijaḥ..7.1.83.40...
16.83.d:
मंडपं कारयेत्तत्र नवसप्तकरं तथा ..
प्रागुदक्प्रवणे देशे पताकाभिरलंकृतम् ..
योगेश्वर्याः संनिधाने विधिना कारयेद्द्विजः..7.1.83.40...
16.83.m: There a pavilion of nine by seven cubits / should be erected in an area sloping towards the northeast and decorated with banners; / the twice-born should have it constructed according to rule in the presence of Yogeśvarī.

16.83.s:
āgneyyāṃ kārayetkuṇḍaṃ hastamātraṃ suśobhanam..
mekhalātrayasaṃyuktaṃ yonyā'śvatthadalābhayā..41..
16.83.d:
आग्नेय्यां कारयेत्कुण्डं हस्तमात्रं सुशोभनम्..
मेखलात्रयसंयुक्तं योन्याऽश्वत्थदलाभया..41..
16.83.m: In the southeast he should make a sacrificial pit of just one cubit, very beautiful, / furnished with three stepped tiers, with a vulva shaped like an aśvattha leaf.

16.83.s:
śāstroktaṃ mantrasaṃyuktaṃ hotavyaṃ pāyasaṃ tataḥ..
tataḥ khaḍgaṃ tu saṃsnāpya paṃcāmṛtarasena vai..
pūjayedvividhaiḥ puṣpairmaṃtrapūrvaṃ dvijottamaiḥ..42..
16.83.d:
शास्त्रोक्तं मन्त्रसंयुक्तं होतव्यं पायसं ततः..
ततः खड्गं तु संस्नाप्य पंचामृतरसेन वै..
पूजयेद्विविधैः पुष्पैर्मंत्रपूर्वं द्विजोत्तमैः..42..
16.83.m: Then sweet milk-rice, consecrated with mantras prescribed by scripture, should be offered into the fire; / then, having bathed the sword with the liquid of the five nectars, / he should worship it with various flowers, preceded by mantras, through the best of the twice-born.

16.83.s:
abhīrviśasanaṃ khaḍgaḥ prāṇibhūto durāsadaḥ ..
agamyo vijayaścaiva dharmādhārastathaiva ca ..
ityaṣṭau tava nāmāni svayamuktāni vedhasā .. 43 ..
16.83.d:
अभीर्विशसनं खड्गः प्राणिभूतो दुरासदः ..
अगम्यो विजयश्चैव धर्माधारस्तथैव च ..
इत्यष्टौ तव नामानि स्वयमुक्तानि वेधसा .. 43 ..
16.83.m: “Abhī, Viśasana, Khaḍga, Prāṇibhūta, Durāsada, / Agamya, Vijaya, and likewise Dharmādhāra— / these are your eight names spoken by the Creator himself.

16.83.s:
nakṣatraṃ kṛttikā tubhyaṃ gururdevo maheśvaraḥ ..
hiraṇyaṃ ca śarīraṃ te dhātā devo janārdanaḥ ..
pitā pitāmaho deva svena pālaya sarvadā .. 44 ..
16.83.d:
नक्षत्रं कृत्तिका तुभ्यं गुरुर्देवो महेश्वरः ..
हिरण्यं च शरीरं ते धाता देवो जनार्दनः ..
पिता पितामहो देव स्वेन पालय सर्वदा .. 44 ..
16.83.m: Your asterism is Kṛttikā, your guru is Lord Maheśvara, / gold is your body, your creator is the god Janārdana, / your father is the grandfather [Brahmā]; O lord, protect [us] always by your own power.”

16.83.s:
.. iti khaḍgamantraḥ .. ..
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhinā taṃ khaṅgaṃ brāhmaṇottamaiḥ ..
bhrāmayennagare rātrau nāndīghoṣapuraḥsaram .. 45 ..
16.83.d:
.. इति खड्गमन्त्रः .. ..
एवं संपूज्य विधिना तं खङ्गं ब्राह्मणोत्तमैः ..
भ्रामयेन्नगरे रात्रौ नान्दीघोषपुरःसरम् .. 45 ..
16.83.m: — Thus is the sword mantra. — / Having thus worshipped that sword according to rule through the best of brahmins, / one should carry it around the city at night accompanied by sounds of auspicious celebration,

16.83.s:
sarvasainyena saṃyuktastatra brāhmaṇapuṃgavaiḥ ..
evaṃ kṛtvā vidhānaṃ tu punaryogeśvarīṃ nayet ..
uccārya mantramevaṃ vai khaṅgaṃ tasyai samarpayet .. 46 ..
16.83.d:
सर्वसैन्येन संयुक्तस्तत्र ब्राह्मणपुंगवैः ..
एवं कृत्वा विधानं तु पुनर्योगेश्वरीं नयेत् ..
उच्चार्य मन्त्रमेवं वै खङ्गं तस्यै समर्पयेत् .. 46 ..
16.83.m: accompanied by the entire army and by the foremost brahmins there. / Having thus performed the ritual, he should bring it back to Yogeśvarī; / uttering this mantra, he should dedicate the sword to her.

16.83.s:
añjanena samālekhya candanena vilepitam ..
bilvapatrakṛtāṃ mālāṃ tasyai devyai nivedayet .. 47 ..
16.83.d:
अञ्जनेन समालेख्य चन्दनेन विलेपितम् ..
बिल्वपत्रकृतां मालां तस्यै देव्यै निवेदयेत् .. 47 ..
16.83.m: Having inscribed it with collyrium and smeared it with sandalwood paste, / he should offer a garland made of bilva leaves to that goddess:

16.83.s:
durge durgārtihe devi sarva durgatināśini ..
trāhi māṃ sarvadurgeṣu durge'haṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ .. 48 ..
16.83.d:
दुर्गे दुर्गार्तिहे देवि सर्व दुर्गतिनाशिनि ..
त्राहि मां सर्वदुर्गेषु दुर्गेऽहं शरणं गतः .. 48 ..
16.83.m: “O Durgā, O goddess who removest distress in difficulties, O destroyer of all misfortune, / protect me in all perils; O Durgā, I have taken refuge in you.”

16.83.s:
dattvaivamarghyaṃ deveśi tatra khaṅgaṃ ca jāgṛyāt ..
nityaṃ saṃpūjya vidhinā aṣṭamyāṃ yāvadeva hi .. 49 ..
16.83.d:
दत्त्वैवमर्घ्यं देवेशि तत्र खङ्गं च जागृयात् ..
नित्यं संपूज्य विधिना अष्टम्यां यावदेव हि .. 49 ..
16.83.m: Having thus offered the guest-water, O ruler of the gods, he should keep vigil over the sword there, / worshipping it daily according to rule, precisely until the eighth day.

16.83.s:
tadrātrau jāgaraṃ kṛtvā prabhāte hyaruṇodaye ..
pātayenmahiṣānmeṣānagrato gatakaṃdharān .. 7.1.83.50 ..
16.83.d:
तद्रात्रौ जागरं कृत्वा प्रभाते ह्यरुणोदये ..
पातयेन्महिषान्मेषानग्रतो गतकंधरान् .. 7.1.83.50 ..
16.83.m: Having kept vigil that night, at dawn when the reddish glow rises, / he should cause buffaloes and sheep to be struck down with severed necks before her,

16.83.s:
śatamardhaśataṃ vāpi tadardhārdhaṃ yathecchayā ..
surāsavabhṛtaiḥ kuṃbhaistarpayetparameśvarīm .. 51 ..
16.83.d:
शतमर्धशतं वापि तदर्धार्धं यथेच्छया ..
सुरासवभृतैः कुंभैस्तर्पयेत्परमेश्वरीम् .. 51 ..
16.83.m: a hundred, or fifty, or half of half of that, according to his wish. / With jars filled with spirituous liquor, he should gratify the Supreme Goddess.

16.83.s:
kāpālikebhyastaddeyaṃ dāsīdāsajane tathā ..
tato'parāhnasamaye navamyāṃ syandane sthitām .. 52 ..
16.83.d:
कापालिकेभ्यस्तद्देयं दासीदासजने तथा ..
ततोऽपराह्नसमये नवम्यां स्यन्दने स्थिताम् .. 52 ..
16.83.m: That should be given to the Kāpālikas and also to the male and female servant folk. / Then, in the afternoon of the ninth day,

16.83.s:
yogeśīṃ bhrāmayedrāṣṭre svayaṃ rājā svasainyavān ..
nadadbhiḥ śaṃkhapaṭahaiḥ paṭhadbhirbaṭucāraṇaiḥ .. 53 ..
16.83.d:
योगेशीं भ्रामयेद्राष्ट्रे स्वयं राजा स्वसैन्यवान् ..
नदद्भिः शंखपटहैः पठद्भिर्बटुचारणैः .. 53 ..
16.83.m: the king himself, accompanied by his army, should parade Yogeśī mounted on a chariot through the realm, / with conches and kettle-drums sounding, and young students and bards reciting.

16.83.s:
bhūtebhyaśca baliṃ dadyānmaṃtreṇānena bhāmini ..
saraktaṃ sajalaṃ sānnaṃ gandhapuṣpākṣatairyutam .. 54 ..
16.83.d:
भूतेभ्यश्च बलिं दद्यान्मंत्रेणानेन भामिनि ..
सरक्तं सजलं सान्नं गन्धपुष्पाक्षतैर्युतम् .. 54 ..
16.83.m: And he should offer an oblation to the spirits with this mantra, O lovely lady, / mixed with blood, mixed with water, with cooked food, and accompanied by perfumes, flowers, and unhusked barley-grains.

16.83.s:
trīnvārām̐stu triśūlena digvidikṣu kṣipedbalim ..
baliṃ gṛhṇantvime devā ādityā vasavastathā .. 55 ..
16.83.d:
त्रीन्वाराम्̐स्तु त्रिशूलेन दिग्विदिक्षु क्षिपेद्बलिम् ..
बलिं गृह्णन्त्विमे देवा आदित्या वसवस्तथा .. 55 ..
16.83.m: Three times with a trident he should cast the oblation into the cardinal and intermediate directions: / “May these gods—the Ādityas and the Vasus,

16.83.s:
maruto'thāśvinau rudrāḥ suparṇāḥ pannagā grahāḥ ..
saumyā bhavaṃtu tṛptāśca bhūtāḥ pretāḥ sukhāvahāḥ .. 56 ..
16.83.d:
मरुतोऽथाश्विनौ रुद्राः सुपर्णाः पन्नगा ग्रहाः ..
सौम्या भवंतु तृप्ताश्च भूताः प्रेताः सुखावहाः .. 56 ..
16.83.m: the Maruts, the two Aśvins, the Rudras, the birds, the serpents, and the planets—receive the oblation; / may they be propitious and satisfied, and may the spirits and ghosts bring happiness.”

16.83.s:
ya evaṃ kurvate yātrāṃ brāhmaṇāḥ kṣetravāsinaḥ ..
na teṣāṃ śatravo nāgnirna caurā na vināyakāḥ ..
vighnaṃ kurvaṃti deveśi yogeśvaryāḥ prasādataḥ .. 57 ..
16.83.d:
य एवं कुर्वते यात्रां ब्राह्मणाः क्षेत्रवासिनः ..
न तेषां शत्रवो नाग्निर्न चौरा न विनायकाः ..
विघ्नं कुर्वंति देवेशि योगेश्वर्याः प्रसादतः .. 57 ..
16.83.m: The brahmins living in the sacred field who perform the festival journey in this manner— / neither enemies, nor fire, nor thieves, nor Vināyakas / cause obstacles for them, O ruler of the gods, by the grace of Yogeśvarī.

16.83.s:
sukhino bhogabhoktāraḥ sarvātaṃkavivarjitāḥ ..
bhavanti puruṣā bhaktā yogeśvaryā niraṃtaram .. 58 ..
16.83.d:
सुखिनो भोगभोक्तारः सर्वातंकविवर्जिताः ..
भवन्ति पुरुषा भक्ता योगेश्वर्या निरंतरम् .. 58 ..
16.83.m: Happy, enjoyers of delights, and freed from all afflictions / are those men who are constantly devoted to Yogeśvarī.

16.83.s:
ityeṣa te samākhyāto yogeśvaryā mahotsavaḥ ..
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva sarvāśubhavināśanaḥ .. 59 ..
16.83.d:
इत्येष ते समाख्यातो योगेश्वर्या महोत्सवः ..
पठतां शृण्वतां चैव सर्वाशुभविनाशनः .. 59 ..
16.83.m: Thus has this great festival of Yogeśvarī been related to you, / which destroys all inauspiciousness for those who recite or hear it.

16.83.s:
śūlāgrabhinnamahiṣāsurapṛṣṭhapīṭhāmutkhātakhaḍga rucirāṃgadabāhudaṃḍām ..
abhyarcya paṃcavadanānugataṃ navamyāṃ durgāṃ sudurgagahanāni taraṃti martyāḥ .. 7.1.83.60 ..
16.83.d:
शूलाग्रभिन्नमहिषासुरपृष्ठपीठामुत्खातखड्ग रुचिरांगदबाहुदंडाम् ..
अभ्यर्च्य पंचवदनानुगतं नवम्यां दुर्गां सुदुर्गगहनानि तरंति मर्त्याः .. 7.1.83.60 ..
16.83.m: Having worshipped on the ninth day Durgā, who makes the back of the buffalo demon pierced by her spear-tip her pedestal, whose staff-like arms are adorned with beautiful armlets brandishing a sword, attended by the five-faced [Śiva], mortals cross over extremely impassable wildernesses.

16.83.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye yogeśvarīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 83 ..
16.83.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये योगेश्वरीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्र्यशीतितमोऽध्यायः .. 83 ..
16.83.m: Thus ends the eighty-third chapter, entitled “Description of the Greatness of Yogeśvarī,” in the first [part], the Greatness of the Prabhāsa Sacred Field, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.84.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi ādinārāyaṇaṃ harim ..
tasyāśca pūrvadigbhāge sarvapātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.84.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि आदिनारायणं हरिम् ..
तस्याश्च पूर्वदिग्भागे सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.84.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to Hari, Ādinārāyaṇa, / on the eastern side of her, who destroys all sins,

16.84.s:
pādukāsanasaṃyuktaṃ sarvadaityāṃtakāriṇam ..
ādau kṛtayuge devi daityo'bhūnmeghavāhanaḥ .. 2 ..
16.84.d:
पादुकासनसंयुक्तं सर्वदैत्यांतकारिणम् ..
आदौ कृतयुगे देवि दैत्योऽभून्मेघवाहनः .. 2 ..
16.84.m: endowed with a pedestal of sandals, the destroyer of all demons. / Formerly, in the Kṛta age, O goddess, there was a demon named Meghavāhana,

16.84.s:
mahābalo mahākāyo yojanāyutavistaraḥ ..
ajeyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ trailokyakṣayakārakaḥ ..
brahmaṇā tasya tuṣṭena varo datto varānane .. 3 ..
16.84.d:
महाबलो महाकायो योजनायुतविस्तरः ..
अजेयः सर्वदेवानां त्रैलोक्यक्षयकारकः ..
ब्रह्मणा तस्य तुष्टेन वरो दत्तो वरानने .. 3 ..
16.84.m: of great strength, of immense body, ten thousand yojanas in extent, / invincible to all the gods, causing the destruction of the three worlds. / A boon was given to him by Brahmā when he was pleased, O fair-faced lady:

16.84.s:
yadā pādukayā viṣṇustvāṃ haniṣyati saṃyuge ..
tadaiva mṛtyurbhavitā nānyathā maraṇaṃ tava .. 4 ..
16.84.d:
यदा पादुकया विष्णुस्त्वां हनिष्यति संयुगे ..
तदैव मृत्युर्भविता नान्यथा मरणं तव .. 4 ..
16.84.m: “When Viṣṇu slays you in battle with a sandal, / only then will your death occur; otherwise there is no death for you.”

16.84.s:
iti labdhavaro daityaḥ saṃtāpayati bhūtalam ..
yugānāṃ koṭimekāṃ tu sadevāsuramānuṣam .. 5 ..
16.84.d:
इति लब्धवरो दैत्यः संतापयति भूतलम् ..
युगानां कोटिमेकां तु सदेवासुरमानुषम् .. 5 ..
16.84.m: Having obtained this boon, the demon tormented the earth / for one crore of yugas, together with gods, asuras, and humans.

16.84.s:
saṃtapya bahudhā devi dakṣiṇo dadhimāgataḥ ..
tatra vidhvaṃsayāmāsa ṛṣīṇāmāśramāṇi vai .. 6 ..
16.84.d:
संतप्य बहुधा देवि दक्षिणो दधिमागतः ..
तत्र विध्वंसयामास ऋषीणामाश्रमाणि वै .. 6 ..
16.84.m: Having tormented [them] in many ways, O goddess, he went to the southern ocean; / there he destroyed the hermitages of the seers.

16.84.s:
tatasta ṛṣayaḥ sarve vidhvastāśramamaṇḍalāḥ ..
śaraṇaṃ caiva saṃprāptā devadevaṃ tu keśavam ..
ajeyaṃ taṃ tu saṃjñātvā tuṣṭuvurgaruḍadhvajam .. 7 ..
16.84.d:
ततस्त ऋषयः सर्वे विध्वस्ताश्रममण्डलाः ..
शरणं चैव संप्राप्ता देवदेवं तु केशवम् ..
अजेयं तं तु संज्ञात्वा तुष्टुवुर्गरुडध्वजम् .. 7 ..
16.84.m: Then all those seers, whose circle of hermitages had been destroyed, / took refuge in Keśava, the god of gods; / knowing him to be invincible, they praised the god whose banner bears Garuḍa.

16.84.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ..
namaḥ paramakalyāṇakalyāṇāyātmayogine ..
janārddanāya devāya śrīdharāya ca vedhase .. 8 ..
16.84.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः ..
नमः परमकल्याणकल्याणायात्मयोगिने ..
जनार्द्दनाय देवाय श्रीधराय च वेधसे .. 8 ..
16.84.m: The seers said: / “Salutations to the yogin of the self, who is supreme auspiciousness and good fortune, / to the god Janārdana, the bearer of Śrī, and the Creator.

16.84.s:
namaḥ kamalakiṃjalkasuvarṇamukuṭāya ca ..
keśavāyātisūkṣmāya bṛhanmūrte namonamaḥ .. 9 ..
16.84.d:
नमः कमलकिंजल्कसुवर्णमुकुटाय च ..
केशवायातिसूक्ष्माय बृहन्मूर्ते नमोनमः .. 9 ..
16.84.m: Salutations to him who wears a golden crown like the filament of a lotus, / to Keśava, who is exceedingly subtle; salutations, salutations to him of vast form!

16.84.s:
mahātmane vareṇyāya namaḥ paṃkajanābhaye ..
namo'stu māyāharaye haraye harivedhase .. 7.1.84.10 ..
16.84.d:
महात्मने वरेण्याय नमः पंकजनाभये ..
नमोऽस्तु मायाहरये हरये हरिवेधसे .. 7.1.84.10 ..
16.84.m: To the Great Soul, the most excellent, salutations to the lotus-naveled one! / Homage be to Hari, the remover of illusion, to Hari, the creator of Hari!

16.84.s:
hiraṇyagarbhagarbhāya jagataḥ kāraṇātmane ..
acyutāya namo nityamanantāya namonamaḥ .. 11 ..
16.84.d:
हिरण्यगर्भगर्भाय जगतः कारणात्मने ..
अच्युताय नमो नित्यमनन्ताय नमोनमः .. 11 ..
16.84.m: To him whose womb is Hiraṇyagarbha, the soul that is the cause of the universe, / to Acyuta be homage, to the eternal, to Ananta, salutations, salutations!

16.84.s:
namo māyāpaṭacchanna jagaddhātre mahātmane ..
saṃsārasāgarottāra jñānapotapradāyine ..
akuṃṭhamataye dhātre sargasthityaṃta karmaṇe .. 12 ..
16.84.d:
