नमो मायापटच्छन्न जगद्धात्रे महात्मने ..
संसारसागरोत्तार ज्ञानपोतप्रदायिने ..
अकुंठमतये धात्रे सर्गस्थित्यंत कर्मणे .. 12 ..
16.84.m: Salutations to the Great Soul, the sustainer of the world veiled by the mantle of illusion, / the bestower of the boat of knowledge for crossing over the ocean of saṃsāra, / of unimpeded intellect, the creator whose deeds are the emission, maintenance, and end [of the world].

16.84.s:
yathā hi vāsudeveti prokte naśyati pātakam ..
tathā vilayamabhyetu daityo'yaṃ meghavāhanaḥ .. 13 ..
16.84.d:
यथा हि वासुदेवेति प्रोक्ते नश्यति पातकम् ..
तथा विलयमभ्येतु दैत्योऽयं मेघवाहनः .. 13 ..
16.84.m: Just as sin is destroyed when the name ‘Vāsudeva’ is uttered, / so may this demon Meghavāhana perish!

16.84.s:
yathā viṣṇuḥ svabhakteṣu pāpamāpnoti saṃsthitam..
tathā vināśamāyātu daityo'yaṃ pāpakarmakṛt .. 14 ..
16.84.d:
यथा विष्णुः स्वभक्तेषु पापमाप्नोति संस्थितम्..
तथा विनाशमायातु दैत्योऽयं पापकर्मकृत् .. 14 ..
16.84.m: Just as Viṣṇu removes the sin abiding in his devotees, / so may this evil-doing demon meet destruction!”

16.84.s:
smṛtamātro yathā viṣṇuḥ sarvaṃ pāpaṃ vyapohati ..
tathā praṇāśamabhyetu daityo'yaṃ meghavāhanaḥ .. 15 ..
16.84.d:
स्मृतमात्रो यथा विष्णुः सर्वं पापं व्यपोहति ..
तथा प्रणाशमभ्येतु दैत्योऽयं मेघवाहनः .. 15 ..
16.84.m: Just as Viṣṇu, the moment he is remembered, removes all sin, / so may this demon Meghavāhana meet with destruction! 15

16.84.s:
bhavaṃtu bhadrāṇi samastadoṣāḥ prayāṃtu nāśaṃ jagato'khilasya ..
abhedyabhaktyā parameśvareśe smṛte jagaddhātari vāsudeve .. 16 ..
16.84.d:
भवंतु भद्राणि समस्तदोषाः प्रयांतु नाशं जगतोऽखिलस्य ..
अभेद्यभक्त्या परमेश्वरेशे स्मृते जगद्धातरि वासुदेवे .. 16 ..
16.84.m: May blessings arise! May all evils of the whole world perish / when Vāsudeva, the Lord of the Supreme Lord and creator of the world, is remembered with undivided devotion! 16

16.84.s:
ye bhūtale ye divi ye'ntarikṣe rasātale prāṇigaṇāśca kecit ..
bhavantu te siddhiyutā narottamāḥ smṛte jagaddhātari vāsudeve .. 17 ..
16.84.d:
ये भूतले ये दिवि येऽन्तरिक्षे रसातले प्राणिगणाश्च केचित् ..
भवन्तु ते सिद्धियुता नरोत्तमाः स्मृते जगद्धातरि वासुदेवे .. 17 ..
16.84.m: Whatever multitudes of living beings are on the surface of the earth, in heaven, in the intermediate space, or in the underworld, / may they, best among men, attain success when Vāsudeva, the creator of the world, is remembered! 17

16.84.s:
ye prāṇinaḥ kutracidatra saṃti brahmāṇḍamadhye parataśca kecit ..
teṣāṃ tu siddhiḥ paramāstvaniṃdyā stute jagaddhātari vāsudeve .. 18 ..
16.84.d:
ये प्राणिनः कुत्रचिदत्र संति ब्रह्माण्डमध्ये परतश्च केचित् ..
तेषां तु सिद्धिः परमास्त्वनिंद्या स्तुते जगद्धातरि वासुदेवे .. 18 ..
16.84.m: Whatever living creatures exist anywhere here within the cosmic egg or beyond it, / may supreme and faultless perfection be theirs when Vāsudeva, the creator of the world, is praised! 18

16.84.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ].
iti stutastadā devi ādinārāyaṇo hariḥ ..
jñātvā sa bhāvi kāryaṃ tatsamāruhya ca pādukām .. 19 ..
16.84.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ].
इति स्तुतस्तदा देवि आदिनारायणो हरिः ..
ज्ञात्वा स भावि कार्यं तत्समारुह्य च पादुकाम् .. 19 ..
16.84.m: Īśvara said: / Thus praised then, O goddess, Hari, the primeval Nārāyaṇa, / knowing that matter which was to be accomplished and mounting his wooden sandal, 19

16.84.s:
babhūva teṣāṃ pratyakṣa ṛṣīṇāṃ pāpanāśanaḥ ..
uvāca praṇatānsarvānkiṃ vā kāryaṃ hṛdi sthitam .. 7.1.84.20 ..
16.84.d:
बभूव तेषां प्रत्यक्ष ऋषीणां पापनाशनः ..
उवाच प्रणतान्सर्वान्किं वा कार्यं हृदि स्थितम् .. 7.1.84.20 ..
16.84.m: the destroyer of sins became visible before the eyes of those seers. / He said to all those who bowed low: “What matter resides in your hearts? 20

16.84.s: kathyatāṃ tatkariṣyāmi yuṣmatstotreṇa tarpitaḥ .. 21 ..
16.84.d: कथ्यतां तत्करिष्यामि युष्मत्स्तोत्रेण तर्पितः .. 21 ..
16.84.m: Let it be told; I shall do it, pleased by your hymn of praise.” 21

16.84.s:
ityuktā ṛṣayaḥ sarve kṛtāṃjalipuṭāḥ sthitāḥ ..
ādidevaṃ hariṃ procuḥ sarve nataśirodharāḥ .. 22 ..
16.84.d:
इत्युक्ता ऋषयः सर्वे कृतांजलिपुटाः स्थिताः ..
आदिदेवं हरिं प्रोचुः सर्वे नतशिरोधराः .. 22 ..
16.84.m: Thus addressed, all the seers, standing with folded hands, / with bowed heads spoke to Hari, the primeval god: 22

16.84.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
jānāsi sarvaṃ tvaṃ deva na cāstyaviditaṃ tava ..
imaṃ daityaṃ mahādeva saṃharasva mahābalam..
yathedaṃ sakalaṃ viśvaṃ nirātaṃkaṃ bhavetprabho .. 23 ..
16.84.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
जानासि सर्वं त्वं देव न चास्त्यविदितं तव ..
इमं दैत्यं महादेव संहरस्व महाबलम्..
यथेदं सकलं विश्वं निरातंकं भवेत्प्रभो .. 23 ..
16.84.m: The seers said: / “You know all, O God, and nothing is unknown to you. / Slay this immensely powerful demon, O Mahādeva, / so that this entire universe may be free from fear, O Lord!” 23

16.84.s:
ityuktastaistadā viṣṇurdaityamāhūya saṃyuge ..
tāḍayāmāsa taṃ daityaṃ hṛdi pādukayā śubhe..24..
16.84.d:
इत्युक्तस्तैस्तदा विष्णुर्दैत्यमाहूय संयुगे ..
ताडयामास तं दैत्यं हृदि पादुकया शुभे..24..
16.84.m: Thus addressed by them, Viṣṇu then challenged the demon to battle, / and struck that demon in the chest with his wooden sandal, O fair one. 24

16.84.s:
sa hataḥ patito daityo vigatāsurmahodadhau..
hatvā daityavaraṃ devastatra sthāne sthito'bhavat..
pādukāsanasaṃsthastu tatrādyāpi varānane .. 25 ..
16.84.d:
स हतः पतितो दैत्यो विगतासुर्महोदधौ..
हत्वा दैत्यवरं देवस्तत्र स्थाने स्थितोऽभवत्..
पादुकासनसंस्थस्तु तत्राद्यापि वरानने .. 25 ..
16.84.m: Struck down, the demon fell dead into the great ocean. / Having slain the foremost of demons, the god took up his abode in that place, / seated on the sandal-throne, even to this day, O fair-faced goddess. 25

16.84.s:
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā ekādaśyāṃ narottamaḥ ..
sośvavamedhaphalaṃ prāpya modate divi devavat .. 26 ..
16.84.d:
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या एकादश्यां नरोत्तमः ..
सोश्ववमेधफलं प्राप्य मोदते दिवि देववत् .. 26 ..
16.84.m: Whatever best of men worships him with devotion on the eleventh day, / attains the fruit of an Aśvamedha sacrifice and rejoices in heaven like a god. 26

16.84.s:
golakṣaṃ brāhmaṇe dattvā yatphalaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ ..
tadādideve govinde dṛṣṭe bhaktyā phalaṃ labhet .. 27 ..
16.84.d:
गोलक्षं ब्राह्मणे दत्त्वा यत्फलं प्राप्नुयान्नरः ..
तदादिदेवे गोविन्दे दृष्टे भक्त्या फलं लभेत् .. 27 ..
16.84.m: The fruit a man obtains by giving a hundred thousand cows to a brahmin, / that very fruit he obtains upon beholding Govinda, the primeval god, with devotion. 27

16.84.s:
kalau kṛtayugaṃ teṣāṃ kleśasteṣāṃ sukhādhikaḥ ..
ādinārāyaṇo devo yeṣāṃ hṛdayasaṃsthitaḥ .. 28..
16.84.d:
कलौ कृतयुगं तेषां क्लेशस्तेषां सुखाधिकः ..
आदिनारायणो देवो येषां हृदयसंस्थितः .. 28..
16.84.m: For those in whose heart the divine primeval Nārāyaṇa resides, / the Kali age is the Kṛta age, and their distress is greater than happiness. 28

16.84.s:
ekādaśyāṃ ravidine snātvā saṃnihitā jale ..
ādinārāyaṇaṃ pūjya mucyate bhavabandhanāt ..29..
16.84.d:
एकादश्यां रविदिने स्नात्वा संनिहिता जले ..
आदिनारायणं पूज्य मुच्यते भवबन्धनात् ..29..
16.84.m: Having bathed in the waters of the Saṃnihitā on a Sunday that is the eleventh day, / and having worshipped the primeval Nārāyaṇa, one is released from the bondage of worldly existence. 29

16.84.s:
iti te kathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ viṣṇudaivatam ..
śrutaṃ pāpaharaṃ nṛṇāṃ dāridyaughavināśanam .. 7.1.84.30 ..
16.84.d:
इति ते कथितं देवि माहात्म्यं विष्णुदैवतम् ..
श्रुतं पापहरं नृणां दारिद्यौघविनाशनम् .. 7.1.84.30 ..
16.84.m: Thus has the māhātmya pertaining to the deity Viṣṇu been told to you, O goddess. / Heard by men, it removes sins and destroys a multitude of miseries. 30

16.84.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ādinārāyaṇamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturaśītitamodhyāyaḥ .. 84 ..
16.84.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य आदिनारायणमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुरशीतितमोध्यायः .. 84 ..
16.84.m: Thus ends the eighty-fourth chapter, entitled ‘Description of the Māhātmya of the Primeval Nārāyaṇa,’ in the first [sub-section], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. 84

16.85.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
tatra saṃnihitā proktā yā tvayā vṛṣabhadhvaja ..
kathaṃ deva samāyātā kurukṣetrānmahānadī ..
kiṃ prabhāvā tu sā proktā phalaṃ snānādikena kim .. .. 1 ..
16.85.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
तत्र संनिहिता प्रोक्ता या त्वया वृषभध्वज ..
कथं देव समायाता कुरुक्षेत्रान्महानदी ..
किं प्रभावा तु सा प्रोक्ता फलं स्नानादिकेन किम् .. .. 1 ..
16.85.m: The goddess said: / “The Saṃnihitā that was mentioned by you there, O bull-bannered Lord, / how did that great river arrive from Kurukṣetra, O god? / What power is attributed to it, and what is the fruit of ritual ablution and the like?” 1

16.85.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yatra saṃnihitā śubhā ..
pāpaghnī sarvajaṃtūnāṃ darśanātsparśanādapi .. 2 ..
16.85.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि यत्र संनिहिता शुभा ..
पापघ्नी सर्वजंतूनां दर्शनात्स्पर्शनादपि .. 2 ..
16.85.m: Īśvara said: / Hear, O goddess, I shall explain where the auspicious Saṃnihitā is situated, / which destroys the sins of all creatures merely by being seen and touched. 2

16.85.s:
ādinārāyaṇāddevi paścime dhanuṣāṃ traye ..
saṃsthitā sā mahādevī saridrūpā mahānadī .. 3 ..
16.85.d:
आदिनारायणाद्देवि पश्चिमे धनुषां त्रये ..
संस्थिता सा महादेवी सरिद्रूपा महानदी .. 3 ..
16.85.m: Three bow-lengths to the west of the primeval Nārāyaṇa, O goddess, / that great goddess stands, a great river in the form of a stream. 3

16.85.s:
kathayāmi samāsena tadutpattiṃ śṛṇu priye ..
jarāsaṃdhabhayāddevi viṣṇuḥ parijanaiḥ saha .. 4 ..
16.85.d:
कथयामि समासेन तदुत्पत्तिं शृणु प्रिये ..
जरासंधभयाद्देवि विष्णुः परिजनैः सह .. 4 ..
16.85.m: I shall relate its origin in brief; listen, O beloved: / Out of fear of Jarāsandha, O goddess, Viṣṇu together with his retinue, 4

16.85.s:
gṛhītvā yādavānsarvānbālavṛddhavaṇigjanān ..
sa śūnyāṃ mathurāṃ kṛtvā prabhāsaṃ samupāgataḥ .. 5 ..
16.85.d:
गृहीत्वा यादवान्सर्वान्बालवृद्धवणिग्जनान् ..
स शून्यां मथुरां कृत्वा प्रभासं समुपागतः .. 5 ..
16.85.m: taking all the Yādavas—children, old men, and merchant-folk— / made Mathurā desolate and came to Prabhāsa. 5

16.85.s:
samudraṃ prārthayāmāsa sthānaṃ saṃvāsahetave ..
etasminneva kāle tu devadevo divākaraḥ .. 6 ..
16.85.d:
समुद्रं प्रार्थयामास स्थानं संवासहेतवे ..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु देवदेवो दिवाकरः .. 6 ..
16.85.m: He requested a place from the ocean for the sake of dwelling. / At that very time, the sun, god of gods, 6

16.85.s:
saṃgrasto rāhuṇā devi parvakāle hyupasthite ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā yādavāḥ sarve viṣādaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ .. 7 ..
16.85.d:
संग्रस्तो राहुणा देवि पर्वकाले ह्युपस्थिते ..
तं दृष्ट्वा यादवाः सर्वे विषादं परमं गताः .. 7 ..
16.85.m: was seized by Rāhu, O goddess, when the time of the eclipse arrived. / Seeing that, all the Yādavas were plunged into great despair, 7

16.85.s:
aprāptāḥ saṃnihityāyāṃ tānuvāca janārddanaḥ ..
mā viṣādaṃ yaduśreṣṭhā vrajadhvaṃ mayi saṃsthite .. 8 ..
16.85.d:
अप्राप्ताः संनिहित्यायां तानुवाच जनार्द्दनः ..
मा विषादं यदुश्रेष्ठा व्रजध्वं मयि संस्थिते .. 8 ..
16.85.m: not having reached the Saṃnihitā. Janārdana said to them: / “Do not fall into despair, O best of the Yadus, while I am here! 8

16.85.s:
dṛśyatāṃ matprabhāvo'dya dharmā rthamiha bhūtale ..
ānayiṣyāmyahaṃ samyakpuṇyaṃ sāṃnihitaṃ saraḥ .. 9 ..
16.85.d:
दृश्यतां मत्प्रभावोऽद्य धर्मा र्थमिह भूतले ..
आनयिष्याम्यहं सम्यक्पुण्यं सांनिहितं सरः .. 9 ..
16.85.m: Behold my power today on this earth for the sake of dharma: / I shall bring here fully the holy Saṃnihita lake!” 9

16.85.s:
evamuktvā sa bhagavānsamādhistho babhūva ha ..
evaṃ saṃdhyāyatastasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ .. 7.1.85.10 ..
16.85.d:
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान्समाधिस्थो बभूव ह ..
एवं संध्यायतस्तस्य विष्णोरमिततेजसः .. 7.1.85.10 ..
16.85.m: Having spoken thus, the Lord entered into meditative absorption. / While Viṣṇu of immeasurable splendour was thus meditating, 10

16.85.s:
prādurbhūtā tatastasya vāridhārā'grataḥ śubhā ..
bibhedya dharaṇīpṛṣṭhaṃ snānārthaṃ cāsuradviṣaḥ .. 11 ..
16.85.d:
प्रादुर्भूता ततस्तस्य वारिधाराऽग्रतः शुभा ..
बिभेद्य धरणीपृष्ठं स्नानार्थं चासुरद्विषः .. 11 ..
16.85.m: an auspicious stream of water burst forth before him, / cleaving open the surface of the earth for the ritual ablution of the enemy of the Asuras. 11

16.85.s:
tata ste yādavāḥ sarve rāmasāṃbapurogamāḥ ..
cakruḥ snānaṃ mahādevi rāhugraste divākare .. 12 ..
16.85.d:
तत स्ते यादवाः सर्वे रामसांबपुरोगमाः ..
चक्रुः स्नानं महादेवि राहुग्रस्ते दिवाकरे .. 12 ..
16.85.m: Then all those Yādavas, led by Rāma and Sāmba, / performed their ritual ablution, O great goddess, while the sun was seized by Rāhu. 12

16.85.s:
prāptapuṇyā babhūvuste saṃnihityāsamudbhavam ..
kurukṣetrasya yātrāyāḥ prāpya samyakphalaṃ hi te .. 13 ..
16.85.d:
प्राप्तपुण्या बभूवुस्ते संनिहित्यासमुद्भवम् ..
कुरुक्षेत्रस्य यात्रायाः प्राप्य सम्यक्फलं हि ते .. 13 ..
16.85.m: They obtained the religious merit arising from the Saṃnihitā, / having truly obtained the full fruit of a pilgrimage to Kurukṣetra. 13

16.85.s:
evaṃ tatsamanuprāptaṃ puṇyaṃ sānnihitaṃ saraḥ ..
tatra snātvā mahādevi rāhugraste divākare ..
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyaśeṣataḥ .. 14 ..
16.85.d:
एवं तत्समनुप्राप्तं पुण्यं सान्निहितं सरः ..
तत्र स्नात्वा महादेवि राहुग्रस्ते दिवाकरे ..
अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यशेषतः .. 14 ..
16.85.m: In this way that holy Saṃnihita lake was obtained. / Having bathed there, O great goddess, while the sun is seized by Rāhu, / one obtains the entire fruit of the Agniṣṭoma sacrifice. 14

16.85.s:
yastatra bhojayedvipraṃ ṣaḍrasaṃ vidhipūrvakam ..
ekena bhojitenaiva koṭirbhavati bhojitā .. 15 ..
16.85.d:
यस्तत्र भोजयेद्विप्रं षड्रसं विधिपूर्वकम् ..
एकेन भोजितेनैव कोटिर्भवति भोजिता .. 15 ..
16.85.m: Whoever feeds a brahmin there with food of six flavours in according with the rules, / by feeding just one, ten million are fed. 15

16.85.s:
yastatra kārayeddhomaṃ saṃnihityāsamīpataḥ ..
ekaikāhutidānena koṭihomaphalaṃ labhet .. 16 ..
16.85.d:
यस्तत्र कारयेद्धोमं संनिहित्यासमीपतः ..
एकैकाहुतिदानेन कोटिहोमफलं लभेत् .. 16 ..
16.85.m: Whoever causes a fire sacrifice to be performed there near the Saṃnihitā, / by offering each single oblation, he obtains the fruit of ten million fire sacrifices. 16

16.85.s:
mantrajāpyaṃ tu kurute tatra sthāne sthito yadi ..
ekaikamaṃtrajāpyena koṭijāpyaphalaṃ labhet .. 17 ..
16.85.d:
मन्त्रजाप्यं तु कुरुते तत्र स्थाने स्थितो यदि ..
एकैकमंत्रजाप्येन कोटिजाप्यफलं लभेत् .. 17 ..
16.85.m: If, standing in that place, he undertakes the recitation of mantras, / by reciting each single mantra, he obtains the fruit of reciting ten million mantras. 17

16.85.s:
suvarṇadānaṃ dātavyaṃ tatra yātrāphalepsubhiḥ ..
snātvā saṃpūjanīyaśca ādidevo janārddanaḥ .. 18 ..
16.85.d:
सुवर्णदानं दातव्यं तत्र यात्राफलेप्सुभिः ..
स्नात्वा संपूजनीयश्च आदिदेवो जनार्द्दनः .. 18 ..
16.85.m: A gift of gold must be given there by those desiring the fruit of the pilgrimage; / and having bathed, Janārdana, the primeval god, must be worshipped. 18

16.85.s:
iti vai kathitaṃ samyakphalaṃ sāṃnihitaṃ tava ..
śrutaṃ pāpaharaṃ nṛṇāṃ samyakchraddhāvatāṃ priye .. 19 ...
16.85.d:
इति वै कथितं सम्यक्फलं सांनिहितं तव ..
श्रुतं पापहरं नृणां सम्यक्छ्रद्धावतां प्रिये .. 19 ...
16.85.m: Thus indeed the full fruit of the Saṃnihitā has been told to you. / Heard by men possessing true faith, O beloved, it removes sins. 19

16.85.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye saṃnihityāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 85 ..
16.85.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये संनिहित्यामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पंचाशीतितमोऽध्यायः .. 85 ..
16.85.m: Thus ends the eighty-fifth chapter, entitled ‘Description of the Māhātmya of the Saṃnihitā,’ in the first [sub-section], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. 85

16.86.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasyāstu dakṣiṇe bhāge sthitaṃ liṃgaṃ mahāprabham ..
pāṃḍaveśvaranāmāḍhyaṃ paṃcabhiḥ sthāpitaṃ kramāt .. 1 ..
16.86.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्यास्तु दक्षिणे भागे स्थितं लिंगं महाप्रभम् ..
पांडवेश्वरनामाढ्यं पंचभिः स्थापितं क्रमात् .. 1 ..
16.86.m: Īśvara said: / On its southern side stands a liṅga of great splendour, / rich in the name Pāṇḍaveśvara, installed in order by the five [Pāṇḍavas]. 1

16.86.s:
guptacaryāṃ yadā yātāḥ pāṃḍavā vanavāsinaḥ ..
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgatāḥ .. 2 ..
16.86.d:
गुप्तचर्यां यदा याताः पांडवा वनवासिनः ..
तीर्थयात्राप्रसंगेन प्रभासं क्षेत्रमागताः .. 2 ..
16.86.m: When the Pāṇḍavas, dwelling in the forest, went on their secret wanderings, / they came to the sacred field of Prabhāsa in the course of their pilgrimage. 2

16.86.s:
tasminkāle mahādevi saṃ prāpte somaparvaṇi ..
sthāpayāmāsuste sarve liṃgaṃ saṃnihitā taṭe .. 3 ..
16.86.d:
तस्मिन्काले महादेवि सं प्राप्ते सोमपर्वणि ..
स्थापयामासुस्ते सर्वे लिंगं संनिहिता तटे .. 3 ..
16.86.m: At that time, O great goddess, when a lunar eclipse had arrived, / they all installed the liṅga on the bank of the Saṃnihitā. 3

16.86.s:
mārkaṇḍapramukhānkṛtvā ṛtvijo brāhmaṇottamān ..
vedoktaiḥ kārayāmāsurabhiṣekaṃ vṛṣāndaduḥ .. 4 ..
16.86.d:
मार्कण्डप्रमुखान्कृत्वा ऋत्विजो ब्राह्मणोत्तमान् ..
वेदोक्तैः कारयामासुरभिषेकं वृषान्ददुः .. 4 ..
16.86.m: Having appointed the best brahmins, headed by Mārkaṇḍeya, as officiating priests, / they had the ritual bath performed according to the Vedic rites and gave bulls. // 4

16.86.s:
tataḥ prasannā ṛṣayo mārkaṃḍapramukhāḥ priye ..
pratiṣṭhitasya liṃgasya pāṃḍavairvaravarṇini .. 5 ..
16.86.d:
ततः प्रसन्ना ऋषयो मार्कंडप्रमुखाः प्रिये ..
प्रतिष्ठितस्य लिंगस्य पांडवैर्वरवर्णिनि .. 5 ..
16.86.m: Then the seers headed by Mārkaṇḍeya were pleased, O beloved one of fair complexion, / with the liṅga installed by the Pāṇḍavas. // 5

16.86.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
ye caitatpūjayiṣyaṃti liṃgaṃ pāṃḍavapūjitam ..
te vai pūjyā bhaviṣyaṃti devadānavarakṣasām .. 6 ..
16.86.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
ये चैतत्पूजयिष्यंति लिंगं पांडवपूजितम् ..
ते वै पूज्या भविष्यंति देवदानवरक्षसाम् .. 6 ..
16.86.m: The seers said: / Whoever will worship this liṅga worshipped by the Pāṇḍavas / will indeed be worthy of worship by gods, Dānavas, and Rākṣasas. // 6

16.86.s:
aśvamedhaphalaṃ teṣāṃ samyakchraddhārcanena vai ..
bhaviṣyati na saṃdeho hyasmadvākyaprabhāvataḥ .. 7 ..
16.86.d:
अश्वमेधफलं तेषां सम्यक्छ्रद्धार्चनेन वै ..
भविष्यति न संदेहो ह्यस्मद्वाक्यप्रभावतः .. 7 ..
16.86.m: By worshipping with complete faith, the fruit of a horse-sacrifice will indeed be theirs; / there is no doubt, by the power of our word. // 7

16.86.s:
snātvā saṃnihitākuṃḍe yo'rcayetpāṃḍaveśvaram ..
māghe māsi samagre tu sa sākṣātpuruṣottamaḥ .. 8 ..
16.86.d:
स्नात्वा संनिहिताकुंडे योऽर्चयेत्पांडवेश्वरम् ..
माघे मासि समग्रे तु स साक्षात्पुरुषोत्तमः .. 8 ..
16.86.m: Having bathed in the Saṃnihitā pool, whoever worships Pāṇḍaveśvara / throughout the entire month of Māgha is Puruṣottama directly manifest. // 8

16.86.s:
darśanenāpi tasyāpi pāpaṃ yāti sahasradhā ..
viṣṇurūpo hi sa prokto nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 9..
16.86.d:
दर्शनेनापि तस्यापि पापं याति सहस्रधा ..
विष्णुरूपो हि स प्रोक्तो नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 9..
16.86.m: Even by seeing him, sin is dispersed a thousandfold; / indeed, he is declared to have the form of Viṣṇu, no doubt should be entertained on this. // 9

16.86.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye saṃnihityāmāhātmye pāṃḍaveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 86 ..
16.86.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये संनिहित्यामाहात्म्ये पांडवेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षडशीतितमोऽध्यायः .. 86 ..
16.86.m: Thus ends the eighty-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Pāṇḍaveśvara' in the Glory of Saṃnihitā, within the first [part], the Glory of Prabhāsa Sacred Field, of the seventh section, Prabhāsa Section, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. // 86

16.87.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evaṃ kṛtvā naro yātrāṃ samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
tato gacchenmahādevi rudrānekādaśa kramāt .. 1 ..
16.87.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एवं कृत्वा नरो यात्रां सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि रुद्रानेकादश क्रमात् .. 1 ..
16.87.m: Īśvara said: / Having completed the pilgrimage thus, endowed with complete faith, / a man should then proceed, O great goddess, to the eleven Rudras in order, // 1

16.87.s:
prabhāsakṣetramadhyasthānmahāpātakanāśanān ..
yadekādaśadhā pāpamarjitaṃ manujaiḥ pṛthak .. 2 ..
16.87.d:
प्रभासक्षेत्रमध्यस्थान्महापातकनाशनान् ..
यदेकादशधा पापमर्जितं मनुजैः पृथक् .. 2 ..
16.87.m: situated within the Prabhāsa sacred field, the destroyers of great sins. / The sin that has been accumulated separately by human beings in eleven ways, // 2

16.87.s:
tadekādaśarudrāṇāṃ pūjanātkṣayameṣyati ..
saṃkrāṃtāvayane vāpi caṃdrasūryagrahe'thavā .. 3 ..
16.87.d:
तदेकादशरुद्राणां पूजनात्क्षयमेष्यति ..
संक्रांतावयने वापि चंद्रसूर्यग्रहेऽथवा .. 3 ..
16.87.m: will go to destruction by the worship of the eleven Rudras. / On a solstitial transit, a solstice, or an eclipse of the moon or sun, // 3

16.87.s:
anyāsu puṇyatithiṣu samyagbhāvena bhāvitaḥ ..
pūjayedānupūrvyeṇa rudraikādaśakaṃ kramāt .. 4 ..
16.87.d:
अन्यासु पुण्यतिथिषु सम्यग्भावेन भावितः ..
पूजयेदानुपूर्व्येण रुद्रैकादशकं क्रमात् .. 4 ..
16.87.m: or on other meritorious lunar days, inspired with right disposition, / he should worship the group of eleven Rudras in proper succession, step by step. // 4

16.87.s:
teṣāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi yānyatītāni me purā ..
ādye kṛtayuge tāni śṛṇu devi yathārthataḥ .. 5 ..
16.87.d:
तेषां नामानि वक्ष्यामि यान्यतीतानि मे पुरा ..
आद्ये कृतयुगे तानि शृणु देवि यथार्थतः .. 5 ..
16.87.m: I shall proclaim their names which were mine in the past; / listen to them as they truly are in the first era, the Kṛta age, O goddess: // 5

16.87.s:
ajaikapādahirbudhnyo virūpākṣo'tha raivataḥ ..
haraśca bahurūpaśca tryaṃbakaśca sureśvaraḥ ..
vṛṣākapiśca śaṃbhuśca kapardī cāparājitaḥ .. 6 ..
16.87.d:
अजैकपादहिर्बुध्न्यो विरूपाक्षोऽथ रैवतः ..
हरश्च बहुरूपश्च त्र्यंबकश्च सुरेश्वरः ..
वृषाकपिश्च शंभुश्च कपर्दी चापराजितः .. 6 ..
16.87.m: Ajaikapād, Ahirbudhnya, Virūpākṣa, then Raivata, / Hara, Bahurūpa, Tryambaka, Sureśvara, / Vṛṣākapi, Śambhu, Kapardin, and Aparājita. // 6

16.87.s:
ādau kṛtayuge devi tretāyāṃ dvāpare'pi ca ..
kalau yuge tu saṃprāpte jātaṃ nāmāṃtaraṃ punaḥ .. 7 ..
16.87.d:
आदौ कृतयुगे देवि त्रेतायां द्वापरेऽपि च ..
कलौ युगे तु संप्राप्ते जातं नामांतरं पुनः .. 7 ..
16.87.m: At first in the Kṛta age, O goddess, in Tretā, and also in Dvāpara; / but when the Kali age arrived, another set of names arose. // 7

16.87.s:
ekādaśadhā rudrāṇāṃ tāni te vacmi sāṃpratam..
bhūteśo nīlarudraśca kapālī vṛṣavāhanaḥ ..8..
16.87.d:
एकादशधा रुद्राणां तानि ते वच्मि सांप्रतम्..
भूतेशो नीलरुद्रश्च कपाली वृषवाहनः ..8..
16.87.m: I tell you now those elevenfold names of the Rudras: / Bhūteśa, Nīlarudra, Kapālin, Vṛṣavāhana, // 8

16.87.s:
tryaṃbako ghoranāmā ca mahākālo'tha bhairavaḥ ..
mṛtyuṃjayo'tha kāmeśo yogeśa iti kīrtitaḥ ..
ekādaśaite rudrāste kathitāḥ kramaśaḥ priye .. 9 ].
anādinidhanā devi bhedabhinnāstu te pṛthak ..
ekādaśasvarūpeṇa pṛthaṅnāmaprabhedataḥ .. 7.1.87.10 ..
16.87.d:
त्र्यंबको घोरनामा च महाकालोऽथ भैरवः ..
मृत्युंजयोऽथ कामेशो योगेश इति कीर्तितः ..
एकादशैते रुद्रास्ते कथिताः क्रमशः प्रिये .. 9 ].
अनादिनिधना देवि भेदभिन्नास्तु ते पृथक् ..
एकादशस्वरूपेण पृथङ्नामप्रभेदतः .. 7.1.87.10 ..
16.87.m: Tryambaka, he who is named Ghora, Mahākāla, then Bhairava, / Mṛtyuñjaya, then Kāmeśa, and he who is celebrated as Yogeśa. / These eleven Rudras have been spoken of to you in sequence, O beloved; // 9 // / without beginning or end, O goddess, they are distinguished separately / in the form of eleven [beings], divided by their distinct names. // 10

16.87.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
bhagavanvistarādbrūhi liṃgaikādaśakakramam ..
sthānasīmāprabhedena māhātmyotpattikāraṇaiḥ ..11 ..
16.87.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
भगवन्विस्तराद्ब्रूहि लिंगैकादशकक्रमम् ..
स्थानसीमाप्रभेदेन माहात्म्योत्पत्तिकारणैः ..11 ..
16.87.m: The goddess said: / O Lord, tell in detail the sequence of the eleven liṅgas, / according to the distinction of locations and boundaries, with the causes of the origin of their greatness. // 11

16.87.s:
kathaṃ pūjyāni tānīśa ke maṃtrāḥ ko vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ..
kasminparvaṇi kāle vā sarvaṃ vistarato vada .. 12 ..
16.87.d:
कथं पूज्यानि तानीश के मंत्राः को विधिः स्मृतः ..
कस्मिन्पर्वणि काले वा सर्वं विस्तरतो वद .. 12 ..
16.87.m: How are they to be worshipped, O Lord? What are the mantras? What is the prescribed ritual? / On what festive occasion or at what time? Tell everything in detail. // 12

16.87.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
somanāthāditaḥ kṛtvā siddhināthādikāraṇam.. 13 ..
16.87.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि रहस्यं पापनाशनम् ..
सोमनाथादितः कृत्वा सिद्धिनाथादिकारणम्.. 13 ..
16.87.m: Īśvara said: / Listen, O goddess, I shall proclaim the sin-destroying secret, / beginning from Somanātha, the origin of Siddhinātha and others, // 13

16.87.s:
yacchrutvā mucyate jaṃtuḥ pātakaiḥ pūrvasaṃcitaiḥ ..
ye caikādaśa rudrā vai tava proktā mayā priye .. 14 ..
16.87.d:
यच्छ्रुत्वा मुच्यते जंतुः पातकैः पूर्वसंचितैः ..
ये चैकादश रुद्रा वै तव प्रोक्ता मया प्रिये .. 14 ..
16.87.m: hearing which a living creature is freed from previously accumulated sins. / And the eleven Rudras who have indeed been declared to you, O beloved, // 14

16.87.s:
daśa te vāyavaḥ proktā ātmā caikādaśaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
teṣāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi vāyūnāṃ śṛṇu me kramāt.. 15 ..
16.87.d:
दश ते वायवः प्रोक्ता आत्मा चैकादशः स्मृतः ..
तेषां नामानि वक्ष्यामि वायूनां शृणु मे क्रमात्.. 15 ..
16.87.m: are declared as the ten vital airs, and the Ātman is held to be the eleventh. / I shall tell their names; hear from me the winds in order: // 15

16.87.s:
prāṇo'pānaḥ samānaśca hyudāno vyāna eva ca ..
nāgaśca kūrmaḥ kṛkalo devadatto dhanaṃjayaḥ.. 16 ..
16.87.d:
प्राणोऽपानः समानश्च ह्युदानो व्यान एव च ..
नागश्च कूर्मः कृकलो देवदत्तो धनंजयः.. 16 ..
16.87.m: prāṇa, apāna, samāna, udāna, and vyāna, / nāga, kūrma, kṛkala, devadatta, and dhanañjaya. // 16

16.87.s:
ātmā ceti kramājjñeyā rudrādhipatayaḥ kramāt ..
teṣāṃ yātrāṃ kramādvakṣye sarvaprāṇihitāya vai .. 17 ..
16.87.d:
आत्मा चेति क्रमाज्ज्ञेया रुद्राधिपतयः क्रमात् ..
तेषां यात्रां क्रमाद्वक्ष्ये सर्वप्राणिहिताय वै .. 17 ..
16.87.m: And the Ātman: thus are to be understood the presiding deities of the Rudras in order. / I shall describe their pilgrimage in sequence for the benefit of all living beings. // 17

16.87.s:
rudrāṇāmādidevo'sau pūrvaṃ someśvaraḥ priye ..
bhūteśvareti nāmnā vai pūjayettaṃ vidhānataḥ .. 18 ..
16.87.d:
रुद्राणामादिदेवोऽसौ पूर्वं सोमेश्वरः प्रिये ..
भूतेश्वरेति नाम्ना वै पूजयेत्तं विधानतः .. 18 ..
16.87.m: He who was previously the primal god among the Rudras, O beloved, Someśvara, / one should worship according to the prescribed rite under the name Bhūteśvara, // 18

16.87.s:
rājopacārayogena śraddhāpūtena cetasā ..
paṃcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya sadyojātena pūjayet .. 19 ..
16.87.d:
राजोपचारयोगेन श्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा ..
पंचामृतेन संस्नाप्य सद्योजातेन पूजयेत् .. 19 ..
16.87.m: employing royal services of homage, with a mind purified by faith. / Having bathed it ceremonially with the five nectars, he should worship it with the Sadyojāta mantra, // 19

16.87.s:
puṣpairmanoharairbhaktyā dhyātvā devaṃ sadāśivam ..
tribhiḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇipatya ca .. 7.1.87.20 ..
16.87.d:
पुष्पैर्मनोहरैर्भक्त्या ध्यात्वा देवं सदाशिवम् ..
त्रिभिः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य साष्टांगं प्रणिपत्य च .. 7.1.87.20 ..
16.87.m: with captivating flowers in devotion, having meditated upon the god Sadāśiva. / Circumambulating three times and bowing down with all eight limbs, // 20

16.87.s:
rudraikādaśayātrārthī nirvighnārthaṃ vrajettataḥ ..
bhūteśvareti yannāma proktaṃ tatte bravīmyaham.. 21 ..
16.87.d:
रुद्रैकादशयात्रार्थी निर्विघ्नार्थं व्रजेत्ततः ..
भूतेश्वरेति यन्नाम प्रोक्तं तत्ते ब्रवीम्यहम्.. 21 ..
16.87.m: the one desiring the pilgrimage of the eleven Rudras should then proceed, for the sake of freedom from obstacles. / The name Bhūteśvara which was mentioned—I explain that to you: // 21

16.87.s:
mahadādi viśeṣāṃtaṃ bhūtajālaṃ yadīritam ..
paṃcaviṃśati saṃkhyākaṃ teṣāmīśo yataḥ smṛtaḥ .. 22 ..
16.87.d:
महदादि विशेषांतं भूतजालं यदीरितम् ..
पंचविंशति संख्याकं तेषामीशो यतः स्मृतः .. 22 ..
16.87.m: The multitude of beings that has been proclaimed, beginning with the Mahat and ending with the gross elements, / numbering twenty-five: since he is held to be the Lord of those, // 22

16.87.s:
tena bhūteśvaretyuktaṃ nāma tasya purā kila ..
paṃcaviṃśatitattvāni jñātvā muktimavāpnuyāt .. 23 ..
16.87.d:
तेन भूतेश्वरेत्युक्तं नाम तस्य पुरा किल ..
पंचविंशतितत्त्वानि ज्ञात्वा मुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् .. 23 ..
16.87.m: therefore, his name was formerly stated to be Bhūteśvara. / Having known the twenty-five principles, one attains liberation; // 23

16.87.s:
bhūteśarudraṃ saṃpūjya gacchedvai muktimavyayām ..
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktamādi rudrasya kīrtanam..
kīrtanīyaṃ dvijātīnāṃ kīrtitaṃ puṇyavarddhanam.. 24 ..
16.87.d:
भूतेशरुद्रं संपूज्य गच्छेद्वै मुक्तिमव्ययाम् ..
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तमादि रुद्रस्य कीर्तनम्..
कीर्तनीयं द्विजातीनां कीर्तितं पुण्यवर्द्धनम्.. 24 ..
16.87.m: having worshipped the Rudra Bhūteśa, one will indeed attain imperishable liberation. / Thus the proclamation of the first Rudra has been declared in brief; / it is to be celebrated by the twice-born, and when celebrated it increases merit. // 24

16.87.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ekādaśarudramāhātmye bhūteśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 87 ..
16.87.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य एकादशरुद्रमाहात्म्ये भूतेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्ताशीतितमोऽध्यायः .. 87 ..
16.87.m: Thus ends the eighty-seventh chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Bhūteśvara' in the Glory of the Eleven Rudras, within the first [part], the Glory of Prabhāsa Sacred Field, of the seventh section, Prabhāsa Section, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. // 87

16.88.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi nīlarudraṃ dvitīyakam..
bhūteśāduttare bhāge dhanuṣāṃ ṣoḍaśe sthitam .. 1 ..
16.88.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि नीलरुद्रं द्वितीयकम्..
भूतेशादुत्तरे भागे धनुषां षोडशे स्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.88.m: Īśvara said: / Then he should proceed, O great goddess, to Nīlarudra, the second, / situated to the north of Bhūteśa at a distance of sixteen bows; // 1

16.88.s:
mahāliṃgaṃ mahādevi gaṇagaṃdharvapūjitam..
saṃsnāpya taṃ vidhānena īśamaṃtreṇa pūjayet.. 2 ..
16.88.d:
महालिंगं महादेवि गणगंधर्वपूजितम्..
संस्नाप्य तं विधानेन ईशमंत्रेण पूजयेत्.. 2 ..
16.88.m: the great liṅga worshipped by gaṇas and gandharvas, O great goddess. / Having bathed it according to the prescribed rite, he should worship it with the Īśa mantra. // 2

16.88.s:
kumudotpalasaṃbhāraiḥ samyaksaṃbhāvitātmavān ..
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇāṃ tasya namaskāreṇa pūjayet .. 3 ..
16.88.d:
कुमुदोत्पलसंभारैः सम्यक्संभावितात्मवान् ..
कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणां तस्य नमस्कारेण पूजयेत् .. 3 ..
16.88.m: Self-controlled and properly collected, with collections of white and blue water-lilies, / having circumambulated it, he should worship it with prostration. // 3

16.88.s:
evaṃ kṛtvā naro devi rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet ..
vṛṣastatraiva dātavyaḥ samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ .. 4 ..
16.88.d:
एवं कृत्वा नरो देवि राजसूयफलं लभेत् ..
वृषस्तत्रैव दातव्यः सम्यग्यात्राफलेप्सुभिः .. 4 ..
16.88.m: Having done so, O goddess, a man obtains the fruit of a Rājasūya sacrifice. / A bull should be given right there by those desiring the full fruit of the pilgrimage. // 4

16.88.s:
nīlāṃjananibho daityo nihataścāṃtakaḥ purā ..
tasya rodayitā strīṇāṃ nīlarudrastataḥ smṛtaḥ..5..
16.88.d:
नीलांजननिभो दैत्यो निहतश्चांतकः पुरा ..
तस्य रोदयिता स्त्रीणां नीलरुद्रस्ततः स्मृतः..5..
16.88.m: In ancient times, a Daitya resembling blue collyrium, named Antaka, was slain; / because he made his women weep, he is known as Nīlarudra. // 5

16.88.s:
tasya saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
samyakchraddhānvitaiḥ prāpyaṃ śrāvyaṃ taddarśanotsukaiḥ .. 6 ..
16.88.d:
तस्य संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं माहात्म्यं पापनाशनम् ..
सम्यक्छ्रद्धान्वितैः प्राप्यं श्राव्यं तद्दर्शनोत्सुकैः .. 6 ..
16.88.m: His sin-destroying glory has been proclaimed in brief; / it is to be attained by those endowed with complete faith, and heard by those eager for his darśana. // 6

16.88.s: itiśrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ekādaśarudramāhātmye nīla rudramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 88 ..
16.88.d: इतिश्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य एकादशरुद्रमाहात्म्ये नील रुद्रमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टाशीतितमोऽध्यायः .. 88 ..
16.88.m: Thus ends the eighty-eighth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Nīlarudra' in the Glory of the Eleven Rudras, within the first [part], the Glory of Prabhāsa Sacred Field, of the seventh section, Prabhāsa Section, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. // 88

16.89.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchedvarārohe kapālīśvaramuttamam ..
rudraṃ tṛtīyaṃ pāpaghnaṃ nīlarudrasyapūrvataḥ .. 1 ..
16.89.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेद्वरारोहे कपालीश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
रुद्रं तृतीयं पापघ्नं नीलरुद्रस्यपूर्वतः .. 1 ..
16.89.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O fair-hipped lady, to the supreme Kapālīśvara, / the third Rudra, destroyer of sins, east of Nīlarudra, 1

16.89.s:
budheśvarātpaścimato dhanuṣāṃ saptake sthitam ..
chinnaṃ mayā purā devi brahmaṇaḥ paṃcamaṃ śiraḥ .. 2 ..
16.89.d:
बुधेश्वरात्पश्चिमतो धनुषां सप्तके स्थितम् ..
छिन्नं मया पुरा देवि ब्रह्मणः पंचमं शिरः .. 2 ..
16.89.m: situated seven bow-lengths to the west of Budheśvara. / Long ago, O goddess, I severed the fifth head of Brahmā. 2

16.89.s:
tatkapālaṃ kare lagnaṃ prabhāsakṣetramāgataḥ ..
tato varṣasahasraṃ tu saṃsthitaḥ kṣetramadhyataḥ .. 3 ..
16.89.d:
तत्कपालं करे लग्नं प्रभासक्षेत्रमागतः ..
ततो वर्षसहस्रं तु संस्थितः क्षेत्रमध्यतः .. 3 ..
16.89.m: With that skull clinging to my hand, I came to Prabhāsakṣetra. / Then for a thousand years I remained in the midst of the sacred field. 3

16.89.s:
kapāladhārī digvāsāḥ kapālī tena ca smṛtaḥ ..
tanmayā pūjitaṃ liṃgaṃ varṣāṇāmayutaṃ priye .. 4 ..
16.89.d:
कपालधारी दिग्वासाः कपाली तेन च स्मृतः ..
तन्मया पूजितं लिंगं वर्षाणामयुतं प्रिये .. 4 ..
16.89.m: Holding the skull, sky-clad, I was therefore remembered as Kapālī. / That liṅga was worshipped by me for ten thousand years, O beloved. 4

16.89.s:
kapālirūpamāsthāya kapālīśastataḥ smṛtaḥ ..
sarvapāpaharo nṛṇāṃ darśanātsparśanādapi .. 5 ..
16.89.d:
कपालिरूपमास्थाय कपालीशस्ततः स्मृतः ..
सर्वपापहरो नृणां दर्शनात्स्पर्शनादपि .. 5 ..
16.89.m: Having assumed the form of Kapālī, he is therefore remembered as Kapālīśa; / he removes all sins of mortals through mere darśana and touch. 5

16.89.s:
mayā tatra niyuktā vai rakṣārthaṃ śūlapāṇayaḥ ..
gaṇāḥ sahasraśo devi pāpināṃ duṣṭacetasām .. 6 ..
16.89.d:
मया तत्र नियुक्ता वै रक्षार्थं शूलपाणयः ..
गणाः सहस्रशो देवि पापिनां दुष्टचेतसाम् .. 6 ..
16.89.m: There I appointed trident-bearing gaṇas / by the thousands, O goddess, for protection against sinners of wicked mind. 6
Therefore, with every effort and endowed with full faith, / one should worship that faultless Mahādeva, Kapālin. 7

16.89.s:
hiraṇyaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇe vedapārage ..
pūjayitvā vidhānena samyaktatpuruṣāṇunā .. 8 ..
16.89.d:
हिरण्यं तत्र दातव्यं ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे ..
पूजयित्वा विधानेन सम्यक्तत्पुरुषाणुना .. 8 ..
16.89.m: Gold should be given there to a brahmin who has mastered the Vedas, / having duly worshipped [the liṅga] with the Tatpuruṣa mantra. 8

16.89.s:
janmaprabhṛti yatpāpaṃ prāṇibhiḥ samupārjitam ..
ṣaḍaśītimukhe dṛṣṭvā talliṃgaṃ tu vyapohati .. 9 ..
16.89.d:
जन्मप्रभृति यत्पापं प्राणिभिः समुपार्जितम् ..
षडशीतिमुखे दृष्ट्वा तल्लिंगं तु व्यपोहति .. 9 ..
16.89.m: Whatever sin has been amassed by living beings from birth onwards, / beholding that liṅga during the Ṣaḍaśītimukha destroys it. 9

16.89.s:
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
kapālirudradevasya tṛtīyasya varānane .. 7.1.89.10 ..
16.89.d:
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं माहात्म्यं पापनाशनम् ..
कपालिरुद्रदेवस्य तृतीयस्य वरानने .. 7.1.89.10 ..
16.89.m: Thus, in brief, has been declared the sin-destroying māhātmya / of the third god, Kapālirudra, O fair-faced lady. 7.1.89.10

16.89.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ekādaśarudramāhātmye kapā līśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 89 ..
16.89.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य एकादशरुद्रमाहात्म्ये कपा लीश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोननवतितमोऽध्यायः .. 89 ..
16.89.m: Thus ends the eighty-ninth chapter, entitled "Description of the Māhātmya of Kapālīśvara", in the Māhātmya of the Eleven Rudras, in the first Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. 89

16.90.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi caturthaṃ rudramuttamam ..
vṛṣabheśvaranāmānaṃ kalpaliṃgaṃ surapriyam .. 1 ..
16.90.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि चतुर्थं रुद्रमुत्तमम् ..
वृषभेश्वरनामानं कल्पलिंगं सुरप्रियम् .. 1 ..
16.90.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the fourth supreme Rudra, / named Vṛṣabheśvara, the kalpa-liṅga beloved by the gods, 1

16.90.s:
bālarūpī mahādevi yatra brahmā svayaṃ sthitaḥ ..
tasyaiva cottare bhāge dhanuṣāṃ tritaye sthitam .. 2 ..
16.90.d:
बालरूपी महादेवि यत्र ब्रह्मा स्वयं स्थितः ..
तस्यैव चोत्तरे भागे धनुषां त्रितये स्थितम् .. 2 ..
16.90.m: where Brahmā himself dwells in the form of a child, O great goddess; / it stands three bow-lengths to his north. 2

16.90.s:
ādyaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi nāpuṇyo veda mānavaḥ ..
tasyaiva kalpanāmāni sāṃprataṃ prabravīmi te .. 3..
16.90.d:
आद्यं महाप्रभावं हि नापुण्यो वेद मानवः ..
तस्यैव कल्पनामानि सांप्रतं प्रब्रवीमि ते .. 3..
16.90.m: A person devoid of merit certainly does not know this primeval one of great power. / I shall now tell you its names in different kalpas. 3

16.90.s:
pūrvakalpe mahādevi brahmeśvara iti smṛtaḥ ..
brahmaṇārādhitaḥ pūrvaṃ varṣāṇāmayutaṃ priye .. 4 ..
16.90.d:
पूर्वकल्पे महादेवि ब्रह्मेश्वर इति स्मृतः ..
ब्रह्मणाराधितः पूर्वं वर्षाणामयुतं प्रिये .. 4 ..
16.90.m: In a previous kalpa, O great goddess, it was remembered as Brahmeśvara, / having been worshipped formerly by Brahmā for ten thousand years, O beloved. 4

16.90.s:
sṛṣṭikāmena devena tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ ..
caturvidhāṃ bhūtasṛṣṭiṃ tataścakre pitāmahaḥ .. 5 ..
16.90.d:
सृष्टिकामेन देवेन ततस्तुष्टो महेश्वरः ..
चतुर्विधां भूतसृष्टिं ततश्चक्रे पितामहः .. 5 ..
16.90.m: Maheśvara was pleased with the god who desired creation; / then the Grandfather brought forth the fourfold creation of living beings. 5

16.90.s:
brahmaṇastvīśabhāvena gatastuṣṭiṃ yato haraḥ ..
tena brahmeśvaraṃ nāma tasmim̐lliṃge purā'bhavat .. 6 ..
16.90.d:
ब्रह्मणस्त्वीशभावेन गतस्तुष्टिं यतो हरः ..
तेन ब्रह्मेश्वरं नाम तस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे पुराऽभवत् .. 6 ..
16.90.m: Because Hara attained satisfaction through Brahmā's lordly state, / therefore, in ancient times, the name Brahmeśvara was given to that liṅga. 6

16.90.s:
tato dvitīyakalpe tu saṃprāpte varavarṇini ..
raivateśvaranāmeti prakhyātaṃ dharaṇītale ..7..
16.90.d:
ततो द्वितीयकल्पे तु संप्राप्ते वरवर्णिनि ..
रैवतेश्वरनामेति प्रख्यातं धरणीतले ..7..
16.90.m: Then, when the second kalpa arrived, O lady of fair complexion, / it became renowned on the surface of the earth under the name Raivateśvara. 7

16.90.s:
raivato nāma rājā'bhūdbrahmāṃḍe sacarācare ..
jagadyonirjigāyedaṃ talliṃgasya prabhāvataḥ .. 8 ..
16.90.d:
रैवतो नाम राजाऽभूद्ब्रह्मांडे सचराचरे ..
जगद्योनिर्जिगायेदं तल्लिंगस्य प्रभावतः .. 8 ..
16.90.m: There was a king named Raivata in the universe of moving and unmoving beings; / by the power of that liṅga he conquered this [world], the womb of creation. 8

16.90.s:
raivateśvaranāmābhūttena liṃgaṃ mahāprabham ..
punastṛtīyakalpe tu saṃprāpte varavarṇini..9 ..
16.90.d:
रैवतेश्वरनामाभूत्तेन लिंगं महाप्रभम् ..
पुनस्तृतीयकल्पे तु संप्राप्ते वरवर्णिनि..9 ..
16.90.m: By him the liṅga of great splendour came to have the name Raivateśvara. / Again, when the third kalpa arrived, O lady of fair complexion, 9

16.90.s:
vṛṣabheśvaranāmābhūttasya liṃgasya bhāmini ..
mamaiva vāhanaṃ yo'sau dharmoyaṃ vṛṣarūpadhṛk .. 7.1.90.10 ..
16.90.d:
वृषभेश्वरनामाभूत्तस्य लिंगस्य भामिनि ..
ममैव वाहनं योऽसौ धर्मोयं वृषरूपधृक् .. 7.1.90.10 ..
16.90.m: that liṅga acquired the name Vṛṣabheśvara, O passionate lady. / He who is my own mount is this Dharma who assumes the form of a bull. 7.1.90.10

16.90.s:
tena tatpūjitaṃ liṃgaṃ divyābdānāṃ sahasrakam..
tatastuṣṭena deveśi nītaḥ sāyujyatāṃ vṛṣaḥ .. 11 ..
16.90.d:
तेन तत्पूजितं लिंगं दिव्याब्दानां सहस्रकम्..
ततस्तुष्टेन देवेशि नीतः सायुज्यतां वृषः .. 11 ..
16.90.m: By him that liṅga was worshipped for a thousand divine years. / Then, pleased [with him], O queen of the gods, the bull was led to union [with me]. 11

16.90.s:
tena talliṃgamabhavadvṛṣabheśeti bhūtale ..
tataścaturthe saṃprāpte vārāhekalpa saṃjñite .. 12 ..
16.90.d:
तेन तल्लिंगमभवद्वृषभेशेति भूतले ..
ततश्चतुर्थे संप्राप्ते वाराहेकल्प संज्ञिते .. 12 ..
16.90.m: Therefore, that liṅga came to be known as Vṛṣabheśa on the surface of the earth. / Then, when the fourth [kalpa] named the Vārāha Kalpa arrived, 12

16.90.s:
aṣṭāviṃśatime tatra tretāyugamukhe tadā ..
ikṣvākurnāma rājā'bhūtsūryavaṃśavibhūṣaṇaḥ .. 13 ..
16.90.d:
अष्टाविंशतिमे तत्र त्रेतायुगमुखे तदा ..
इक्ष्वाकुर्नाम राजाऽभूत्सूर्यवंशविभूषणः .. 13 ..
16.90.m: at the beginning of the Tretāyuga during the twenty-eighth [cycle], / there was a king named Ikṣvāku, an ornament of the Solar dynasty. 13

16.90.s:
sa liṃgaṃ pūjayāmāsa trikālaṃ bhaktibhāvitaḥ ..
ekāhāro jitāhāro bhūbhiśāyī jiteṃdriyaḥ .. 14 ..
16.90.d:
स लिंगं पूजयामास त्रिकालं भक्तिभावितः ..
एकाहारो जिताहारो भूभिशायी जितेंद्रियः .. 14 ..
16.90.m: Endowed with devotion, he worshipped the liṅga at the three junctions of the day, / taking a single meal, having conquered his appetite, sleeping on the bare ground, with senses subdued. 14

16.90.s:
evaṃ kāle bahuvidhe tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ ..
dadau rājyaṃ mahodagraṃ saṃtatiṃ putra pautrikīm.. 15 ..
16.90.d:
एवं काले बहुविधे ततस्तुष्टो महेश्वरः ..
ददौ राज्यं महोदग्रं संततिं पुत्र पौत्रिकीम्.. 15 ..
16.90.m: After a long period of time in this manner, Maheśvara was pleased / and gave him an exalted kingdom and offspring consisting of sons and grandsons. 15

16.90.s:
ikṣvākvīśvaranāmābhūttenedaṃ liṃgamuttamam ..
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā devaṃ vṛṣabhavāhanam .. .16 ..
saptajanmakṛtaiḥ pāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
triṃśaddhanuṣpramāṇena tasya kṣetracaturddiśam.. 17..
16.90.d:
इक्ष्वाक्वीश्वरनामाभूत्तेनेदं लिंगमुत्तमम् ..
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या देवं वृषभवाहनम् .. .16 ..
सप्तजन्मकृतैः पापैर्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ..
त्रिंशद्धनुष्प्रमाणेन तस्य क्षेत्रचतुर्द्दिशम्.. 17..
16.90.m: By him this supreme liṅga came to have the name Ikṣvākvīśvara. / He who worships that god whose mount is the bull with devotion / is freed from sins committed in seven births; of this there is no doubt. / The sacred field around it measures thirty bow-lengths in all four directions. 16–17

16.90.s:
snānaṃ jāpyaṃ baliṃ homaṃ pūjāṃ stotramudīraṇam ..
tasmiṃstīrthe tu yaḥ kuryāttatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet .. 18 ..
16.90.d:
स्नानं जाप्यं बलिं होमं पूजां स्तोत्रमुदीरणम् ..
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु यः कुर्यात्तत्सर्वं चाक्षयं भवेत् .. 18 ..
16.90.m: Ablution, recitation of mantras, offerings, fire sacrifices, worship, and the chanting of hymns of praise— / whatever one performs at that sacred ford becomes imperishable. 18

16.90.s:
catuṣkoṇāṃtarā kṣetramevaṃ mātrāpramāṇataḥ ..
ekarātroṣito bhūtvā tasya liṃgasya sannidhau .. 19 ..
16.90.d:
चतुष्कोणांतरा क्षेत्रमेवं मात्राप्रमाणतः ..
एकरात्रोषितो भूत्वा तस्य लिंगस्य सन्निधौ .. 19 ..
16.90.m: Thus is the field, measured within four corners. / Having fasted for a single night in the presence of that liṅga, 19

16.90.s:
brahmacaryeṇa jāgartti sa pāpaiḥ saṃpramucyate ..
homajāpyasamādhistho nṛtyagītādivādanaiḥ .. 7.1.90.20 ..
16.90.d:
ब्रह्मचर्येण जागर्त्ति स पापैः संप्रमुच्यते ..
होमजाप्यसमाधिस्थो नृत्यगीतादिवादनैः .. 7.1.90.20 ..
16.90.m: he who keeps vigil in celibacy is completely freed from sins, / absorbed in fire offerings, recitation, and meditation, with dances, songs, and instrumental music. 7.1.90.20

16.90.s:
goghno vā brahmahā pāpī mucyate duṣkṛtairnaraḥ ..
yaḥ saṃprīṇayate viprāṃstatra bhojyaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ .. 21 ..
16.90.d:
गोघ्नो वा ब्रह्महा पापी मुच्यते दुष्कृतैर्नरः ..
यः संप्रीणयते विप्रांस्तत्र भोज्यैः पृथग्विधैः .. 21 ..
16.90.m: Whether a slayer of a cow, a slayer of a brahmin, or a sinner, a man is freed from his misdeeds / if he gratifies the brahmins there with various kinds of food. 21

16.90.s:
ekasminbhojite vipre koṭirbhavati bhojitā ..
bhairavaṃ caiva kedāraṃ puṣkaraṃ drutijaṃgamam .. 22 ..
16.90.d:
एकस्मिन्भोजिते विप्रे कोटिर्भवति भोजिता ..
भैरवं चैव केदारं पुष्करं द्रुतिजंगमम् .. 22 ..
16.90.m: When one brahmin is fed, ten million are considered fed. / Bhairava, Kedāra, Puṣkara, Drutijaṅgama, 22

16.90.s:
vārāṇasī kurukṣetraṃ mahā kālaṃ ca naimiṣam ..
etattīrthāṣṭakaṃ devi tasmim̐lliṃge vyavasthitam .. 23 ..
16.90.d:
वाराणसी कुरुक्षेत्रं महा कालं च नैमिषम् ..
एतत्तीर्थाष्टकं देवि तस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे व्यवस्थितम् .. 23 ..
16.90.m: Vārāṇasī, Kurukṣetra, Mahākāla, and Naimiṣa— / this group of eight sacred fords, O goddess, resides in that liṅga. 23

16.90.s:
māghe kṛṣṇacaturddaśyāṃ tatra yo jāgṛyānniśi ..
saṃpūjya vidhinā devaṃ sa tīrthāṣṭaphalaṃ labhet .. 24 ..
16.90.d:
माघे कृष्णचतुर्द्दश्यां तत्र यो जागृयान्निशि ..
संपूज्य विधिना देवं स तीर्थाष्टफलं लभेत् .. 24 ..
16.90.m: He who keeps vigil at night there on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of Māgha, / having duly worshipped the god, obtains the fruit of the eight sacred fords. 24

16.90.s:
dadāti tatra yaḥ piṇḍaṃ naṣṭendau śivasaṃnidhau ..
tṛpyanti pitarastasya yāvadbrahmadināntakam .. 25 ..
16.90.d:
ददाति तत्र यः पिण्डं नष्टेन्दौ शिवसंनिधौ ..
तृप्यन्ति पितरस्तस्य यावद्ब्रह्मदिनान्तकम् .. 25 ..
16.90.m: He who offers a piṇḍa there in the presence of Śiva on the new moon day— / his ancestors are satisfied until the end of Brahmā's day. 25

16.90.s:
dadhikṣīra ghṛtenaiva paṃcagavyakuśodakaiḥ ..
kuṃkumāgarukarpūraistalligaṃ pūjayenniśi .. 26 ..
16.90.d:
दधिक्षीर घृतेनैव पंचगव्यकुशोदकैः ..
कुंकुमागरुकर्पूरैस्तल्लिगं पूजयेन्निशि .. 26 ..
16.90.m: With curd, milk, and ghee, with the five products of the cow and kuśa water, / and with saffron, aloe-wood, and camphor, one should worship that liṅga at night. 26

16.90.s:
saṃmaṃtryāghoramaṃtreṇa dhyātvā devaṃ sadāśivam ..
evaṃ kṛtvā mahādevi mucyate paṃcapātakaiḥ .. 27 ..
16.90.d:
संमंत्र्याघोरमंत्रेण ध्यात्वा देवं सदाशिवम् ..
एवं कृत्वा महादेवि मुच्यते पंचपातकैः .. 27 ..
16.90.m: Consecrating it with the Aghora mantra and meditating on the god Sadāśiva, / having acted thus, O great goddess, one is freed from the five great sins. 27

16.90.s:
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturddaśyāṃ dadhnā saṃsnāpayedyadi ..
sa brāhmaṇaścaturvedo jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 28 ..
16.90.d:
अष्टम्यां च चतुर्द्दश्यां दध्ना संस्नापयेद्यदि ..
स ब्राह्मणश्चतुर्वेदो जायते नात्र संशयः .. 28 ..
16.90.m: And if one bathes it with curd on the eighth and fourteenth days, / he will be born as a brahmin learned in the four Vedas; of this there is no doubt. 28

16.90.s:
kṣīreṇa snāpayeddevi yadi taṃ vṛṣabheśvaram ..
saptadhenusahasrāṇāṃ sa phalaṃ viṃdate mahat .. 29 ..
16.90.d:
क्षीरेण स्नापयेद्देवि यदि तं वृषभेश्वरम् ..
सप्तधेनुसहस्राणां स फलं विंदते महत् .. 29 ..
16.90.m: If one bathes that Vṛṣabheśvara with milk, O goddess, / he attains the great fruit [equivalent to the gift] of seven thousand cows. 29

16.90.s:
janmāṃtareṇa yatpāpaṃ sāṃprataṃ yatkṛtaṃ priye ..
tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti ghṛtasnānena bhāmini .. 7.1.90.30 ..
16.90.d:
जन्मांतरेण यत्पापं सांप्रतं यत्कृतं प्रिये ..
तत्सर्वं नाशमायाति घृतस्नानेन भामिनि .. 7.1.90.30 ..
16.90.m: Whatever sin was committed in another birth or is done now, O beloved, / all of that is destroyed by a bath of ghee, O passionate lady. 7.1.90.30

16.90.s:
paṃcagavyena yo devi snāpayedvṛṣabheśvaram ..
sa dahetsarvapāpāni sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet .. 31 ..
16.90.d:
पंचगव्येन यो देवि स्नापयेद्वृषभेश्वरम् ..
स दहेत्सर्वपापानि सर्वयज्ञफलं लभेत् .. 31 ..
16.90.m: O goddess, he who bathes Vṛṣabheśvara with the five products of the cow / burns away all sins and obtains the fruit of all sacrifices. 31

16.90.s:
taddṛṣṭvā brahmahā goghnaḥ steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ ..
śaraṇāgataghātī ca mitraviśraṃbhaghātakaḥ .. 32 ..
16.90.d:
तद्दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्महा गोघ्नः स्तेयी च गुरुतल्पगः ..
शरणागतघाती च मित्रविश्रंभघातकः .. 32 ..
16.90.m: Beholding it, a slayer of a brahmin, a slayer of a cow, a thief, one who violates the teacher's bed, / a slayer of one who sought refuge, and a betrayer of a friend's trust— 32

16.90.s:
duṣṭapāpasamācāro mātṛhā pitṛhā tathā ..
mucyate sarvapāpaistu talliṃgārādhanodyataḥ .. 33 ..
16.90.d:
दुष्टपापसमाचारो मातृहा पितृहा तथा ..
मुच्यते सर्वपापैस्तु तल्लिंगाराधनोद्यतः .. 33 ..
16.90.m: one who has practiced wicked sins, or even a killer of mother or father, / is freed from all sins when intent upon worshiping that liṅga.

16.90.s:
kārtikaṃ sakalaṃ yastu pūjayedbrahmaṇā saha ..
brahmeśvaraṃ mahāliṃgaṃ sa muktaḥ pātakairbhavet .. 34 ..
16.90.d:
कार्तिकं सकलं यस्तु पूजयेद्ब्रह्मणा सह ..
ब्रह्मेश्वरं महालिंगं स मुक्तः पातकैर्भवेत् .. 34 ..
16.90.m: Whoever worships the great liṅga Brahmeśvara together with Brahmā / for the entire month of Kārtika becomes liberated from sins.

16.90.s:
tena dattaṃ bhavetsarvaṃ guravastena toṣitāḥ ..
śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ gayātīrthe tena taptaṃ mahattapaḥ ..
yena devādhidevo'saupūjito vṛṣabheśvaraḥ .. 35 ..
16.90.d:
तेन दत्तं भवेत्सर्वं गुरवस्तेन तोषिताः ..
श्राद्धं कृतं गयातीर्थे तेन तप्तं महत्तपः ..
येन देवाधिदेवोऽसौपूजितो वृषभेश्वरः .. 35 ..
16.90.m: Everything has been given by him; the gurus have been gratified by him; / a śrāddha has been performed at the tīrtha of Gayā; great austerity has been practiced by him / by whom this supreme God of gods, Vṛṣabheśvara, has been worshiped.

16.90.s:
iti te kathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ devapūjitam ..
vṛṣabheśvaradevasya kalpaliṃgasya bhāmini .. 36 ..
16.90.d:
इति ते कथितं देवि माहात्म्यं देवपूजितम् ..
वृषभेश्वरदेवस्य कल्पलिंगस्य भामिनि .. 36 ..
16.90.m: Thus has been told to you, O goddess, the māhātmya worshiped by gods, / belonging to the lord Vṛṣabheśvara, the Kalpaliṅga, O fair-faced lady.

16.90.s:
yaḥ śṛṇoti mahādevi māhātmyaṃ daivadevatam ..
mūrkho vā paṃḍito vā'pi sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 37 ..
16.90.d:
यः शृणोति महादेवि माहात्म्यं दैवदेवतम् ..
मूर्खो वा पंडितो वाऽपि स याति परमां गतिम् .. 37 ..
16.90.m: A fool or even a learned man who hears this divine māhātmya / of the god of gods, O great goddess, attains the supreme destination.

16.90.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ekādaśarudramāhātmye vṛṣavāhaneśvaramāhāmyavarṇanaṃnāma navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 90 ..
16.90.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य एकादशरुद्रमाहात्म्ये वृषवाहनेश्वरमाहाम्यवर्णनंनाम नवतितमोऽध्यायः .. 90 ..
16.90.m: Thus ends the ninetieth chapter, named 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Vṛṣavāhaneśvara,' in the Māhātmya of the Eleven Rudras, in the first [part], the Māhātmya of the Prabhāsakṣetra, in the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.91.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tryaṃbakeśvaramavyayam ..
tatpaṃcamaṃ samākhyātaṃ rudrāṇāmādidaivatam .. 1 ..
16.91.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि त्र्यंबकेश्वरमव्ययम् ..
तत्पंचमं समाख्यातं रुद्राणामादिदैवतम् .. 1 ..
16.91.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the imperishable Tryambakeśvara; / that is declared to be the fifth, the primordial deity among the Rudras.

16.91.s:
śikhaṃḍīśvaramākhyātaṃ pūrvaṃ tretāyuge priye ..
taccādyāhaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā saṃjñāyate naraiḥ ..2..
16.91.d:
शिखंडीश्वरमाख्यातं पूर्वं त्रेतायुगे प्रिये ..
तच्चाद्याहं प्रवक्ष्यामि यथा संज्ञायते नरैः ..2..
16.91.m: It was proclaimed as Śikhaṇḍīśvara previously in the Tretāyuga, O beloved; / and today I shall tell that by which it is known by men.

16.91.s:
asti sāṃbapuraṃ devi tatrasthaṃ parameśvari ..
tasyaivottaradigbhāge sthānaṃ kāpālikaṃ smṛtam .. 3 ..
16.91.d:
अस्ति सांबपुरं देवि तत्रस्थं परमेश्वरि ..
तस्यैवोत्तरदिग्भागे स्थानं कापालिकं स्मृतम् .. 3 ..
16.91.m: There is Sāmbapura, O goddess, situated there, O supreme lady; / in the northern quarter of it, a Kāpālika abode is recalled,

16.91.s:
kapāleśvaranāmā ca yatreśo liṃgamūrtimān ..
saṃsthitaḥ pāpanāśāya darśanātsparśanānnṛṇām .. 4 ..
16.91.d:
कपालेश्वरनामा च यत्रेशो लिंगमूर्तिमान् ..
संस्थितः पापनाशाय दर्शनात्स्पर्शनान्नृणाम् .. 4 ..
16.91.m: named Kapāleśvara, where the Lord embodied as a liṅga / is stationed for the destruction of sin from seeing and touching [him] for mortals.

16.91.s:
tasmādīśānadigbhāge dhanuṣāṃ ṣoḍaśāṃtare ..
tryaṃbakeśvaranāmā ca tatra rudraḥ sthitaḥ svayam .. .. 5 ..
16.91.d:
तस्मादीशानदिग्भागे धनुषां षोडशांतरे ..
त्र्यंबकेश्वरनामा च तत्र रुद्रः स्थितः स्वयम् .. .. 5 ..
16.91.m: In the northeast quarter from there, at a distance of sixteen bow-lengths, / Rudra himself is situated there under the name Tryambakeśvara,

16.91.s:
sarvānugrahakarttā ca sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ ..
purā yatrātapaddevi tapo ghoraṃ suduṣkaram ..
gururnāmā ṛṣivaro devadānavaduḥsaham .. 6 ..
16.91.d:
सर्वानुग्रहकर्त्ता च सर्वकामफलप्रदः ..
पुरा यत्रातपद्देवि तपो घोरं सुदुष्करम् ..
गुरुर्नामा ऋषिवरो देवदानवदुःसहम् .. 6 ..
16.91.m: the maker of grace for all, the grantor of the fruit of all desires; / where formerly, O goddess, the best of ṛṣis named Guru practiced severe austerity, / extremely difficult to perform and unbearable to gods and demons,

16.91.s:
koṭīnāṃ tritayaṃ yena tryaṃbako maṃtranāyakaḥ ..
japto divyena vidhinā trikālaṃ pūjya śaṃkaram .. 7 ..
16.91.d:
कोटीनां त्रितयं येन त्र्यंबको मंत्रनायकः ..
जप्तो दिव्येन विधिना त्रिकालं पूज्य शंकरम् .. 7 ..
16.91.m: by whom thirty million [recitations] of the king of mantras, Tryambaka, / were chanted according to divine rites, worshiping Śaṃkara at the three junctures of the day.

16.91.s:
tataḥ prasādya deveśaṃ divyaiśvaryamavāpa saḥ ..
cakre nāma svayaṃ tasya tryaṃbakeśvaramavyayam .. 8 ..
16.91.d:
ततः प्रसाद्य देवेशं दिव्यैश्वर्यमवाप सः ..
चक्रे नाम स्वयं तस्य त्र्यंबकेश्वरमव्ययम् .. 8 ..
16.91.m: Then, having propitiated the Lord of gods, he obtained divine sovereignty; / he himself named it the imperishable Tryambakeśvara.

16.91.s:
japtvā tu tryaṃbakaṃ maṃtraṃ yataḥ siddhimavāpa saḥ ..
divyāṣṭaguṇamaiśvaryaṃ tenāsau tryaṃbakeśvaraḥ .. 9 ..
16.91.d:
जप्त्वा तु त्र्यंबकं मंत्रं यतः सिद्धिमवाप सः ..
दिव्याष्टगुणमैश्वर्यं तेनासौ त्र्यंबकेश्वरः .. 9 ..
16.91.m: Since he attained siddhi by chanting the Tryambaka mantra, / [and attained] divine eightfold sovereignty, therefore it is Tryambakeśvara.

16.91.s:
sarvapātaka vidhvaṃsī darśanātsparśanādapi ..
yastryaṃbakaṃ japedviprastryaṃbakeśvarasaṃnidhau ..
sa prāpnoti mahāsiddhiṃ pratyakṣaṃ rudra eva saḥ ..7.1.91.10..
16.91.d:
सर्वपातक विध्वंसी दर्शनात्स्पर्शनादपि ..
यस्त्र्यंबकं जपेद्विप्रस्त्र्यंबकेश्वरसंनिधौ ..
स प्राप्नोति महासिद्धिं प्रत्यक्षं रुद्र एव सः ..7.1.91.10..
16.91.m: It destroys all sins by darśana and even by touch; / whatever brahmin chants the Tryambaka [mantra] in the presence of Tryambakeśvara, / he attains great siddhi; he is truly Rudra manifest.

16.91.s:
darśanādapi tasyātha pāpaṃ yāti sahasradhā ..
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā vidhinā bhāvamāsthitaḥ ..
vāmadevena maṃtreṇa sa muktaḥ pātakairbhavet .. 11 ..
16.91.d:
दर्शनादपि तस्याथ पापं याति सहस्रधा ..
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या विधिना भावमास्थितः ..
वामदेवेन मंत्रेण स मुक्तः पातकैर्भवेत् .. 11 ..
16.91.m: Even from the darśana of it, sin is scattered a thousandfold; / whoever worships it with devotion according to the rites, established in reverence, / with the Vāmadeva mantra, becomes freed from sins.

16.91.s:
caitraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ tatra yo jāgṛyānniśi ..
pūjāstutikathābhiśca sa prāpnotīpsitaṃ phalam .. 12 ..
16.91.d:
चैत्रशुक्लचतुर्दश्यां तत्र यो जागृयान्निशि ..
पूजास्तुतिकथाभिश्च स प्राप्नोतीप्सितं फलम् .. 12 ..
16.91.m: Whoever keeps vigil there at night on the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight of Caitra / with worship, hymns of praise, and sacred narratives, attains the desired fruit.
A cow should be given right there by those desiring the complete fruit of the pilgrimage.

16.91.s:
iti te kathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
tryaṃbakeśvararudrasya nṛṇāṃ puṇyaphalapradam .. 14 ..
16.91.d:
इति ते कथितं देवि माहात्म्यं पापनाशनम् ..
त्र्यंबकेश्वररुद्रस्य नृणां पुण्यफलप्रदम् .. 14 ..
16.91.m: Thus has been told to you, O goddess, the sin-destroying māhātmya / of Tryambakeśvara Rudra, which bestows the fruit of religious merit on mortals.

16.91.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ekādaśarudramāhātmye tryaṃbakeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 91 ..
16.91.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य एकादशरुद्रमाहात्म्ये त्र्यंबकेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनवतितमोऽध्यायः .. 91 ..
16.91.m: Thus ends the ninety-first chapter, named 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Tryambakeśvara,' in the Māhātmya of the Eleven Rudras, in the first [part], the Māhātmya of the Prabhāsakṣetra, in the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.92.s:
.. īśvara uvāca.. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi aghoreśvaramuttamam..
ṣaṣṭhaṃ liṃgaṃ samākhyātaṃ tadvaktraṃ bhairavaṃ smṛtam..1..
16.92.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच.. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि अघोरेश्वरमुत्तमम्..
षष्ठं लिंगं समाख्यातं तद्वक्त्रं भैरवं स्मृतम्..1..
16.92.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the supreme Aghoreśvara; / it is declared as the sixth liṅga; that face is remembered as the Bhairava [aspect].

16.92.s:
tryaṃbakeśvaravāyavye dhanuṣāṃ paṃcake sthitam..
sarvakāmapradaṃ puṇyaṃ kalikalmaṣanāśanam..2..
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā snānapūjādibhiḥ kramāt..
merudānasya kṛtsnasya sa labhenmanujaḥ phalam..3..
16.92.d:
त्र्यंबकेश्वरवायव्ये धनुषां पंचके स्थितम्..
सर्वकामप्रदं पुण्यं कलिकल्मषनाशनम्..2..
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या स्नानपूजादिभिः क्रमात्..
मेरुदानस्य कृत्स्नस्य स लभेन्मनुजः फलम्..3..
16.92.m: It stands in the northwest of Tryambakeśvara at a distance of five bow-lengths, / granting all desires, sacred, destroying the defilement of the Kali age. / The mortal who worships it with devotion, in order, with snāna, worship, and other [rites], / obtains the entire fruit of giving Mount Meru [in gold].

16.92.s:
dakṣiṇāmūrtimāsthāya yatkiṃcittatra dīyate..
aghoreśvaradevasya tatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet..4..
16.92.d:
दक्षिणामूर्तिमास्थाय यत्किंचित्तत्र दीयते..
अघोरेश्वरदेवस्य तत्सर्वं चाक्षयं भवेत्..4..
16.92.m: Taking the form of Dakṣiṇāmūrti, whatever little is given there / to the god Aghoreśvara, all that becomes imperishable.

16.92.s:
yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute tatra aghoreśvaradakṣiṇe..
ākalpaṃ tṛptimāyāṃti pitarastasya tarpitāḥ .. 5..
16.92.d:
यः श्राद्धं कुरुते तत्र अघोरेश्वरदक्षिणे..
आकल्पं तृप्तिमायांति पितरस्तस्य तर्पिताः .. 5..
16.92.m: He who performs a śrāddha there to the south of Aghoreśvara, / his ancestors, having been gratified, attain satisfaction until the end of the kalpa.

16.92.s:
kiṃ śrāddhena gayātīrthe vājimedhena kiṃ priye ..
tatra śrāddhena tatsarvaṃ phalamabhyadhikaṃ labhet .. 6 ..
16.92.d:
किं श्राद्धेन गयातीर्थे वाजिमेधेन किं प्रिये ..
तत्र श्राद्धेन तत्सर्वं फलमभ्यधिकं लभेत् .. 6 ..
16.92.m: What is the use of a śrāddha at the tīrtha of Gayā? What is the use of a horse sacrifice, O beloved? / Through a śrāddha there, one obtains all that fruit, and even more.

16.92.s:
truṭimātramapi svarṇaṃ yātrāyāṃ yaḥ prayacchati ..
sa sarvaṃ phalamāpnoti mahādānasya bhūriśaḥ .. 7 ..
16.92.d:
त्रुटिमात्रमपि स्वर्णं यात्रायां यः प्रयच्छति ..
स सर्वं फलमाप्नोति महादानस्य भूरिशः .. 7 ..
16.92.m: Whoever gives even a truṭi of gold during the pilgrimage, / he obtains all the fruit of a great gift in abundance.

16.92.s:
brahmakūrcaṃ caredyastu somāṣṭamyāṃ vidhānataḥ ..
aghoreśvarasāṃnidhye aghoreṇābhimaṃtritam ..
ṣaḍabdasya mahattena prāyaścittaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet .. 8 ..
16.92.d:
ब्रह्मकूर्चं चरेद्यस्तु सोमाष्टम्यां विधानतः ..
अघोरेश्वरसांनिध्ये अघोरेणाभिमंत्रितम् ..
षडब्दस्य महत्तेन प्रायश्चित्तं कृतं भवेत् .. 8 ..
16.92.m: Whoever performs the brahmakūrca according to rule on a Somāṣṭamī / in the presence of Aghoreśvara, consecrated with the Aghora mantra, / by him the great expiation of six years has been performed.

16.92.s:
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktamaghoreśamahodayam ..
māhātmyaṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ śrutaṃ sarvārthasādhakam .. 9 ..
16.92.d:
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तमघोरेशमहोदयम् ..
माहात्म्यं सर्वपापघ्नं श्रुतं सर्वार्थसाधकम् .. 9 ..
16.92.m: Thus has been declared briefly the glorious Aghoreśa, / a māhātmya that destroys all sins, heard as accomplishing all purposes.

16.92.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ekādaśa rudramāhātmye'ghoreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 92 ..
16.92.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य एकादश रुद्रमाहात्म्येऽघोरेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्विनवतितमोऽध्यायः .. 92 ..
16.92.m: Thus ends the ninety-second chapter, named 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Aghoreśvara,' in the Māhātmya of the Eleven Rudras, in the first [part], the Māhātmya of the Prabhāsakṣetra, in the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.93.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchedvarārohe mahākāleśvaraṃ haram ..
aghoreśāduttarataḥ kiṃcidvāyavyasaṃsthitam .. 1 ..
16.93.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेद्वरारोहे महाकालेश्वरं हरम् ..
अघोरेशादुत्तरतः किंचिद्वायव्यसंस्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.93.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O fair-hipped lady, to Hara Mahākāleśvara, / situated to the north of Aghoreśa, slightly towards the northwest,

16.93.s:
dhanuṣāṃ triṃśatā devi śrutaṃ pātakanāśanam ..
pūrvaṃ kṛtayuge devi smṛtaṃ citrāṃgadeśvaram.. 2 ..
16.93.d:
धनुषां त्रिंशता देवि श्रुतं पातकनाशनम् ..
पूर्वं कृतयुगे देवि स्मृतं चित्रांगदेश्वरम्.. 2 ..
16.93.m: at thirty bow-lengths, O goddess; it is heard as destroying sins. / In the previous Kṛtayuga, O goddess, it was known as Citrāṅgadeśvara.

16.93.s:
mahākāleśvaraṃ devi kalau nāma prakīrtitam ..
kālarūpī mahārudrastasmim̐lliṃge vyavasthitaḥ .. 3 ..
16.93.d:
महाकालेश्वरं देवि कलौ नाम प्रकीर्तितम् ..
कालरूपी महारुद्रस्तस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे व्यवस्थितः .. 3 ..
16.93.m: In the Kali age, O goddess, its name is proclaimed as Mahākāleśvara; / the great Rudra whose form is Time is established in that liṅga,

16.93.s:
carācaraguruḥ sākṣāddevadānavadarpahā ..
sūryarūpeṇa yatsarvaṃ brahmāṃḍe grasate priye .. 4 ..
16.93.d:
चराचरगुरुः साक्षाद्देवदानवदर्पहा ..
सूर्यरूपेण यत्सर्वं ब्रह्मांडे ग्रसते प्रिये .. 4 ..
16.93.m: the guru of the moving and unmoving, manifest, the destroyer of the arrogance of gods and demons, / who, in the form of the sun, devours everything in the cosmic egg, O beloved.

16.93.s:
sa devaḥ saṃsthito devi tasmim̐lliṃge mahāprabhaḥ ..
yastatpūjayate bhaktyā kalye liṃgaṃ mama priyam ..
ṣaḍakṣareṇa maṃtreṇa mṛtyuṃ jayati tatkṣaṇāt .. 5 ..
16.93.d:
स देवः संस्थितो देवि तस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे महाप्रभः ..
यस्तत्पूजयते भक्त्या कल्ये लिंगं मम प्रियम् ..
षडक्षरेण मंत्रेण मृत्युं जयति तत्क्षणात् .. 5 ..
16.93.m: That god of great splendor is stationed in that liṅga, O goddess; / whoever worships at dawn that liṅga dear to me with devotion / by means of the six-syllable mantra, instantly conquers death.

16.93.s:
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣeṇa guggulaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutam ..
yo dahedvidhivattatra pūjāṃ kṛtvā niśāgame .. 6 ..
16.93.d:
कृष्णाष्टम्यां विशेषेण गुग्गुलं घृतसंयुतम् ..
यो दहेद्विधिवत्तत्र पूजां कृत्वा निशागमे .. 6 ..
16.93.m: Especially on the eighth day of the dark fortnight, whoever duly burns / bdellium combined with ghee there, having performed worship at nightfall,

16.93.s:
aparādhasahasraṃ tu kṣamate tasya bhairavaḥ ..
dhenudānaṃ praśaṃsaṃti tasminsthāne maharṣayaḥ .. 7 ..
16.93.d:
अपराधसहस्रं तु क्षमते तस्य भैरवः ..
धेनुदानं प्रशंसंति तस्मिन्स्थाने महर्षयः .. 7 ..
16.93.m: Bhairava forgives a thousand transgressions of his; / the great seers praise the gift of a cow in that place.

16.93.s:
dhenudastārayennūnaṃ daśa pūrvāndaśāparān ..
devasya dakṣiṇe bhāge yo japecchatarudriyam .. 8 ..
16.93.d:
धेनुदस्तारयेन्नूनं दश पूर्वान्दशापरान् ..
देवस्य दक्षिणे भागे यो जपेच्छतरुद्रियम् .. 8 ..
16.93.m: The giver of a cow certainly delivers ten ancestors and ten descendants; / whoever chants the Śatarudriya in the southern part of the god...

16.93.s:
uddharetpitṛvargaṃ ca mātṛvargaṃ ca mānavaḥ ..
bālye vayasi yatpāpaṃ vārddhake yauvane'pi vā ..
kṣālayeccaiva tatsarvaṃ dṛṣṭvā kāleśvaraṃ haram .. 9 ..
16.93.d:
उद्धरेत्पितृवर्गं च मातृवर्गं च मानवः ..
बाल्ये वयसि यत्पापं वार्द्धके यौवनेऽपि वा ..
क्षालयेच्चैव तत्सर्वं दृष्ट्वा कालेश्वरं हरम् .. 9 ..
16.93.m: A person delivers the group of his paternal ancestors and the group of his maternal ancestors. / Whatever sin [was committed] in childhood, old age, or youth, / he washes it all away having seen Hara, the Lord of Time (Kāleśvara).

16.93.s:
ayane cottare prāpte yaḥ kuryādghṛtakaṃbalam ..
na sa bhūyo'tra saṃsāre janma prāpnoti dāruṇam .. 7.1.93.10 ..
16.93.d:
अयने चोत्तरे प्राप्ते यः कुर्याद्घृतकंबलम् ..
न स भूयोऽत्र संसारे जन्म प्राप्नोति दारुणम् .. 7.1.93.10 ..
16.93.m: And he who prepares a blanket of clarified butter when the northern solstice arrives / does not attain a dreadful rebirth again in this world of transmigratory existence.

16.93.s:
na duḥkhito daridro vā durbhago vā prajāyate ..
saptajanmāntarāṇyeva mahākāleśadarśanāt .. 11 ..
16.93.d:
न दुःखितो दरिद्रो वा दुर्भगो वा प्रजायते ..
सप्तजन्मान्तराण्येव महाकालेशदर्शनात् .. 11 ..
16.93.m: He is not born distressed, poor, or unfortunate / throughout seven births, simply by the darśana of the great Lord of Time (Mahākāleśa).

16.93.s:
dhanadhānyasamāyukte sphīte sañjāyate kule ..
bhaktirbhavati bhūyo'pi mahākāleśvarārcane .. 12 ..
16.93.d:
धनधान्यसमायुक्ते स्फीते सञ्जायते कुले ..
भक्तिर्भवति भूयोऽपि महाकालेश्वरार्चने .. 12 ..
16.93.m: He is born into a flourishing family endowed with wealth and grain, / and his devotion to the worship of Mahākāleśvara arises yet again.

16.93.s:
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ mahākāleśvaraṃ priye ..
citrāṃgado gaṇo devi tena cārādhitaṃ purā .. 13 ..
16.93.d:
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं महाकालेश्वरं प्रिये ..
चित्रांगदो गणो देवि तेन चाराधितं पुरा .. 13 ..
16.93.m: Thus has the great Lord of Time (Mahākāleśvara) been described in brief, O beloved. / Formerly, O goddess, the attendant Citrāṅgada worshipped him

16.93.s:
divyābdānāṃ sahasraṃ tu mahā kāleśvaraṃ hi tat ..
citrāṃgadeśvaraṃ nāma tena khyātaṃ dharātale .. 14 ..
16.93.d:
दिव्याब्दानां सहस्रं तु महा कालेश्वरं हि तत् ..
चित्रांगदेश्वरं नाम तेन ख्यातं धरातले .. 14 ..
16.93.m: for a thousand celestial years—that very Mahākāleśvara; / therefore it became famous on the surface of the earth under the name Citrāṅgadeśvara.

16.93.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ekādaśarudramāhātmye mahākāleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṇavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 93 .. .. ..
16.93.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य एकादशरुद्रमाहात्म्ये महाकालेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रिणवतितमोऽध्यायः .. 93 .. .. ..
16.93.m: Thus ends the ninety-third chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Mahākāleśvara', in the Praise of the Eleven Rudras, in the first [part], the 'Glory of Prabhāsakṣetra', of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.94.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi bhairaveśvaramuttamam ..
tasyaiva vahnikoṇasthaṃ dhanuṣāṃdaśake sthitam ..1..
16.94.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि भैरवेश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
तस्यैव वह्निकोणस्थं धनुषांदशके स्थितम् ..1..
16.94.m: The Lord said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the excellent Lord of the Bhairavas (Bhairaveśvara), / situated in the fire direction (southeast) of that very [shrine], at a distance of ten bows.

16.94.s:
sarvakāmapradaṃ devi dāridryaughavināśanam ..
pūrvaṃ caṇḍeśvaraṃnāma khyātaṃ kṛtayuge priye .. 2 ..
16.94.d:
सर्वकामप्रदं देवि दारिद्र्यौघविनाशनम् ..
पूर्वं चण्डेश्वरंनाम ख्यातं कृतयुगे प्रिये .. 2 ..
16.94.m: It grants all desires, O goddess, and destroys the flood of poverty; / in the Kṛta age, O beloved, it was celebrated of old under the name Caṇḍeśvara.

16.94.s:
caṇḍonāma gaṇo devi tena cārādhitaṃ purā ..
divyābdānāṃ sahasraṃ tu tena caṇḍeśvaraṃ smṛtam .. 3 ..
16.94.d:
चण्डोनाम गणो देवि तेन चाराधितं पुरा ..
दिव्याब्दानां सहस्रं तु तेन चण्डेश्वरं स्मृतम् .. 3 ..
16.94.m: Formerly, O goddess, an attendant named Caṇḍa worshipped it / for a thousand celestial years; therefore it is remembered as Caṇḍeśvara.

16.94.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā devadeveśaṃ spṛṣṭvā ca susamāhitaḥ ..
mucyate sakalātpāpādājanmamaraṇāṃtikāt .. 4 ..
16.94.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा देवदेवेशं स्पृष्ट्वा च सुसमाहितः ..
मुच्यते सकलात्पापादाजन्ममरणांतिकात् .. 4 ..
16.94.m: Having seen that Lord of the gods of gods and having touched [it] with a well-composed mind, / one is freed from every sin from birth to the moment of death.

16.94.s:
tatra kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ māse bhādrapade priye ..
upavāsa paro bhūtvā yaḥ karoti prajāgaram ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ .. 5 ..
16.94.d:
तत्र कृष्णचतुर्दश्यां मासे भाद्रपदे प्रिये ..
उपवास परो भूत्वा यः करोति प्रजागरम् ..
स याति परमं स्थानं यत्र देवो महेश्वरः .. 5 ..
16.94.m: He who, having become intent on fasting, observes a vigil there / on the fourteenth day of the dark half in the month of Bhādrapada, O beloved, / goes to the supreme abode where the god Maheśvara resides.

16.94.s:
vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmaṇā yadupārjitam ..
tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti tasya liṃgasya darśanāt .. 6 ..
16.94.d:
वाचिकं मानसं पापं कर्मणा यदुपार्जितम् ..
तत्सर्वं नाशमायाति तस्य लिंगस्य दर्शनात् .. 6 ..
16.94.m: Sin committed by speech, mind, / or bodily action— / all that comes to ruin from the darśana of that liṅga.

16.94.s:
tilā hiraṇyaṃ vastrāṇi tatra deyaṃ manīṣiṇe ..
sarvakilviṣanāśārthaṃ samyagyātrāphalepsunā .. 7 ..
16.94.d:
तिला हिरण्यं वस्त्राणि तत्र देयं मनीषिणे ..
सर्वकिल्विषनाशार्थं सम्यग्यात्राफलेप्सुना .. 7 ..
16.94.m: Sesame seeds, gold, and garments should be given there to a wise man / by one who wishes for the complete fruit of the pilgrimage to destroy all sins.

16.94.s:
bhairavākāramāsthāya kalpānte sa haredyataḥ ..
viśvaṃ samagraṃ deveśi tenāsau bhairavaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 8 ..
16.94.d:
भैरवाकारमास्थाय कल्पान्ते स हरेद्यतः ..
विश्वं समग्रं देवेशि तेनासौ भैरवः स्मृतः .. 8 ..
16.94.m: Because he destroys the entire universe at the end of a kalpa, / having assumed the form of Bhairava, O queen of gods, he is therefore remembered as Bhairava.

16.94.s:
asminkalpe mahādevi prabhāsakṣetramāsthitaḥ ..
babhūva bhairavo rudraḥ kalpānte liṃgamūrtimān .. 9 ..
16.94.d:
अस्मिन्कल्पे महादेवि प्रभासक्षेत्रमास्थितः ..
बभूव भैरवो रुद्रः कल्पान्ते लिंगमूर्तिमान् .. 9 ..
16.94.m: In this kalpa, O great goddess, having taken his stand in Prabhāsakṣetra, / Rudra Bhairava became embodied as a liṅga at the close of the kalpa.

16.94.s:
evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ bhairaveśvaram ..
yacchrutvā mucyate jantuḥ pātakādatibhairavāt .. 7.1.94.10 ..
16.94.d:
एवं संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं माहात्म्यं भैरवेश्वरम् ..
यच्छ्रुत्वा मुच्यते जन्तुः पातकादतिभैरवात् .. 7.1.94.10 ..
16.94.m: Thus has the glory of Bhairaveśvara been told in brief, / hearing which a creature is freed from extremely dreadful sin.

16.94.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ekādaśarudramāhātmye bhairaveśvaramāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma caturṇavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 94 .. .. cha ..
16.94.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य एकादशरुद्रमाहात्म्ये भैरवेश्वरमाहात्म्य वर्णनंनाम चतुर्णवतितमोऽध्यायः .. 94 .. .. छ ..
16.94.m: Thus ends the ninety-fourth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Bhairaveśvara', in the Praise of the Eleven Rudras, in the first [part], the 'Glory of Prabhāsakṣetra', of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.95.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchedvarārohe liṃgaṃ mṛtyuñjayeśvaram ..
tasyaiva vahni koṇasthaṃ dhanuṣāṃ daśake sthitam .. 1 ..
16.95.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेद्वरारोहे लिंगं मृत्युञ्जयेश्वरम् ..
तस्यैव वह्नि कोणस्थं धनुषां दशके स्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.95.m: The Lord said: / Then one should go, O woman of beautiful hips, to the liṅga Mṛtyuñjayeśvara, / situated in the fire direction (southeast) of that very [shrine], at a distance of ten bows.

16.95.s:
paścime sāgarādityātsthitaṃ dhanuścatuṣṭaye ..
pāpaghnaṃ sarvajantūnāṃ darśanātsparśanādapi .. 2 ..
16.95.d:
पश्चिमे सागरादित्यात्स्थितं धनुश्चतुष्टये ..
पापघ्नं सर्वजन्तूनां दर्शनात्स्पर्शनादपि .. 2 ..
16.95.m: It stands four bows to the west of Sāgarāditya; / it destroys sins for all creatures merely by darśana and by touch.

16.95.s:
pūrve yuge samākhyātaṃ nāma nandīśvareti ca ..
yatra taptaṃ tapo ghoraṃ nandināmnā gaṇena me .. 3 ..
16.95.d:
पूर्वे युगे समाख्यातं नाम नन्दीश्वरेति च ..
यत्र तप्तं तपो घोरं नन्दिनाम्ना गणेन मे .. 3 ..
16.95.m: In a previous age, it was celebrated by the name Nandīśvara, / where fierce austerity was performed by my attendant named Nandin.

16.95.s:
pratiṣṭhāpya mahāliṃgaṃ nityaṃ pūjāpareṇa ca ..
tatra japto mahāmantro mṛtyuñjaya iti śrutaḥ .. 4 ..
16.95.d:
प्रतिष्ठाप्य महालिंगं नित्यं पूजापरेण च ..
तत्र जप्तो महामन्त्रो मृत्युञ्जय इति श्रुतः .. 4 ..
16.95.m: Having installed the great liṅga and having remained constantly devoted to worship, / he recited there the renowned great mantra 'Mṛtyuñjaya'.

16.95.s:
koṭīnāṃ niyutaṃ devi tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ ..
dadau gaṇeśatāṃ tasya muktiṃ sāmīpyagāṃ tathā .. 5 ..
16.95.d:
कोटीनां नियुतं देवि ततस्तुष्टो महेश्वरः ..
ददौ गणेशतां तस्य मुक्तिं सामीप्यगां तथा .. 5 ..
16.95.m: He recited a million crores, O goddess; then Maheśvara, being pleased, / granted him the status of the chief of attendants, and likewise liberation that consists in proximity [to God].

16.95.s:
mṛtyuñjayena mantreṇa tasya tuṣṭo yato haraḥ ..
tena mṛtyuñjayeśeti khyātaṃ liṃgaṃ dharātale .. 6 ..
16.95.d:
मृत्युञ्जयेन मन्त्रेण तस्य तुष्टो यतो हरः ..
तेन मृत्युञ्जयेशेति ख्यातं लिंगं धरातले .. 6 ..
16.95.m: Since Hara was pleased with him through the Mṛtyuñjaya mantra, / the liṅga is therefore celebrated on the surface of the earth as Mṛtyuñjayeśa.

16.95.s:
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā paśyedvā bhāvitātmavān ..
nāśayettasya pāpāni saptajanmārjitānyapi .. 7 ..
16.95.d:
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या पश्येद्वा भावितात्मवान् ..
नाशयेत्तस्य पापानि सप्तजन्मार्जितान्यपि .. 7 ..
16.95.m: Whoever worships it with devotion or beholds it with a purified self, / it destroys his sins even though accumulated over seven births.

16.95.s:
snāpayetpayasā liṃgaṃ dadhnā ghṛtayutena ca ..
madhunekṣurasenaiva kuṃkumena vilepayet .. 8 ..
16.95.d:
स्नापयेत्पयसा लिंगं दध्ना घृतयुतेन च ..
मधुनेक्षुरसेनैव कुंकुमेन विलेपयेत् .. 8 ..
16.95.m: One should bathe the liṅga with milk, curds mixed with clarified butter, / honey, and sugarcane juice, and anoint it with saffron.

16.95.s:
karpūrośīra miśreṇa mṛganābhirasena ca ..
candanena sugandhena puṣpaiḥ saṃpūjayettataḥ .. 9 ..
16.95.d:
कर्पूरोशीर मिश्रेण मृगनाभिरसेन च ..
चन्दनेन सुगन्धेन पुष्पैः संपूजयेत्ततः .. 9 ..
16.95.m: Then one should worship it with fragrant sandalwood / mixed with camphor, uśīra root, and musk fluid, and with flowers.

16.95.s:
dadyāddhūpaṃ puro devi tato devasya cāgurum ..
vastraiḥ saṃpūjya vividhairātmavittānusārataḥ .. 7.1.95.10 ..
16.95.d:
दद्याद्धूपं पुरो देवि ततो देवस्य चागुरुम् ..
वस्त्रैः संपूज्य विविधैरात्मवित्तानुसारतः .. 7.1.95.10 ..
16.95.m: O goddess, one should offer incense before the god, and then agallochum, / worshipping [him] with various garments according to one's wealth.

16.95.s:
naivedyaṃ paramānnaṃ ca dattvā dīpasamanvitam ..
aṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇipātaṃ ca tataḥ kāryaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ .. 11 ..
16.95.d:
नैवेद्यं परमान्नं च दत्त्वा दीपसमन्वितम् ..
अष्टांगं प्रणिपातं च ततः कार्यं च भक्तितः .. 11 ..
16.95.m: Having offered the food oblation consisting of supreme rice cooked with milk, along with a lamp, / a prostration with eight limbs should then be performed with devotion.
A gift of gold should be given to a brahmin who has mastered the Vedas.

16.95.s:
evaṃ yātrā bhavettasya śāstroktā nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
evaṃ kṛtvā naro devi labhate janmanaḥ phalam .. 13 ..
16.95.d:
एवं यात्रा भवेत्तस्य शास्त्रोक्ता नात्र संशयः ..
एवं कृत्वा नरो देवि लभते जन्मनः फलम् .. 13 ..
16.95.m: Thus his pilgrimage will be one declared in scripture; of this there is no doubt. / Having done so, O goddess, a man obtains the fruit of his life.

16.95.s:
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ mṛtyuñjayamahodayam ..
pāpaghnaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam .. 14 ..
16.95.d:
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं मृत्युञ्जयमहोदयम् ..
पापघ्नं सर्वजंतूनां सर्वकामफलप्रदम् .. 14 ..
16.95.m: Thus the great majesty of Mṛtyuñjaya has been related in brief; / it destroys the sins of all living beings and grants the fruit of all desires.

16.95.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ekādaśarudramāhātmye mṛtyuñjayamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 95 ..
16.95.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य एकादशरुद्रमाहात्म्ये मृत्युञ्जयमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चनवतितमोऽध्यायः .. 95 ..
16.95.m: Thus ends the ninety-fifth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Mṛtyuñjaya', in the Praise of the Eleven Rudras, in the first [part], the 'Glory of Prabhāsakṣetra', of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.96.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tatogacchenmahādevi kāmeśvaramiti smṛtam ..
tasyaivottaradigbhāge dhanuṣāṃ tritaye sthitam ..
ratīśvaramiti khyātaṃ tretāyāṃ tatsure śvari .. 1 ..
16.96.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततोगच्छेन्महादेवि कामेश्वरमिति स्मृतम् ..
तस्यैवोत्तरदिग्भागे धनुषां त्रितये स्थितम् ..
रतीश्वरमिति ख्यातं त्रेतायां तत्सुरे श्वरि .. 1 ..
16.96.m: The Lord said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to what is known as Kāmeśvara, / situated in the northern direction of that very [shrine], at a distance of three bows; / it was celebrated as Ratīśvara in the Tretā age, O queen of gods.

16.96.s:
yasmindṛṣṭe manuṣyāṇāṃ pūjite tu varānane ..
naśyecca saptajanmāghaṃ gṛhabhaṃgaśca no bhavet .. 2 ..
16.96.d:
यस्मिन्दृष्टे मनुष्याणां पूजिते तु वरानने ..
नश्येच्च सप्तजन्माघं गृहभंगश्च नो भवेत् .. 2 ..
16.96.m: When it is beheld, and indeed worshipped by human beings, O fair-faced one, / the sin of seven births is destroyed, and ruin of the household does not happen.

16.96.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
kenāyaṃ sthāpito deva kasmātprokto ratīśvaraḥ ..
darśanenāsya kiṃ śreyaḥ sarvaṃ vistarato vada .. 3 ..
16.96.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
केनायं स्थापितो देव कस्मात्प्रोक्तो रतीश्वरः ..
दर्शनेनास्य किं श्रेयः सर्वं विस्तरतो वद .. 3 ..
16.96.m: The goddess said: / By whom was this installed, O god? Why is it called Ratīśvara? / What good comes from seeing it? Tell me everything in detail.

16.96.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm ..
