ratirnāmābhavatsādhvī kāmapatnī yaśasvinī ..4..
16.96.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि कथां पापप्रणाशिनीम् ..
रतिर्नामाभवत्साध्वी कामपत्नी यशस्विनी ..4..
16.96.m: The Lord said: / Hear, O goddess, and I will narrate the sin-destroying story. / There was a virtuous and renowned wife of Kāma named Rati.

16.96.s:
dagdhe manasije pūrvaṃ devena tripurāriṇā..
tadarthāya tapastepe tasmindeśe ratiḥ kila ..5..
16.96.d:
दग्धे मनसिजे पूर्वं देवेन त्रिपुरारिणा..
तदर्थाय तपस्तेपे तस्मिन्देशे रतिः किल ..5..
16.96.m: When the mind-born [Kāma] was burned formerly by the god who was the enemy of Tripura, / Rati, indeed, performed austerity in that place for his sake.

16.96.s:
aṃguṣṭhāgreṇa tiṣṭhantyā yāvadyugacatuṣṭayam ..
ārādhito mahādevaḥ śāṃtena manasā priye .. 6 ..
16.96.d:
अंगुष्ठाग्रेण तिष्ठन्त्या यावद्युगचतुष्टयम् ..
आराधितो महादेवः शांतेन मनसा प्रिये .. 6 ..
16.96.m: Standing on the tip of her big toe for four ages, / Mahādeva was worshipped by her with a serene mind, O beloved.

16.96.s:
kasmiṃścidatha kāle tu nirbhidya dharaṇītalam ..
tadagrataḥ samuttasthau ligaṃ māheśvaraṃ priye .. 7 ..
16.96.d:
कस्मिंश्चिदथ काले तु निर्भिद्य धरणीतलम् ..
तदग्रतः समुत्तस्थौ लिगं माहेश्वरं प्रिये .. 7 ..
16.96.m: Then, at a certain time, having split open the surface of the earth, / a liṅga belonging to Maheśvara rose up before her, O beloved.

16.96.s:
etasminneva kāle tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī ..
āhlādayaṃtī sahasā tasyāścittaṃ varānane .. 8 ..
16.96.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु वागुवाचाशरीरिणी ..
आह्लादयंती सहसा तस्याश्चित्तं वरानने .. 8 ..
16.96.m: At that very time, a bodiless voice spoke, / suddenly gladdening her heart, O fair-faced one: 8

16.96.s:
yasmānmāheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tvadbhaktyā sahasotthitam ..
pūjayestanmahābhāge tataḥ kāṃtamavāpsyasi ..9..
16.96.d:
यस्मान्माहेश्वरं लिंगं त्वद्भक्त्या सहसोत्थितम् ..
पूजयेस्तन्महाभागे ततः कांतमवाप्स्यसि ..9..
16.96.m: “Since this liṅga of Maheśvara has suddenly emerged through your devotion, / you should worship it, O fortunate lady; then you will regain your beloved.” 9

16.96.s:
etacchutvā tu sā sādhvī devadūtasya bhāṣitam..
talliṃgaṃ pūjayāmāsa sa bhaktyā paramayā yutā .. 7.1.96.10 ..
16.96.d:
एतच्छुत्वा तु सा साध्वी देवदूतस्य भाषितम्..
तल्लिंगं पूजयामास स भक्त्या परमया युता .. 7.1.96.10 ..
16.96.m: Hearing this utterance of the divine messenger, that chaste woman / worshipped that liṅga, filled with supreme devotion. 10

16.96.s:
tataḥ kāmaḥ samuttasthau suptotthita iva priye ..
tataḥ prabhṛti talliṃgaṃ kāmeśvaramiti śrutam .. 11 ..
16.96.d:
ततः कामः समुत्तस्थौ सुप्तोत्थित इव प्रिये ..
ततः प्रभृति तल्लिंगं कामेश्वरमिति श्रुतम् .. 11 ..
16.96.m: Then Kāma arose, like one waking from sleep, O beloved; / from then on, that liṅga has been renowned as Kāmeśvara. 11

16.96.s:
tataḥ sā kāmadayitā vākyametaduvāca ha ..
prahṛṣṭā kāmadevāptyā purataḥ puṣpadhanvanaḥ .. 12 ..
16.96.d:
ततः सा कामदयिता वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ..
प्रहृष्टा कामदेवाप्त्या पुरतः पुष्पधन्वनः .. 12 ..
16.96.m: Then that beloved of Kāma spoke these words, / overjoyed at regaining Kāmadeva, before the god with the flower-bow: 12

16.96.s:
pūjayiṣyaṃti ye cānye liṃgametatsamāhitāḥ ..
evaṃ te vāṃchitāṃ siddhiṃ bhūyo yāsyaṃti sadgatim.. 13 ..
16.96.d:
पूजयिष्यंति ये चान्ये लिंगमेतत्समाहिताः ..
एवं ते वांछितां सिद्धिं भूयो यास्यंति सद्गतिम्.. 13 ..
16.96.m: “And whatever other people worship this liṅga with concentrated mind / shall likewise obtain their desired success and further attain the highest state. 13

16.96.s:
mano'bhīṣṭaṃ tathā sarvaṃ yadyapi syātsadurllabham ..
tatprāpsyaṃti na saṃdeho liṃgasyāsya prasādataḥ .. .. 14 ..
16.96.d:
मनोऽभीष्टं तथा सर्वं यद्यपि स्यात्सदुर्ल्लभम् ..
तत्प्राप्स्यंति न संदेहो लिंगस्यास्य प्रसादतः .. .. 14 ..
16.96.m: Likewise, every desire of their heart, even if it be extremely difficult to obtain, / they shall obtain—of this there is no doubt—by the grace of this liṅga.” 14

16.96.s:
evamuktvā gatā sādhvī ratiḥ kāmena saṃyutā ..
svasthāne pūrṇakāmā sā prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā .. 15 ..
16.96.d:
एवमुक्त्वा गता साध्वी रतिः कामेन संयुता ..
स्वस्थाने पूर्णकामा सा प्रहृष्टेनांतरात्मना .. 15 ..
16.96.m: Having spoken thus, the virtuous Rati, united with Kāma, / went to her own abode, her desire fulfilled, her inner self overjoyed. 15

16.96.s:
enaṃ caitratrayodaśyāṃ śuklāyāṃ yaḥ samarcati ..
sakāmavadbhavennṛṇāṃ śrutaṃ saubhāgyadāyakam .. 16 ..
16.96.d:
एनं चैत्रत्रयोदश्यां शुक्लायां यः समर्चति ..
सकामवद्भवेन्नृणां श्रुतं सौभाग्यदायकम् .. 16 ..
16.96.m: Whoever worships this [liṅga] on the thirteenth day of the bright fortnight of Caitra / will have all desires fulfilled; it is traditionally taught as granting good fortune to men. 16

16.96.s: hṛti śrīskāṃdemahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ekādaśarudramāhātmye kāmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṇṇavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 96 ..
16.96.d: हृति श्रीस्कांदेमहापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य एकादशरुद्रमाहात्म्ये कामेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षण्णवतितमोऽध्यायः .. 96 ..
16.96.m: Thus ends the ninety-sixth chapter, named “The Description of the Māhātmya of Kāmeśvara,” in the Māhātmya of the Eleven Rudras, in the first [part], the Māhātmya of the Prabhāsakṣetra, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 96

16.97.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi yogeśvaramiti śrutam ..
kāmeśādvāyave bhāge dhanuṣāṃ saptake sthitam .. 1 ..
16.97.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि योगेश्वरमिति श्रुतम् ..
कामेशाद्वायवे भागे धनुषां सप्तके स्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.97.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to what is renowned as Yogeśvara, / situated seven dhanuses to the north-west of Kāmeśa. 1

16.97.s:
liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi darśanātpāpanāśanam..
pūrve yuge tu saṃkhyātaṃ gaṇeśvaramiti śrutam.. 2 ..
16.97.d:
लिंगं महाप्रभावं हि दर्शनात्पापनाशनम्..
पूर्वे युगे तु संख्यातं गणेश्वरमिति श्रुतम्.. 2 ..
16.97.m: A liṅga indeed of great power, destroying sin by its mere darśana; / in the former yuga it was accounted and renowned as Gaṇeśvara. 2

16.97.s:
purā mama gaṇā devi asaṃkhyātā mahāvalāḥ ..
kṣetraṃ māheśvaraṃ jñātvā prabhāsaṃ samupāgaman .. 3 ..
16.97.d:
पुरा मम गणा देवि असंख्याता महावलाः ..
क्षेत्रं माहेश्वरं ज्ञात्वा प्रभासं समुपागमन् .. 3 ..
16.97.m: Anciently, O goddess, my countless attendants of great strength, / recognizing Prabhāsa to be a sacred field of Maheśvara, came there. 3

16.97.s:
tatrasthāśca tapo ghoraṃ tepuste yogamāśritāḥ ..
divyābdānāṃ sahasraṃ tu tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ .. 4 ..
sālokyāṃ ca dadau muktiṃ teṣāṃ yogabalena 3 ..
16.97.d:
तत्रस्थाश्च तपो घोरं तेपुस्ते योगमाश्रिताः ..
दिव्याब्दानां सहस्रं तु ततस्तुष्टो महेश्वरः .. 4 ..
सालोक्यां च ददौ मुक्तिं तेषां योगबलेन 3 ..
16.97.m:
Staying there, taking resort to yoga, they performed terrible austerity / for a thousand divine years; thereupon Maheśvara was pleased, 4
and by the power of their yoga he granted them liberation consisting of dwelling in the same world [with him]. 3 [5a]

16.97.s:
yasmā tṣaḍaṃgayogena teṣāṃ tuṣṭo vṛṣadhvajaḥ ..
tena yogeśvaraṃ nāma liṃgaṃ yogaphalapradam .. 5 ..
16.97.d:
यस्मा त्षडंगयोगेन तेषां तुष्टो वृषध्वजः ..
तेन योगेश्वरं नाम लिंगं योगफलप्रदम् .. 5 ..
16.97.m: Because the bull-bannered god was pleased with them through the six-limbed yoga, / therefore the liṅga is named Yogeśvara, granting the fruit of yoga. 5 [5b-c]

16.97.s:
yastamarcayate bhaktyā samyakpūjāvidhānataḥ ..
sa yogasiddhimāpnoti modate divi devavat .. 6 ..
16.97.d:
यस्तमर्चयते भक्त्या सम्यक्पूजाविधानतः ..
स योगसिद्धिमाप्नोति मोदते दिवि देववत् .. 6 ..
16.97.m: He who worships it with devotion according to the proper ritual rules / attains the perfection of yoga and rejoices in heaven like a god. 6

16.97.s:
yo dadyātkāṃcanaṃ meruṃ kṛtsnāṃ caiva vasundharām ..
yogeśaṃ pūjayedyastu sa tayoradhikaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 7 ..
16.97.d:
यो दद्यात्कांचनं मेरुं कृत्स्नां चैव वसुन्धराम् ..
योगेशं पूजयेद्यस्तु स तयोरधिकः स्मृतः .. 7 ..
16.97.m: He who would give a golden Meru and the entire earth— / yet he who worships Yogeśa is remembered as superior to both. 7

16.97.s:
vṛṣabhastatra dātavyaḥ saṃpūrṇaphalahetave ..
evamekādaśa proktā rudrāḥ prābhāsamāśritāḥ ..
nityaṃ pūjyāśca vaṃdyāśca kṣetrasya phalamīpsubhiḥ .. 8 ..
16.97.d:
वृषभस्तत्र दातव्यः संपूर्णफलहेतवे ..
एवमेकादश प्रोक्ता रुद्राः प्राभासमाश्रिताः ..
नित्यं पूज्याश्च वंद्याश्च क्षेत्रस्य फलमीप्सुभिः .. 8 ..
16.97.m: A bull should be given there for the sake of the complete fruit. / Thus eleven Rudras dwelling in Prabhāsa have been proclaimed; / they must be constantly worshipped and revered by those desiring the fruit of the sacred field. 8

16.97.s:
ya etāṃ caiva śṛṇuyādrudraikādaśasaṃhitām ..
tasya kṣetraphalaṃ sarvaṃ prabhāsāṃtaravāsinaḥ .. 9 ..
16.97.d:
य एतां चैव शृणुयाद्रुद्रैकादशसंहिताम् ..
तस्य क्षेत्रफलं सर्वं प्रभासांतरवासिनः .. 9 ..
16.97.m: And whoever hears this collection of the eleven Rudras / gains the entire fruit of the sacred field of one who dwells within Prabhāsa. 9

16.97.s:
yaścaitānnaiva jānāti rudrānprābhāsamāśritān ..
sa kṣetramadhyasaṃstho'pi nāstyeva sa paśuḥ smṛtaḥ .. 7.1.97.10 ..
16.97.d:
यश्चैतान्नैव जानाति रुद्रान्प्राभासमाश्रितान् ..
स क्षेत्रमध्यसंस्थोऽपि नास्त्येव स पशुः स्मृतः .. 7.1.97.10 ..
16.97.m: And he who does not know these Rudras dwelling in Prabhāsa, / even though he resides in the middle of the sacred field, is considered non-existent, a beast. 10

16.97.s:
eteṣāṃ caiva rudrāṇāṃ sarvānvāpyekameva vā ..
someśvaraṃ pūjayitvā japedvai śatarudriyam ..
sarveṣāṃ labhate puṇyaṃ rudrāṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 11 ..
16.97.d:
एतेषां चैव रुद्राणां सर्वान्वाप्येकमेव वा ..
सोमेश्वरं पूजयित्वा जपेद्वै शतरुद्रियम् ..
सर्वेषां लभते पुण्यं रुद्राणां नात्र संशयः .. 11 ..
16.97.m: Having worshipped all these Rudras, or even just one, / [or] Someśvara, if one recites the Śatarudrīya, / he obtains the merit of all the Rudras; of this there is no doubt. 11

16.97.s:
idaṃ rahasyaṃ saṃkhyātaṃ māhātmyaṃ tava bhāmini ..
rudrāṇāṃ pāpaśamanaṃ śrutaṃ puṇyavivarddhanam .. 12 ..
16.97.d:
इदं रहस्यं संख्यातं माहात्म्यं तव भामिनि ..
रुद्राणां पापशमनं श्रुतं पुण्यविवर्द्धनम् .. 12 ..
16.97.m: This secret māhātmya of the Rudras has been declared to you, O passionate lady; / heard, it dispels sin and increases merit. 12

16.97.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye yogeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 97 ..
16.97.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये योगेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तनवतितमोऽध्यायः .. .. 97 ..
16.97.m: Thus ends the ninety-seventh chapter, named “The Description of the Māhātmya of Yogeśvara,” in the first [part], the Māhātmya of the Prabhāsakṣetra, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 97

16.98.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi caṃḍeśvaramiti śrutam..
someśādvāyave bhāge dhanuṣāṃ ṣaṣṭibhiḥ sthitam.. 1 ..
16.98.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि चंडेश्वरमिति श्रुतम्..
सोमेशाद्वायवे भागे धनुषां षष्टिभिः स्थितम्.. 1 ..
16.98.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to what is renowned as Caṇḍeśvara, / situated sixty dhanuses to the north-west of Someśa. 1

16.98.s:
divyaṃ liṃgaṃ mahādevi sarvapātakanāśanam ..
tatpūrve tu yuge khyātaṃ manoḥ svāyaṃbhuvāṃtare .. 2 ..
16.98.d:
दिव्यं लिंगं महादेवि सर्वपातकनाशनम् ..
तत्पूर्वे तु युगे ख्यातं मनोः स्वायंभुवांतरे .. 2 ..
16.98.m: A divine liṅga, O great goddess, destroying all sins; / in a former yuga, during the interval of the Svāyambhuva Manu, it was celebrated. 2

16.98.s:
tretāyugamukhe devi pṛthivyā saṃpratiṣṭhitam..
pūrvamanvaṃtare cāsmim̐lliṅgaṃ pṛthvīśvaraṃ priye .. 3 ..
16.98.d:
त्रेतायुगमुखे देवि पृथिव्या संप्रतिष्ठितम्..
पूर्वमन्वंतरे चास्मिम्̐ल्लिङ्गं पृथ्वीश्वरं प्रिये .. 3 ..
16.98.m: At the beginning of the Tretāyuga, O goddess, it was established by the Earth; / and in that former manvantara, O beloved, the liṅga was [known as] Pṛthvīśvara. 3

16.98.s:
punaścaṃdreṇa tatprāptaṃ liṃgaṃ caṃdreśvaraṃ priye ..
brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ nāśanaṃ puṇyavarddhanam .. 4 ..
16.98.d:
पुनश्चंद्रेण तत्प्राप्तं लिंगं चंद्रेश्वरं प्रिये ..
ब्रह्महत्यादिपापानां नाशनं पुण्यवर्द्धनम् .. 4 ..
16.98.m: Then it was reached by Candra, [becoming] the liṅga Candreśvara, O beloved, / destroying sins such as the killing of a brahmin, and increasing merit. 4

16.98.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi saptajanmasamudbhavaiḥ ..
mucyate kalmaṣaiḥ sarvaiḥ kṛtakṛtyastu jāyate .. 5 ..
16.98.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा मानवो देवि सप्तजन्मसमुद्भवैः ..
मुच्यते कल्मषैः सर्वैः कृतकृत्यस्तु जायते .. 5 ..
16.98.m: Beholding it, a mortal is freed from all taints / arising from seven births, O goddess, and becomes one whose duty is accomplished. 5

16.98.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
kathaṃ pṛthvīśvaraṃ khyātaṃ talliṃgaṃ pāpa nāśanam ..
kathaṃ punaḥ samākhyātaṃ candreśvaramiti prabho ..
etadvistarato brūhi śrotukāmāhamādarāt .. 6 ..
16.98.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
कथं पृथ्वीश्वरं ख्यातं तल्लिंगं पाप नाशनम् ..
कथं पुनः समाख्यातं चन्द्रेश्वरमिति प्रभो ..
एतद्विस्तरतो ब्रूहि श्रोतुकामाहमादरात् .. 6 ..
16.98.m: The Goddess said: / How was that sin-destroying liṅga celebrated as Pṛthvīśvara? / How was it again proclaimed as Candreśvara, O Lord? / Tell this in detail; I desire to hear it with reverence. 6

16.98.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi kathā pāpapraṇāśinīm ..
yāṃ śrutvā mucyate jaṃtustrividhaiḥ karmabandhanaiḥ .. 7 ..
16.98.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि कथा पापप्रणाशिनीम् ..
यां श्रुत्वा मुच्यते जंतुस्त्रिविधैः कर्मबन्धनैः .. 7 ..
16.98.m: Īśvara said: / Listen, O goddess, I shall relate the sin-destroying story, / hearing which a living being is freed from the threefold bonds of karma. 7

16.98.s: āsītpūrvaṃ mahādevi daityabhārārdditā mahī .. sā'dho vrajaṃtī sahasā gorūpā saṃbabhūva ha .. 8 ..
16.98.d: आसीत्पूर्वं महादेवि दैत्यभारार्द्दिता मही .. साऽधो व्रजंती सहसा गोरूपा संबभूव ह .. 8 ..
16.98.m: Formerly, O great goddess, the Earth was oppressed by the burden of daityas; / sinking down, she suddenly took the form of a cow. 8

16.98.s:
itastato dhāvamānā na lebhe nirvṛtiṃ kvacit ..
tato varṣaśate pūrṇe bhramamāṇā kvacitkvacit .. 9 ..
16.98.d:
इतस्ततो धावमाना न लेभे निर्वृतिं क्वचित् ..
ततो वर्षशते पूर्णे भ्रममाणा क्वचित्क्वचित् .. 9 ..
16.98.m: Running here and there, she found peace nowhere; / then, wandering in various places until a hundred years had passed, 9

16.98.s:
āsasāda mahākṣetraṃ prabhāsamiti viśrutam ..
devadānavagaṃdharvaiḥ sevitaṃ pāpanāśanam.. 7.1.98.10 ..
16.98.d:
आससाद महाक्षेत्रं प्रभासमिति विश्रुतम् ..
देवदानवगंधर्वैः सेवितं पापनाशनम्.. 7.1.98.10 ..
16.98.m: she reached the great sacred field renowned as Prabhāsa, / attended by gods, dānavas, and gandharvas, destroying sin. 10

16.98.s:
tatra sthitvā mahākṣetre kṛtvā manasi niścayam ..
liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhayāmāsa bhaktyā paramayā yutā .. 11 ..
16.98.d:
तत्र स्थित्वा महाक्षेत्रे कृत्वा मनसि निश्चयम् ..
लिंगं प्रतिष्ठयामास भक्त्या परमया युता .. 11 ..
16.98.m: Staying in that great sacred field, having resolved in her mind, / she established a liṅga, endowed with supreme devotion. 11

16.98.s:
varṣāṇāṃ ca śataṃ sāgraṃ kṛte tapasi duścare ..
tutoṣa bhagavānrudro dharitrīṃ vākyamabravīt .. 12 ..
16.98.d:
वर्षाणां च शतं साग्रं कृते तपसि दुश्चरे ..
तुतोष भगवान्रुद्रो धरित्रीं वाक्यमब्रवीत् .. 12 ..
16.98.m: When austere penance had been performed for more than a hundred years, / the blessed Rudra was pleased and said these words to the Earth: 12

16.98.s:
devi viśvaṃbhare sarvaṃ tapaḥ sucaritaṃ tvayā ..
mā śokaṃ kuru kalyāṇi bhaviṣyati tavepsitam .. 13 ..
16.98.d:
देवि विश्वंभरे सर्वं तपः सुचरितं त्वया ..
मा शोकं कुरु कल्याणि भविष्यति तवेप्सितम् .. 13 ..
16.98.m: “O goddess Viśvambharā, all penance has been well performed by you; / do not grieve, O auspicious one, what you desire will come to pass. 13

16.98.s:
daityā nāśaṃ gamiṣyaṃti viṣṇunā nihatā bhuvi ..
bhavitrī tvaṃ mahādevi daityabhāravivarjitā .. 14 ..
16.98.d:
दैत्या नाशं गमिष्यंति विष्णुना निहता भुवि ..
भवित्री त्वं महादेवि दैत्यभारविवर्जिता .. 14 ..
16.98.m: The daityas will meet destruction, slain on earth by Viṣṇu; / you, O great goddess, shall be relieved of the daityas’ burden. 14

16.98.s:
idaṃ tvayā sthāpitaṃ yalliṃgaṃ paramaśobhanam ..
dharitrīnāmnā vikhyātaṃ loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati .. .. 15 ..
16.98.d:
इदं त्वया स्थापितं यल्लिंगं परमशोभनम् ..
धरित्रीनाम्ना विख्यातं लोके ख्यातिं गमिष्यति .. .. 15 ..
16.98.m: This exceedingly beautiful liṅga which has been established by you / shall attain renown in the world under the name of the Earth. 15

16.98.s:
atrāhaṃ saṃsthito nityaṃ liṃgarūpī mahāprabhuḥ ..
sthāsyāmi kalpekalpe vai nṛṇāṃ pāpāpahārakaḥ .. 16 ..
16.98.d:
अत्राहं संस्थितो नित्यं लिंगरूपी महाप्रभुः ..
स्थास्यामि कल्पेकल्पे वै नृणां पापापहारकः .. 16 ..
16.98.m: Remaining here constantly in the form of a liṅga, the great lord, / I shall abide through eon after eon, taking away the sins of men. 16

16.98.s:
mūrtyaṣṭakasamāyukto liṃge 'sminsaṃsthitaḥ sadā ..
nṛṇāṃ nāśayitā pāpaṃ pūrvajanmaśatārjitam .. 17 ..
16.98.d:
मूर्त्यष्टकसमायुक्तो लिंगे ऽस्मिन्संस्थितः सदा ..
नृणां नाशयिता पापं पूर्वजन्मशतार्जितम् .. 17 ..
16.98.m: Endowed with eight forms, constantly present in this liṅga, / I shall destroy the sins of men acquired in hundreds of past births.” 17

16.98.s:
bhādre kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ yaścaitaṃ pūjayiṣyati ..
so'śvamedhasahasrasya phalamāpsyatyasaṃśayam .. 18 ..
16.98.d:
भाद्रे कृष्णतृतीयायां यश्चैतं पूजयिष्यति ..
सोऽश्वमेधसहस्रस्य फलमाप्स्यत्यसंशयम् .. 18 ..
16.98.m: And whoever worships this [liṅga] on the third day of the dark fortnight of the month of Bhādrapada, / he will without doubt obtain the fruit of a thousand horse sacrifices.

16.98.s:
sarvatīrthābhiṣekasya sarveṣāṃ dānakarmaṇām ..
bhaviṣyati phalaṃ tasya liṃgasyaivāsya pūjanāt .. 19 ..
16.98.d:
सर्वतीर्थाभिषेकस्य सर्वेषां दानकर्मणाम् ..
भविष्यति फलं तस्य लिंगस्यैवास्य पूजनात् .. 19 ..
16.98.m: The fruit of ritual bathing in all sacred fords and of all acts of donation / will belong to him simply by worshiping this liṅga.

16.98.s:
dhanuṣāṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ yāvatsamaṃtātparimaṃḍalam ..
kṣetramasya samākhyātaṃ prāṇināṃ muktidāyakam .. 7.1.98.20 ..
16.98.d:
धनुषां षोडशं यावत्समंतात्परिमंडलम् ..
क्षेत्रमस्य समाख्यातं प्राणिनां मुक्तिदायकम् .. 7.1.98.20 ..
16.98.m: As far as sixteen bows' lengths all around in circumference, / its sacred field is proclaimed to grant liberation to living beings.

16.98.s:
tasminmṛtāḥ prāṇino ye kāmato vāpyakāmataḥ ..
kṛmi kīṭasamā vāpi te yāṃti paramāṃ gatim .. 21 ..
16.98.d:
तस्मिन्मृताः प्राणिनो ये कामतो वाप्यकामतः ..
कृमि कीटसमा वापि ते यांति परमां गतिम् .. 21 ..
16.98.m: Living beings who die there, willingly or even unwillingly, / even if like worms and insects, go to the highest state.

16.98.s:
yo dadyātkāñcanaṃ meruṃ kṛtsnāṃ vā'pi vasundharām ..
yaḥ pūjayati pṛthvīśaṃ sa tayoradhikaḥ smṛtaḥ ..22..
16.98.d:
यो दद्यात्काञ्चनं मेरुं कृत्स्नां वाऽपि वसुन्धराम् ..
यः पूजयति पृथ्वीशं स तयोरधिकः स्मृतः ..22..
16.98.m: Whether one gives a golden Meru or the entire earth, / he who worships Pṛthvīśa is considered superior to both.

16.98.s:
īśvara uvāca .. ..
iti dattvā varāndevastatraivāṃtaradhīyata ..
pṛthivīśvaranāmābhūttatprabhṛtyeva śaṃkaraḥ .. 23 ..
16.98.d:
ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
इति दत्त्वा वरान्देवस्तत्रैवांतरधीयत ..
पृथिवीश्वरनामाभूत्तत्प्रभृत्येव शंकरः .. 23 ..
16.98.m: Īśvara said: / Having granted these boons, the god vanished right there. / From that time on, Śaṃkara became known by the name Pṛthivīśvara.

16.98.s:
punarasminmahākalpe vārāha iti viśrute ..
kadāciddakṣaśāpena kṣīṇaścandro babhūva ha .. 24 ..
16.98.d:
पुनरस्मिन्महाकल्पे वाराह इति विश्रुते ..
कदाचिद्दक्षशापेन क्षीणश्चन्द्रो बभूव ह .. 24 ..
16.98.m: Again, in this great cosmic cycle known as the Vārāha, / once the Moon became emaciated due to Dakṣa's curse.

16.98.s:
papāta bhūtale devi yakṣmaṇā pīḍitaḥ śaśī ..
kṣetraṃ prabhāsamāsādya tanmahodadhisaṃnidhau .. 25 ..
16.98.d:
पपात भूतले देवि यक्ष्मणा पीडितः शशी ..
क्षेत्रं प्रभासमासाद्य तन्महोदधिसंनिधौ .. 25 ..
16.98.m: Afflicted by consumption, the Moon fell to the surface of the earth, O goddess, / having reached the sacred field of Prabhāsa near that great ocean.

16.98.s:
dṛṣṭvā pṛthvīśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ saprabhāvaṃ mahāprabham ..
tatpūjānirato bhūtvā varṣāṇāṃ tu sahasrakam .. 26 ..
16.98.d:
दृष्ट्वा पृथ्वीश्वरं लिंगं सप्रभावं महाप्रभम् ..
तत्पूजानिरतो भूत्वा वर्षाणां तु सहस्रकम् .. 26 ..
16.98.m: Seeing the Pṛthvīśvara liṅga possessed of majesty and great splendour, / and becoming devoted to its worship for a thousand years,

16.98.s:
atapatsa tapo raudraṃ śīrṇaparṇāṃbubhakṣakaḥ ..
yataḥ samabhavaddīptyā sarvāhlādakaraḥ śaśī .. 27 ..
16.98.d:
अतपत्स तपो रौद्रं शीर्णपर्णांबुभक्षकः ..
यतः समभवद्दीप्त्या सर्वाह्लादकरः शशी .. 27 ..
16.98.m: he performed dreadful austerity, subsisting on withered leaves and water, / wherefore the Moon, delighting all with his radiance, was restored.

16.98.s:
talliṃgasyaiva māhātmyāttataścaṃdreśvaro'bhavat ..
tasya liṃgasya māhātmyāccaṃdramā gatakalmaṣaḥ .. 28 ..
16.98.d:
तल्लिंगस्यैव माहात्म्यात्ततश्चंद्रेश्वरोऽभवत् ..
तस्य लिंगस्य माहात्म्याच्चंद्रमा गतकल्मषः .. 28 ..
16.98.m: Indeed from the māhātmya of that liṅga, it became Candreśvara. / Through the māhātmya of that liṅga, the Moon was freed from impurity,

16.98.s:
avāpa siddhimatyugrāṃ sparśaliṃgaprakāśinīm ..
somanātheti yāṃ prāhuḥ prasiddhāṃ liṃgarūpiṇīm .. 29 ..
16.98.d:
अवाप सिद्धिमत्युग्रां स्पर्शलिंगप्रकाशिनीम् ..
सोमनाथेति यां प्राहुः प्रसिद्धां लिंगरूपिणीम् .. 29 ..
16.98.m: and attained an exceedingly fierce perfection that reveals the contact-liṅga, / which they proclaim as Somanātha, renowned in the form of a liṅga.

16.98.s:
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ candradaivatam ..
śrutaṃ harati pāpāni tathā''rogyaṃ prayacchati .. 7.1.98.30 ..
16.98.d:
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं माहात्म्यं चन्द्रदैवतम् ..
श्रुतं हरति पापानि तथा'ऽरोग्यं प्रयच्छति .. 7.1.98.30 ..
16.98.m: Thus has been briefly declared the māhātmya dedicated to the Moon. / Heard, it removes sins and likewise bestows health.

16.98.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye madhyayātrāyāṃ pṛthvīśvara( caṃdreśvara)māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭanavatitamodhyāyaḥ .. 98 ..
16.98.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये मध्ययात्रायां पृथ्वीश्वर( चंद्रेश्वर)माहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टनवतितमोध्यायः .. 98 ..
16.98.m: Thus ends the ninety-eighth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Pṛthvīśvara (Candreśvara)', in the Intermediate Pilgrimage, in the first Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.99.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi yatra cakradharaḥ sthitaḥ ..
daṃḍapāṇiśca deveśi yatraikasthānasaṃsthitaḥ .. 1 ..
16.99.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि यत्र चक्रधरः स्थितः ..
दंडपाणिश्च देवेशि यत्रैकस्थानसंस्थितः .. 1 ..
16.99.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to where Cakradhara resides, / and where Daṇḍapāṇi is situated in the same place, O ruler of gods,

16.99.s:
caṃdreśātpūrvadigbhāge . someśāduttaresthitaḥ) ..
dhanuṣāṃ paṃcasaṃsthāne gaṃdharveśātsamīpataḥ .. 2 ..
16.99.d:
चंद्रेशात्पूर्वदिग्भागे . सोमेशादुत्तरेस्थितः) ..
धनुषां पंचसंस्थाने गंधर्वेशात्समीपतः .. 2 ..
16.99.m: to the east of Candreśa and to the north of Someśa, / at a distance of five bows' lengths, near Gandharveśa,

16.99.s:
umāyā nairṛte bhāge brahmadevarṣisaṃsthitaḥ ..
tasyotpattiṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvapātakanāśinīm..3..
16.99.d:
उमाया नैरृते भागे ब्रह्मदेवर्षिसंस्थितः ..
तस्योत्पत्तिं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वपातकनाशिनीम्..3..
16.99.m: to the south-west of Umā, situated among divine seers and Brahmā. / I will proclaim its origin, which destroys all grave sins.

16.99.s:
pauṃḍrako vāsudevastu vārāṇasyāṃ purā'bhavat..
tena śrutaṃ purāṇaṃ tu paṭhyamānaṃ dvijātibhiḥ..4..
16.99.d:
पौंड्रको वासुदेवस्तु वाराणस्यां पुराऽभवत्..
तेन श्रुतं पुराणं तु पठ्यमानं द्विजातिभिः..4..
16.99.m: Formerly there was Pauṇḍraka Vāsudeva in Vārāṇasī. / He heard the Purāṇa being recited by the twice-born:

16.99.s:
kalpādau dvāparāṃte tu kṣatriyāṇāṃ niveśane ..
avatāraṃ mahābāhuvāsudevaḥ kariṣyati .. 5 ..
16.99.d:
कल्पादौ द्वापरांते तु क्षत्रियाणां निवेशने ..
अवतारं महाबाहुवासुदेवः करिष्यति .. 5 ..
16.99.m: 'At the beginning of the kalpa, at the end of the Dvāpara age, in the house of kṣatriyas, / the mighty-armed Vāsudeva will make his incarnation.'

16.99.s:
sa tu mūḍhamatirmene ahaṃ viṣṇuriti priye ..
cihnāni dhārayāmāsa cakrādīni varānane .. 6 ..
16.99.d:
स तु मूढमतिर्मेने अहं विष्णुरिति प्रिये ..
चिह्नानि धारयामास चक्रादीनि वरानने .. 6 ..
16.99.m: Foolish-minded, he thought, 'I am Viṣṇu', O beloved! / He bore the emblems—the discus and the rest, O lovely-faced one!

16.99.s:
sa dūtaṃ preṣayāmāsa dvārakāyāṃ mahodaram ..
sa gatvā prāha viṣṇuṃ vai cakrādīni parityaja .. 7 ..
16.99.d:
स दूतं प्रेषयामास द्वारकायां महोदरम् ..
स गत्वा प्राह विष्णुं वै चक्रादीनि परित्यज .. 7 ..
16.99.m: He sent a large-bellied messenger to Dvārakā. / Having gone, he said to Viṣṇu: 'Abandon the discus and the rest!

16.99.s:
ityāha pauṃḍrako rājā nacedvadhamavā psyasi ..
tataśca bhagavānviṣṇuḥ prāhāsya ruciraṃ vacaḥ .. 8 ..
16.99.d:
इत्याह पौंड्रको राजा नचेद्वधमवा प्स्यसि ..
ततश्च भगवान्विष्णुः प्राहास्य रुचिरं वचः .. 8 ..
16.99.m: Thus speaks King Pauṇḍraka: "If not, you will meet death!"' / Thereupon the blessed Lord Viṣṇu spoke agreeable words to him:

16.99.s:
vācyaḥ sa pauṃḍrako rājā tvayā haṃta vaco mama ..
gṛhītacakra evāhaṃ kāśīmāgamya te purīm .. 9 ..
16.99.d:
वाच्यः स पौंड्रको राजा त्वया हंत वचो मम ..
गृहीतचक्र एवाहं काशीमागम्य ते पुरीम् .. 9 ..
16.99.m: 'Indeed, that King Pauṇḍraka is to be told my words by you: / Taking the discus, having come to your city of Kāśī,

16.99.s:
saṃtyakṣyāmi tataścakraṃ gadāṃ cemāmasaṃśayam ..
tadgrāhyaṃ bhavatā cakramanyadvā yattavepsitam .. 7.1.99.10 ..
16.99.d:
संत्यक्ष्यामि ततश्चक्रं गदां चेमामसंशयम् ..
तद्ग्राह्यं भवता चक्रमन्यद्वा यत्तवेप्सितम् .. 7.1.99.10 ..
16.99.m: I will then cast down the discus and this club without doubt. / That discus must be seized by you, or whatever else you desire.'

16.99.s:
ityukte'tha gate dūte saṃsmṛtyā'bhyā gataṃ hariḥ ..
garutmantaṃ samāruhya tvaritastatpuraṃ yayau .. 11 ..
16.99.d:
इत्युक्तेऽथ गते दूते संस्मृत्याऽभ्या गतं हरिः ..
गरुत्मन्तं समारुह्य त्वरितस्तत्पुरं ययौ .. 11 ..
16.99.m: When this was said and the messenger had departed, Hari, mindful of who had come, / mounted Garuḍa and swiftly set out for that city.

16.99.s:
mitrasnehāttatastasya kāśirājaḥ sahānugaḥ ..
sarvasainyaparīvārastataḥ pauṃḍramupāyayau .. 12 ..
16.99.d:
मित्रस्नेहात्ततस्तस्य काशिराजः सहानुगः ..
सर्वसैन्यपरीवारस्ततः पौंड्रमुपाययौ .. 12 ..
16.99.m: Then, out of friendship for him, the king of Kāśī, along with his followers / and surrounded by his entire army, approached the Pauṇḍra.

16.99.s:
tato balena mahatā kāśirājabalena ca ..
pauṃḍrako vāsudevo'sau keśavābhimukho yayau .. 13..
16.99.d:
ततो बलेन महता काशिराजबलेन च ..
पौंड्रको वासुदेवोऽसौ केशवाभिमुखो ययौ .. 13..
16.99.m: Then, with a great army and the army of the king of Kāśī, / that Pauṇḍraka Vāsudeva marched against Keśava.

16.99.s:
taṃ dadarśa harirdūrāddurvāre syaṃdane sthitam ..
cakrahastaṃ gadāśārṅgasaṃyutaṃ garuḍadhvajam .. 14 ..
16.99.d:
तं ददर्श हरिर्दूराद्दुर्वारे स्यंदने स्थितम् ..
चक्रहस्तं गदाशार्ङ्गसंयुतं गरुडध्वजम् .. 14 ..
16.99.m: From afar Hari saw him standing in an irresistible chariot, / discus in hand, equipped with mace and the Śārṅga bow, and bearing the Garuḍa banner.

16.99.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhāvagaṃbhīraṃ jahāsa garuḍadhvajaḥ ..
uvāca pauṃḍrakaṃ mūḍhamātmacihnopalakṣitam .. 15 ..
16.99.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा भावगंभीरं जहास गरुडध्वजः ..
उवाच पौंड्रकं मूढमात्मचिह्नोपलक्षितम् .. 15 ..
16.99.m: Seeing him so solemn in demeanor, he who has Garuḍa on his banner laughed, / and said to the foolish Pauṇḍraka, who was marked with his own emblems:

16.99.s:
pauṃḍrakoktaṃ tvayā yattu dūtavaktreṇa māṃ prati ..
samutsṛjeti cihnāni tacca sarvaṃ tyajāmyaham .. 16 ..
16.99.d:
पौंड्रकोक्तं त्वया यत्तु दूतवक्त्रेण मां प्रति ..
समुत्सृजेति चिह्नानि तच्च सर्वं त्यजाम्यहम् .. 16 ..
16.99.m: 'Pauṇḍraka, what you said to me through the mouth of the messenger, / saying: "Cast off the emblems!"—all of that I now cast off.

16.99.s:
cakrametatsamutsṛṣṭaṃ gadeyaṃ ca visa rjitā ..
garutmāneṣa te gatvā samārohatu vai dhvajam .. 17 ..
16.99.d:
चक्रमेतत्समुत्सृष्टं गदेयं च विस र्जिता ..
गरुत्मानेष ते गत्वा समारोहतु वै ध्वजम् .. 17 ..
16.99.m: This discus is discharged, and this mace is hurled! / Let this Garuḍa go and perch upon your banner!'

16.99.s:
ityuccārya vimuktena cakreṇāsau nipātitaḥ ..
rathaśca gadayā bhagno gajāścā śvāśca cūrṇitāḥ .. 18 ..
16.99.d:
इत्युच्चार्य विमुक्तेन चक्रेणासौ निपातितः ..
रथश्च गदया भग्नो गजाश्चा श्वाश्च चूर्णिताः .. 18 ..
16.99.m: Having spoken thus, he struck him down with the released discus; / the chariot was shattered with his mace, and the elephants and horses crushed.

16.99.s:
tato hāhākṛte loke kāśinātho mahābalī ..
yuyudhe vāsudevena mitraduḥkhena duḥkhitaḥ .. 19 ..
16.99.d:
ततो हाहाकृते लोके काशिनाथो महाबली ..
युयुधे वासुदेवेन मित्रदुःखेन दुःखितः .. 19 ..
16.99.m: Then, amid the lamentation of the world, the mighty lord of Kāśī / fought with Vāsudeva, aggrieved by the sorrow of his friend.

16.99.s:
tataḥ śārṅgavinirmuktaiśchittvā tasya śaraiḥ śiraḥ ..
kāśīpuryāṃ sa cikṣepa kurvam̐llokasya vismayam .. 7.1.99.20 ..
16.99.d:
ततः शार्ङ्गविनिर्मुक्तैश्छित्त्वा तस्य शरैः शिरः ..
काशीपुर्यां स चिक्षेप कुर्वम्̐ल्लोकस्य विस्मयम् .. 7.1.99.20 ..
16.99.m: Then, severing his head with arrows shot from the Śārṅga bow, / he cast it into the city of Kāśī, causing wonder to the world.

16.99.s:
hatvā tu pauṃḍrakaṃ śauriḥ kāśirājaṃ ca sānu gam ..
punardvāravatīṃ prāpto mṛgayāyā gato yathā .. 21 ..
16.99.d:
हत्वा तु पौंड्रकं शौरिः काशिराजं च सानु गम् ..
पुनर्द्वारवतीं प्राप्तो मृगयाया गतो यथा .. 21 ..
16.99.m: Having slain Pauṇḍraka and the king of Kāśī along with his followers, / Śauri returned to Dvāravatī, like one returning from a hunt.

16.99.s:
tataḥ kāśipateḥ putraḥ piturduḥkhena duḥkhitaḥ ..
śaṃkaraṃ toṣayāmāsa sa ca tasmai varaṃ dadau .. 22 ..
16.99.d:
ततः काशिपतेः पुत्रः पितुर्दुःखेन दुःखितः ..
शंकरं तोषयामास स च तस्मै वरं ददौ .. 22 ..
16.99.m: Then the son of the lord of Kāśī, distressed by grief for his father, / propitiated Śaṃkara, and he granted him a boon.

16.99.s:
sa vavre bhagavankṛtyā piturhaṃturvadhāya me ..
samuttiṣṭhatu kṛṣṇasya tvatprasādātsureśvara .. 23 ..
16.99.d:
स वव्रे भगवन्कृत्या पितुर्हंतुर्वधाय मे ..
समुत्तिष्ठतु कृष्णस्य त्वत्प्रसादात्सुरेश्वर .. 23 ..
16.99.m: He chose: 'O Blessed One, for the slaying of Kṛṣṇa, the killer of my father, / let a malevolent spirit arise by your grace, O lord of the gods!'

16.99.s:
evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyukte dakṣiṇāgnestu madhyataḥ ..
mahākṛtyā samuttasthau prasthitā dvārakāṃ prati .. 24 ..
16.99.d:
एवं भविष्यतीत्युक्ते दक्षिणाग्नेस्तु मध्यतः ..
महाकृत्या समुत्तस्थौ प्रस्थिता द्वारकां प्रति .. 24 ..
16.99.m: When he had said, 'So shall it be,' from the midst of the southern fire / a great malevolent spirit arose and set forth toward Dvārakā.

16.99.s:
jvālāmālākarālāṃ tāṃ yādavā bhayavihvalāḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā janārddanaṃ sarve śaraṇārthamupāgatāḥ .. 25 ..
16.99.d:
ज्वालामालाकरालां तां यादवा भयविह्वलाः ..
दृष्ट्वा जनार्द्दनं सर्वे शरणार्थमुपागताः .. 25 ..
16.99.m: Seeing her terrible with a garland of flames, the Yādavas, overwhelmed with fear, / all went to Janārdana for refuge.

16.99.s:
tataḥ sudarśanaṃ tasyā mumoca garuḍadhvajaḥ ..
vadhāya sā tato bhagnā cakratejo'bhipīḍitā .. 26 ..
16.99.d:
ततः सुदर्शनं तस्या मुमोच गरुडध्वजः ..
वधाय सा ततो भग्ना चक्रतेजोऽभिपीडिता .. 26 ..
16.99.m: Then he who has Garuḍa on his banner released the Sudarśana [discus] for her destruction; / tormented by the splendour of the discus, she fled.

16.99.s:
kṛtyāmanujagāmāśu viṣṇoścakraṃ sudarśanam ..
kṛtyā vārāṇasīṃ prāptā tasyāścakraṃ tu pṛṣṭhataḥ .. 27 ..
16.99.d:
कृत्यामनुजगामाशु विष्णोश्चक्रं सुदर्शनम् ..
कृत्या वाराणसीं प्राप्ता तस्याश्चक्रं तु पृष्ठतः .. 27 ..
16.99.m: Viṣṇu's Sudarśana discus swiftly pursued the malevolent spirit; / the malevolent spirit reached Vārāṇasī, with the discus right behind her.

16.99.s:
tataḥ sā bhayasaṃtrastā śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ gatā ..
somanāthaṃ jagannāthaṃ nānyaḥ śakto hi rakṣitum .. 28 ..
16.99.d:
ततः सा भयसंत्रस्ता शंकरं शरणं गता ..
सोमनाथं जगन्नाथं नान्यः शक्तो हि रक्षितुम् .. 28 ..
16.99.m: Then, terrified with fear, she sought refuge with Śaṃkara, / Somanātha, the lord of the world, for no other was able to protect her.

16.99.s:
tataścakraṃ varairbāṇaistāḍayāmāsa śaṃkaraḥ ..
tacca dvāravatīṃ prāptaṃ śivasāyakamiśritam .. 29 ..
16.99.d:
ततश्चक्रं वरैर्बाणैस्ताडयामास शंकरः ..
तच्च द्वारवतीं प्राप्तं शिवसायकमिश्रितम् .. 29 ..
16.99.m: Then Śaṃkara struck the discus with excellent arrows; / and it reached Dvāravatī, pierced with the arrows of Śiva.

16.99.s:
taddṛṣṭvā śivanāmāṃkaistāḍitaṃ bhagavānhariḥ ..
cakraṃ śaraistataḥ kuddho gṛhītvā ca kareṇa tat ..
jagāma tatra yatrāste someśaḥ kālabhairavaḥ .. 7.1.99.30
sa gatvā roṣa tāmrākṣaścakrodyatakaraḥ sthitaḥ ..
kṛtyāṃ haṃtuṃ matiṃ cakre kālabhairavanirmitām .. 31 ..
16.99.d:
तद्दृष्ट्वा शिवनामांकैस्ताडितं भगवान्हरिः ..
चक्रं शरैस्ततः कुद्धो गृहीत्वा च करेण तत् ..
जगाम तत्र यत्रास्ते सोमेशः कालभैरवः .. 7.1.99.30
स गत्वा रोष ताम्राक्षश्चक्रोद्यतकरः स्थितः ..
कृत्यां हंतुं मतिं चक्रे कालभैरवनिर्मिताम् .. 31 ..
16.99.m:
Seeing that disc struck by arrows inscribed with Śiva's name, the blessed Hari, enraged, grasped it with his hand
and went to the place where Someśa, who is Kālabhairava, was.
Having gone there, his eyes copper-red with rage, his hand raising the disc, he stood
and resolved to destroy the kṛtyā fashioned by Kālabhairava.

16.99.s:
dṛṣṭo devaistataḥ sarvaidaṃḍapāṇigaṇena ca ..
devānāṃ prekṣatāṃ tatra daṇḍapāṇirmahāgaṇaḥ ..
cakrodyatakaraṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇuṃ prāhābjalocanam .. 32 ..
16.99.d:
दृष्टो देवैस्ततः सर्वैदंडपाणिगणेन च ..
देवानां प्रेक्षतां तत्र दण्डपाणिर्महागणः ..
चक्रोद्यतकरं दृष्ट्वा विष्णुं प्राहाब्जलोचनम् .. 32 ..
16.99.m:
Then he was seen by all the gods and by the gaṇa Daṇḍapāṇi.
While the gods were watching there, the great gaṇa Daṇḍapāṇi,
seeing Viṣṇu, whose eyes are like lotus petals, with his hand raising the disc, spoke:

16.99.s:
.. daṃḍapāṇiruvāca .. ..
mā krodhaṃ kuru deveśa kṛtyāṃ prati jagatprabho .. 33 ..
16.99.d:
.. दंडपाणिरुवाच .. ..
मा क्रोधं कुरु देवेश कृत्यां प्रति जगत्प्रभो .. 33 ..
16.99.m:
Daṇḍapāṇi said:
Do not direct your anger against the kṛtyā, O Lord of gods, O master of the universe!

16.99.s:
amoghaṃ yudhi te cakraṃ kṛtyā cāpi ca śāṃkarī ..
evaṃ cakra vinirmukte bhavetkodho hare yadi ..
bhaviṣyati mahadduḥkhaṃ lokānāṃ saṃkṣayo hi vā .. 34 ..
16.99.d:
अमोघं युधि ते चक्रं कृत्या चापि च शांकरी ..
एवं चक्र विनिर्मुक्ते भवेत्कोधो हरे यदि ..
भविष्यति महद्दुःखं लोकानां संक्षयो हि वा .. 34 ..
16.99.m:
Unfailing in battle is your disc, and so too is the kṛtyā belonging to Śaṃkara.
If anger should thus arise when the disc is released, O Hari,
there will be great suffering, or indeed the destruction of the worlds.

16.99.s:
na moktavyamataścakra śṛṇu bhūyo vacaśca naḥ ..
atra sthāne niyukto'haṃ śaṃkareṇa purā hare .. 35..
16.99.d:
न मोक्तव्यमतश्चक्र शृणु भूयो वचश्च नः ..
अत्र स्थाने नियुक्तोऽहं शंकरेण पुरा हरे .. 35..
16.99.m:
Therefore the disc should not be released; hear further our word:
Formerly, O Hari, I was appointed to this place by Śaṃkara

16.99.s:
pāpināṃ rakṣaṇārthaṃ vai vighnārthaṃ duṣṭacetasām..
tasmāttvaṃ mama sāṃnidhye tiṣṭha cakradharo hare ..36 ..
16.99.d:
पापिनां रक्षणार्थं वै विघ्नार्थं दुष्टचेतसाम्..
तस्मात्त्वं मम सांनिध्ये तिष्ठ चक्रधरो हरे ..36 ..
16.99.m:
for the protection of sinners and for creating obstacles for the evil-minded.
Therefore, O Hari, bearer of the disc, remain in my presence.

16.99.s:
atra cakradharaṃ devaṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti mānavāḥ ..
dhūpamālyopahāraiśca naivedyairvivi dhairapi .. 37 ..
16.99.d:
अत्र चक्रधरं देवं पूजयिष्यंति मानवाः ..
धूपमाल्योपहारैश्च नैवेद्यैर्विवि धैरपि .. 37 ..
16.99.m:
Here mortals will worship the disc-bearing God
with incense, garlands, offerings, and varied foods.

16.99.s:
.. viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
eṣa eva nivṛttohaṃ tava vākyāṃkuśena vai ..
atra cakrodyatakaraḥ sthāsye tava samīpataḥ .. 38 ..
16.99.d:
.. विष्णुरुवाच .. ..
एष एव निवृत्तोहं तव वाक्यांकुशेन वै ..
अत्र चक्रोद्यतकरः स्थास्ये तव समीपतः .. 38 ..
16.99.m:
Viṣṇu said:
Indeed, I have desisted, restrained by the goad of your words.
I shall remain near you here, with my hand raising the disc.

16.99.s:
evaṃ hi sthitodevastatra cakradharaḥ priye ..
daṃḍapāṇiśca bhagavānmama rūpī gaṇeśvaraḥ .. 39 ..
16.99.d:
एवं हि स्थितोदेवस्तत्र चक्रधरः प्रिये ..
दंडपाणिश्च भगवान्मम रूपी गणेश्वरः .. 39 ..
16.99.m:
Thus indeed, O beloved, the disc-bearing God remained there,
as did the blessed Daṇḍapāṇi, lord of the gaṇas, who is my own form.

16.99.s:
yastau pūjayate bhaktyā daṃḍapāṇiharī kramāt ..
sa pāpa kaṃcukairmukto gacchecchivapuraṃ naraḥ .. 7.1.99.40 ..
16.99.d:
यस्तौ पूजयते भक्त्या दंडपाणिहरी क्रमात् ..
स पाप कंचुकैर्मुक्तो गच्छेच्छिवपुरं नरः .. 7.1.99.40 ..
16.99.m:
Whatever person devoutly worships both, Daṇḍapāṇi and Hari, in sequence,
freed from the cloaks of sin, shall go to Śiva's city.

16.99.s:
māghe māsi caturddaśyāṃ kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
gaṃdhadhūpopahārairyaḥ pūjayeddaṇḍanāyakam ..
tasya kṣetre nivasato na vighnaṃ jāyate kvacit .. 41 ..
16.99.d:
माघे मासि चतुर्द्दश्यां कृष्णाष्टम्यां विशेषतः ..
गंधधूपोपहारैर्यः पूजयेद्दण्डनायकम् ..
तस्य क्षेत्रे निवसतो न विघ्नं जायते क्वचित् .. 41 ..
16.99.m:
In the month of Māgha, on the fourteenth day, and especially on the dark eighth,
whoever worships the commander of the rod with perfumes, incenses, and gifts—
no obstacle ever arises for him as he dwells in the sacred field.

16.99.s:
ekādaśyāṃ jitāhāro yo'rcayeccakrapāṇinam ..
sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvairyāti viṣṇoḥ salokatām .. 42 ..
16.99.d:
एकादश्यां जिताहारो योऽर्चयेच्चक्रपाणिनम् ..
स मुक्तः पातकैः सर्वैर्याति विष्णोः सलोकताम् .. 42 ..
16.99.m:
Whoever, having mastered his diet, worships the disc-wielding God on the eleventh day,
freed from all grave sins, attains the same world as Viṣṇu.

16.99.s:
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ cakrapāṇinaḥ ..
daṇḍapāṇigaṇasyāpi śrutaṃ pāpaughanāśanam .. 43 ..
16.99.d:
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं माहात्म्यं चक्रपाणिनः ..
दण्डपाणिगणस्यापि श्रुतं पापौघनाशनम् .. 43 ..
16.99.m:
Thus the māhātmya of the disc-wielding God has been declared in brief,
and also that of the gaṇa Daṇḍapāṇi, which destroys floods of sin when heard.

16.99.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye madhyayātrāyāṃ daṇḍapāṇicakradharamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmekonaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..99.. .. cha .. .. ..
16.99.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां सहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये मध्ययात्रायां दण्डपाणिचक्रधरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामेकोनशततमोऽध्यायः ..99.. .. छ .. .. ..
16.99.m: Thus ends the ninety-ninth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Māhātmya of Daṇḍapāṇi and Cakradhara," in the Middle Pilgrimage, in the first part, the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.100.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tayoruttarasaṃsthitam ..
tathā vāyavyadigbhāge brahmaṇo bālarūpiṇaḥ .. 1 ..
16.100.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तयोरुत्तरसंस्थितम् ..
तथा वायव्यदिग्भागे ब्रह्मणो बालरूपिणः .. 1 ..
16.100.m:
Īśvara said:
Then, O great goddess, one should go to that which stands to the north of both of them,
and likewise to the northwest of Brahmā in the form of a child,

16.100.s:
sāṃbādityaṃ suraśreṣṭhe yaḥ sāṃbena pratiṣṭhitaḥ ..
sthānāni trīṇi devasya dvīpe'sminbhāskarasya tu .. 2 ..
16.100.d:
सांबादित्यं सुरश्रेष्ठे यः सांबेन प्रतिष्ठितः ..
स्थानानि त्रीणि देवस्य द्वीपेऽस्मिन्भास्करस्य तु .. 2 ..
16.100.m:
to Sāmbāditya, O best of the gods, which was established by Sāmba.
For there are three places of the god, the Sun, on this island-continent:

16.100.s:
pūrvaṃ mitravanaṃ nāma tathā muṇḍīramucyate ..
prabhāsakṣetramāsthāya sāṃbādityastṛtīyakaḥ .. 3 ..
16.100.d:
पूर्वं मित्रवनं नाम तथा मुण्डीरमुच्यते ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रमास्थाय सांबादित्यस्तृतीयकः .. 3 ..
16.100.m:
the first is called Mitravana, and likewise Muṇḍīra;
and relying upon Prabhāsa sacred field, Sāmbāditya is the third.

16.100.s:
tasminkṣetre mahādevi puraṃ yatsāṃbasaṃjñakam ..
dvitīyaṃ śāśvataṃ sthānaṃ tatra sūryasya nityaśaḥ .. 4 ..
16.100.d:
तस्मिन्क्षेत्रे महादेवि पुरं यत्सांबसंज्ञकम् ..
द्वितीयं शाश्वतं स्थानं तत्र सूर्यस्य नित्यशः .. 4 ..
16.100.m:
In that sacred field, O great goddess, the city named Sāmba
is the eternal second place of the Sun forever.

16.100.s:
prītyā sāṃba sya tatrārko janasyānugrahāya ca ..
tatra dvādaśabhāgena mitro maitreṇa cakṣuṣā .. 5 ..
16.100.d:
प्रीत्या सांब स्य तत्रार्को जनस्यानुग्रहाय च ..
तत्र द्वादशभागेन मित्रो मैत्रेण चक्षुषा .. 5 ..
16.100.m:
Out of affection for Sāmba and for showing grace to people, the Sun is there.
There, as Mitra, with his twelfth portion, through friendly eyes,

16.100.s:
avalokayañjagatsarvaṃ śreyorthaṃ tiṣṭhate sadā ..
prayuktāṃ vidhivatpūjāṃ gṛhṇāti bhagavānsvayam.. 6 ..
16.100.d:
अवलोकयञ्जगत्सर्वं श्रेयोर्थं तिष्ठते सदा ..
प्रयुक्तां विधिवत्पूजां गृह्णाति भगवान्स्वयम्.. 6 ..
16.100.m:
looking upon the entire universe, he always stands for the sake of its well-being.
The Blessed One himself receives the worship offered according to rule.

16.100.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
ko'yaṃ sāṃbaḥ sutaḥ kasya yasya nāmnā raveḥ puram ..
yasya vā'yaṃ sahasrāṃśurvaradaḥ puṇyakarmaṇaḥ ..7..
16.100.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
कोऽयं सांबः सुतः कस्य यस्य नाम्ना रवेः पुरम् ..
यस्य वाऽयं सहस्रांशुर्वरदः पुण्यकर्मणः ..7..
16.100.m:
The Goddess said:
Who is this Sāmba? Whose son is he, by whose name the Sun's city is known,
or to whom, of virtuous deeds, this thousand-rayed Sun is the granter of boons?

16.100.s:
.. .. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ya ete dvādaśādityā virājante mahābalāḥ ..
teṣāṃ yo viṣṇusaṃjñastu sarvalokeṣu viśrutaḥ .. 8 ..
16.100.d:
.. .. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
य एते द्वादशादित्या विराजन्ते महाबलाः ..
तेषां यो विष्णुसंज्ञस्तु सर्वलोकेषु विश्रुतः .. 8 ..
16.100.m:
Īśvara said:
Among these twelve suns of great might who shine forth,
he who is called Viṣṇu is celebrated in all the worlds.
Here that blessed and all-pervading one attained the state of Vāsudeva.

16.100.s:
tasya sāṃbaḥ suto jajñe jāṃbavatyāṃ mahābalaḥ ..
sa tu pitrā bhṛśaṃ śaptaḥ kuṣṭharogamavāptavān ..
tena saṃsthāpitaḥ sūryo nijanāmnā puraṃ kṛtam .. 7.1.100.10 ..
16.100.d:
तस्य सांबः सुतो जज्ञे जांबवत्यां महाबलः ..
स तु पित्रा भृशं शप्तः कुष्ठरोगमवाप्तवान् ..
तेन संस्थापितः सूर्यो निजनाम्ना पुरं कृतम् .. 7.1.100.10 ..
16.100.m:
To him was born by Jāmbavatī a son of great might, Sāmba.
He, severely cursed by his father, contracted leprosy.
By him the Sun was installed, and a city was founded in his own name.

16.100.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
śaptaḥ kasminnimitte'sau pitrā putraḥ svayaṃ punaḥ ..
nālpaṃ syātkāraṇaṃ deva yenāsau śaptavānsutam .. 11 ..
16.100.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
शप्तः कस्मिन्निमित्तेऽसौ पित्रा पुत्रः स्वयं पुनः ..
नाल्पं स्यात्कारणं देव येनासौ शप्तवान्सुतम् .. 11 ..
16.100.m:
The Goddess said:
For what reason was this son cursed by his own father?
The reason for which he cursed his son could not have been minor, O God.

16.100.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇuṣvāvahitā bhūtvā tasya yacchāpakāraṇam ..
durvāsānāma bhagavānmamaivāṃśasamudbhavaḥ .. 12 ..
16.100.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणुष्वावहिता भूत्वा तस्य यच्छापकारणम् ..
दुर्वासानाम भगवान्ममैवांशसमुद्भवः .. 12 ..
16.100.m:
Īśvara said:
Listen attentively to the cause of his curse:
The blessed one named Durvāsas, born from a portion of myself,

16.100.s:
aṭamānaḥ sa bhagavāṃstrīṃllokānpracacāra ha ..
atha prāpto dvāravatīṃ lokāḥ saṃjajñire puraḥ .. 13 ..
16.100.d:
अटमानः स भगवांस्त्रींल्लोकान्प्रचचार ह ..
अथ प्राप्तो द्वारवतीं लोकाः संजज्ञिरे पुरः .. 13 ..
16.100.m:
wandered as a pilgrim through the three worlds.
Then, when he reached Dvāravatī, the people gathered before him.

16.100.s:
tamāgatamṛṣiṃ dṛṣṭvā sāṃbo rūpeṇa garvitaḥ ..
piṃgākṣaṃ jaṭilaṃ rūkṣaṃ visvarūpaṃ kṛśaṃ tathā .. 14 ..
16.100.d:
तमागतमृषिं दृष्ट्वा सांबो रूपेण गर्वितः ..
पिंगाक्षं जटिलं रूक्षं विस्वरूपं कृशं तथा .. 14 ..
16.100.m:
Seeing that seer who had arrived, Sāmba, proud of his beauty—
[seeing the seer] tawny-eyed, matted-haired, harsh, of distorted form, and emaciated—

16.100.s:
avamānaṃ cakārāsau darśanātsparśanāttathā ..
dṛṣṭvā tasya mukhaṃ maṃdo vaktraṃ cakre tathātmanaḥ ..
cakre yadukulaśreṣṭho garvito yauvanena tu .. 15 ..
16.100.d:
अवमानं चकारासौ दर्शनात्स्पर्शनात्तथा ..
दृष्ट्वा तस्य मुखं मंदो वक्त्रं चक्रे तथात्मनः ..
चक्रे यदुकुलश्रेष्ठो गर्वितो यौवनेन तु .. 15 ..

16.100.s:
atha kruddho mahātejā durvāsā ṛṣisattamaḥ ..
sāṃbaṃ provāca bhagavānvidhunvanmukhamātma naḥ .. 16 ..
16.100.d:
अथ क्रुद्धो महातेजा दुर्वासा ऋषिसत्तमः ..
सांबं प्रोवाच भगवान्विधुन्वन्मुखमात्म नः .. 16 ..
16.100.m:
Then the best of seers, the blessed Durvāsas of great splendor, angered,
shaking his head, spoke to Sāmba:

16.100.s:
yasmādvirūpaṃ māṃ dṛṣṭvā ātmarūpeṇa garvitaḥ ..
gamane darśane mahyamahaṃkāraḥ kṛto yataḥ ..
tasmāttvaṃ kuṣṭharogeṇa na cireṇa grasiṣyase .. 17 ..
16.100.d:
यस्माद्विरूपं मां दृष्ट्वा आत्मरूपेण गर्वितः ..
गमने दर्शने मह्यमहंकारः कृतो यतः ..
तस्मात्त्वं कुष्ठरोगेण न चिरेण ग्रसिष्यसे .. 17 ..
16.100.m:
"Since, seeing me deformed, proud of your own beauty,
you showed arrogance toward me in my gait and appearance,
therefore you shall before long be seized by leprosy!"

16.100.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye madhyayātrāyāṃ sāṃbādityamāhātmyopakrame sāṃbāya durvāsasā śāpapradānavarṇanaṃnāma śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 100 ..
16.100.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये मध्ययात्रायां सांबादित्यमाहात्म्योपक्रमे सांबाय दुर्वाससा शापप्रदानवर्णनंनाम शततमोऽध्यायः .. 100 ..
16.100.m: Thus ends the one hundredth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Imparting of the Curse to Sāmba by Durvāsas," at the commencement of the māhātmya of Sāmbāditya, in the Middle Pilgrimage, in the first part, the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.101.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
etasminneva kāle tu nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ ..
brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putrastriṣu lokeṣu garvitaḥ .. 1 ..
16.101.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु नारदो भगवानृषिः ..
ब्रह्मणो मानसः पुत्रस्त्रिषु लोकेषु गर्वितः .. 1 ..
16.101.m:
Īśvara said:
At that very time, the blessed seer Nārada,
mind-born son of Brahmā, celebrated in the three worlds,

16.101.s:
sarvalokacaraḥ so'pi yuvā devanamaskṛtaḥ ..
tathā yadṛcchayā cāyamaṭamānaḥ samaṃtataḥ .. 2 ..
16.101.d:
सर्वलोकचरः सोऽपि युवा देवनमस्कृतः ..
तथा यदृच्छया चायमटमानः समंततः .. 2 ..
16.101.m:
a wanderer through all worlds, youthful, reverenced by gods,
and wandering everywhere at will—

16.101.s:
vāsudevaṃ sa vai draṣṭuṃ nityaṃ dvāravatīṃ purīm ..
āyāti ṛṣibhiḥ sārddhaṃ krodhena ṛṣi sattamaḥ .. 3 ..
16.101.d:
वासुदेवं स वै द्रष्टुं नित्यं द्वारवतीं पुरीम् ..
आयाति ऋषिभिः सार्द्धं क्रोधेन ऋषि सत्तमः .. 3 ..
16.101.m:
to see Vāsudeva, that best of seers
always came to the city of Dvāravatī together with seers, with passion.

16.101.s:
athāśvāgacchatastasya sarve yadukumārakāḥ ..
ye pradyumnaprabhṛtayaste ca prahvānanāḥ sthitāḥ .. 4 ..
16.101.d:
अथाश्वागच्छतस्तस्य सर्वे यदुकुमारकाः ..
ये प्रद्युम्नप्रभृतयस्ते च प्रह्वाननाः स्थिताः .. 4 ..
16.101.m:
Now, as he approached quickly, all the Yadu youths,
Pradyumna and the rest, stood with bowed faces,

16.101.s:
abhāvāccārghyapādyānāṃ pūjāṃ cakruḥ samaṃtataḥ ..
sāṃbastvavaśyabhāvitvāttasya śāpasya kāraṇāt .. 5 ..
16.101.d:
अभावाच्चार्घ्यपाद्यानां पूजां चक्रुः समंततः ..
सांबस्त्ववश्यभावित्वात्तस्य शापस्य कारणात् .. 5 ..
16.101.m:
and for lack of arghya and water for the feet, they offered worship from all sides.
But Sāmba, on account of the inevitability of that curse...

16.101.s:
avajñāṃ kurute nityaṃ nāradasya mahātmanaḥ ..
ratakrīḍā sa vai nityaṃ rūpayauvanagarvitaḥ .. 6 ..
16.101.d:
अवज्ञां कुरुते नित्यं नारदस्य महात्मनः ..
रतक्रीडा स वै नित्यं रूपयौवनगर्वितः .. 6 ..
16.101.m: He constantly showed disrespect to the great-souled Nārada; / he was always engaged in amorous play, arrogant with his beauty and youth. 6

16.101.s:
avinītaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā cintayāmāsa nāradaḥ ..
asyāhamavinītasya kariṣye vinayaṃ śubham .. 7 ..
16.101.d:
अविनीतं तु तं दृष्ट्वा चिन्तयामास नारदः ..
अस्याहमविनीतस्य करिष्ये विनयं शुभम् .. 7 ..
16.101.m: Seeing him ill-mannered, Nārada thought: / 'I will teach this ill-mannered boy proper discipline.' 7

16.101.s:
evaṃ sa cintayitvātu vāsudevamathābravīt ..
imāḥ ṣoḍaśasāhasrāḥ striyo yā devasattama .. 8 ..
16.101.d:
एवं स चिन्तयित्वातु वासुदेवमथाब्रवीत् ..
इमाः षोडशसाहस्राः स्त्रियो या देवसत्तम .. 8 ..
16.101.m: Having thus reflected, he then spoke to Vāsudeva: / 'These sixteen thousand women that exist, O best of gods, 8

16.101.s:
sarvāstāsāṃ sadā sāṃbe bhāvo deva samāśritaḥ ..
rūpeṇāpratimaḥ sāṃbo loke'sminsacarācare .. 9 ..
16.101.d:
सर्वास्तासां सदा सांबे भावो देव समाश्रितः ..
रूपेणाप्रतिमः सांबो लोकेऽस्मिन्सचराचरे .. 9 ..
16.101.m: the affections of all of them are constantly fixed on Sāmba, O god. / Sāmba is peerless in beauty in this world with its moving and unmoving beings. 9

16.101.s:
sadā'rhaṃti ca tāstasya darśanaṃ hyapi satstriyaḥ ..
śrutvaivaṃ nāradādvākyaṃ cintayāmāsa keśavaḥ ..7.1.101.10 ..
16.101.d:
सदाऽर्हंति च तास्तस्य दर्शनं ह्यपि सत्स्त्रियः ..
श्रुत्वैवं नारदाद्वाक्यं चिन्तयामास केशवः ..7.1.101.10 ..
16.101.m: And those noble women constantly deserve the darśana of him.' / Hearing this speech from Nārada, Keśava reflected: 10

16.101.s:
yadetannāradenoktaṃ satyamatra tu kiṃ bhavet ..
evaṃ ca śrūyate loke cāpalyaṃ strīṣu vidyate ..
ślokāvimau purā gītau cittajñairyoṣitāṃ dvijaiḥ .. 11 ..
16.101.d:
यदेतन्नारदेनोक्तं सत्यमत्र तु किं भवेत् ..
एवं च श्रूयते लोके चापल्यं स्त्रीषु विद्यते ..
श्लोकाविमौ पुरा गीतौ चित्तज्ञैर्योषितां द्विजैः .. 11 ..
16.101.m: 'What truth can there be in what Nārada has spoken? / Yet it is heard in the world that fickleness exists in women. / These two verses were sung of old by brahmins who knew the minds of women: 11

16.101.s:
pauṃścalyādaticāpalyādajñānācca svabhāvataḥ ..
rakṣitā yatnato hyetā vikurvaṃti hi bhartṛṣu .. 12 ..
16.101.d:
पौंश्चल्यादतिचापल्यादज्ञानाच्च स्वभावतः ..
रक्षिता यत्नतो ह्येता विकुर्वंति हि भर्तृषु .. 12 ..
16.101.m: "Due to unchastity, extreme fickleness, and ignorance born of their very nature, / even when guarded with effort, they indeed act perversely towards their husbands. 12

16.101.s:
naitā rūpaṃ parīkṣaṃte nā''sāṃ vayasi saṃśrayaḥ ..
surūpaṃ vā virūpaṃ vā pumānityeva bhuṃjate .. 13 ..
16.101.d:
नैता रूपं परीक्षंते ना'ऽसां वयसि संश्रयः ..
सुरूपं वा विरूपं वा पुमानित्येव भुंजते .. 13 ..
16.101.m: They do not examine beauty, nor do they care about age; / whether handsome or deformed, they enjoy him simply because he is a man." 13

16.101.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
manasā cintayitvaivaṃ kṛṣṇo nāradamabravīt ..
nahyahaṃ śraddadhāmyetadyadetadbhāṣitaṃ purā .. 14 ..
16.101.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
मनसा चिन्तयित्वैवं कृष्णो नारदमब्रवीत् ..
नह्यहं श्रद्दधाम्येतद्यदेतद्भाषितं पुरा .. 14 ..
16.101.m: Īśvara said: / Reflecting thus in his mind, Kṛṣṇa spoke to Nārada: / 'I do not believe this that was just spoken.' 14

16.101.s:
bruvāṇamevaṃ devaṃ tu nāradaḥ pratyuvāca ha ..
tathāhaṃ tu kariṣyāmi yathā śraddhāsyate bhavān .. 15 ..
16.101.d:
ब्रुवाणमेवं देवं तु नारदः प्रत्युवाच ह ..
तथाहं तु करिष्यामि यथा श्रद्धास्यते भवान् .. 15 ..
16.101.m: To the god speaking thus, Nārada replied: / 'I shall act in such a way that you will believe.' 15

16.101.s:
evamuktvā yayau bhūyo nāradastu yathāgatam ..
tataḥ katipayāhasya dvārakāṃ punarabhyagāt .. 16 ..
16.101.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ययौ भूयो नारदस्तु यथागतम् ..
ततः कतिपयाहस्य द्वारकां पुनरभ्यगात् .. 16 ..
16.101.m: Having spoken thus, Nārada departed as he had come; / then, after several days, he came back to Dvārakā. 16

16.101.s:
tasminnahani devo'pi sahāṃtaḥpaurakairjanaiḥ ..
anubhūya jalakrīḍāṃ pānamāsevate rahaḥ .. 17 ..
16.101.d:
तस्मिन्नहनि देवोऽपि सहांतःपौरकैर्जनैः ..
अनुभूय जलक्रीडां पानमासेवते रहः .. 17 ..
16.101.m: On that day, the god too, together with the women of the inner apartments, / having enjoyed water-sports, was drinking in secret 17

16.101.s:
ramye raivatakodyāne nānādrumavibhūṣite ..
sarvartukusumairnityaṃ vāsite sarvakāmane .. 18 ..
16.101.d:
रम्ये रैवतकोद्याने नानाद्रुमविभूषिते ..
सर्वर्तुकुसुमैर्नित्यं वासिते सर्वकामने .. 18 ..
16.101.m: in the delightful Raivataka park, adorned with various trees, / constantly perfumed with flowers of all seasons, fulfilling all desires, 18

16.101.s:
nānājalajaphullābhirdīrghikā bhiralaṃkṛte ..
haṃsasārasasaṃghuṣṭe cakravākopaśobhite ..19 ..
16.101.d:
नानाजलजफुल्लाभिर्दीर्घिका भिरलंकृते ..
हंससारससंघुष्टे चक्रवाकोपशोभिते ..19 ..
16.101.m: adorned with elongated ponds radiant with various blossoming water-lilies, / resonant with swans and sārusa cranes, beautified by cakravāka birds. 19

16.101.s:
tasminsa ramate devaḥ strībhiḥ parivṛtastadā ..
hāranūpurakeyūrarasanādyairvibhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 7.1.101.20 ..
16.101.d:
तस्मिन्स रमते देवः स्त्रीभिः परिवृतस्तदा ..
हारनूपुरकेयूररसनाद्यैर्विभूषणैः .. 7.1.101.20 ..
16.101.m: There the god took delight, surrounded then by women / adorned with necklaces, anklets, armlets, girdles, and other ornaments, 20

16.101.s:
bhūṣitānāṃ varastrīṇāṃ sarvāṃgīṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
tatrasthaḥ pibate pānaṃ śubhagandhānvitaṃ śubham .. 21 ..
16.101.d:
भूषितानां वरस्त्रीणां सर्वांगीणां विशेषतः ..
तत्रस्थः पिबते पानं शुभगन्धान्वितं शुभम् .. 21 ..
16.101.m: the excellent women adorned especially on every limb. / Staying there, he drank delightful liquor endowed with a pleasing aroma. 21

16.101.s:
etasminnaṃtare buddhvā madyamattāstataḥ striyaḥ ..
uvāca nāradaḥ sāṃbamasmiṃstiṣṭha kumāraka .. 22 ..
16.101.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे बुद्ध्वा मद्यमत्तास्ततः स्त्रियः ..
उवाच नारदः सांबमस्मिंस्तिष्ठ कुमारक .. 22 ..
16.101.m: Meanwhile, perceiving that the women were intoxicated by wine, / Nārada spoke to Sāmba: 'Stay here, young prince. 22

16.101.s:
tvāṃ samāhvayate devo na yuktaṃ sthātumatra te ..
tadvākyārthamabuddhvaiva nāradenātha noditaḥ .. 23 ..
16.101.d:
त्वां समाह्वयते देवो न युक्तं स्थातुमत्र ते ..
तद्वाक्यार्थमबुद्ध्वैव नारदेनाथ नोदितः .. 23 ..
16.101.m: The god is calling for you; it is not fitting for you to remain here.' / Not grasping the meaning of those words, urged on then by Nārada, 23

16.101.s:
gatvā tu satvaraṃ sāṃbaḥ praṇāmamakarotpituḥ ..
nirddiṣṭamāsanaṃ bheje yathābhāvena viṣṇunā .. 24 ..
16.101.d:
गत्वा तु सत्वरं सांबः प्रणाममकरोत्पितुः ..
निर्द्दिष्टमासनं भेजे यथाभावेन विष्णुना .. 24 ..
16.101.m: Sāmba went quickly and bowed to his father. / He occupied the seat pointed out to him affectionately by Viṣṇu. 24

16.101.s:
etasminnaṃtare tatra yāstu vai cālpasāttvikāḥ ..
tā dṛṣṭvā sahasā sāṃbaṃ sarvāścukṣubhire striyaḥ .. 25 ..
16.101.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तत्र यास्तु वै चाल्पसात्त्विकाः ..
ता दृष्ट्वा सहसा सांबं सर्वाश्चुक्षुभिरे स्त्रियः .. 25 ..
16.101.m: Meanwhile, those women who were deficient in purity of mind, / all became agitated at once upon seeing Sāmba. 25

16.101.s:
na sa dṛṣṭaḥ purā yābhiraṃtaḥpuranivāsibhiḥ ..
madyadoṣāttatastāsāṃ smṛtilopāttathā bahu ..26 ..
16.101.d:
न स दृष्टः पुरा याभिरंतःपुरनिवासिभिः ..
मद्यदोषात्ततस्तासां स्मृतिलोपात्तथा बहु ..26 ..
16.101.m: He had not been seen before by those who resided in the inner apartments; / then, due to the fault of wine, and likewise from a great loss of memory, 26

16.101.s:
svabhāvato'lpasattvānāṃ jaghanāni visusruvuḥ ..
śrūyate cāpyayaṃ ślokaḥ purāṇaprathitaḥ kṣitau .. 27 ..
brahmacarye'pi varttaṃtyā yoginyā vā pramādataḥ ..
prakṛṣṭaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā varāṃgaṃ klidyate striyāḥ .. 27 ..
16.101.d:
स्वभावतोऽल्पसत्त्वानां जघनानि विसुस्रुवुः ..
श्रूयते चाप्ययं श्लोकः पुराणप्रथितः क्षितौ .. 27 ..
ब्रह्मचर्येऽपि वर्त्तंत्या योगिन्या वा प्रमादतः ..
प्रकृष्टं पुरुषं दृष्ट्वा वरांगं क्लिद्यते स्त्रियाः .. 27 ..
16.101.m:
the loins of those women, who were naturally deficient in moral strength, began to ooze. / And this verse, celebrated in the purāṇas on earth, is heard: 27
"Even of a woman observing celibacy, or a female ascetic, through heedlessness, / upon seeing an eminent man, the private parts become moist." 28

16.101.s:
loke'pi dṛśyate hyetanmadyasyāpyatha sevanāt ..
lajjāṃ muṃcaṃti niḥśaṃkā hrīmatyo hyapi ca striyaḥ .. 29 ..
16.101.d:
लोकेऽपि दृश्यते ह्येतन्मद्यस्याप्यथ सेवनात् ..
लज्जां मुंचंति निःशंका ह्रीमत्यो ह्यपि च स्त्रियः .. 29 ..
16.101.m: In the world, too, this is seen: from the indulgence in wine, / even modest women cast off shame and become shameless. 29

16.101.s:
samāṃsairbhojanaiḥ snigdhaiḥ pānaiḥ sīdhusurāsavaiḥ ..
gaṃdhairmanojñairvastraiśca kāmaḥ strīṣu vijṛṃbhati .. 7.1.101.30 ..
16.101.d:
समांसैर्भोजनैः स्निग्धैः पानैः सीधुसुरासवैः ..
गंधैर्मनोज्ञैर्वस्त्रैश्च कामः स्त्रीषु विजृंभति .. 7.1.101.30 ..
16.101.m: Through meals with meat, rich foods, drinks like sīdhu, surā, and āsava, / and fragrant, charming garments, passion expands in women. 30

16.101.s:
madyaṃ na deyamatyarthaṃ puruṣeṇa vipaścitā ..
madonmattāḥ svabhāvena pūrvaṃ saṃti yataḥ striyaḥ .. 31 ..
16.101.d:
मद्यं न देयमत्यर्थं पुरुषेण विपश्चिता ..
मदोन्मत्ताः स्वभावेन पूर्वं संति यतः स्त्रियः .. 31 ..
16.101.m: Liquor should not be given in excess by a wise man, / since women by nature are already intoxicated by passion. 31

16.101.s:
nārado'pyatha taṃ sāṃbaṃ preṣayitvā tvarānvitaḥ ..
ājagāmātha tatraiva sāṃbasyānupadena tu .. 32 ..
16.101.d:
नारदोऽप्यथ तं सांबं प्रेषयित्वा त्वरान्वितः ..
आजगामाथ तत्रैव सांबस्यानुपदेन तु .. 32 ..
16.101.m: Nārada too, having sent Sāmba, with haste / came to that very place, right on Sāmba's footsteps. 32

16.101.s:
āyāṃtaṃ tāḥ svayaṃ dṛṣṭvā priyasaumanasaṃ munim..
sahasaivotthitāḥ sarvā madonmattā api striyaḥ .. 33 ..
16.101.d:
आयांतं ताः स्वयं दृष्ट्वा प्रियसौमनसं मुनिम्..
सहसैवोत्थिताः सर्वा मदोन्मत्ता अपि स्त्रियः .. 33 ..
16.101.m: Seeing the sage approaching on his own, the dear friend of pleasant mind, / all the women, though intoxicated by wine, stood up at once. 33

16.101.s:
tāsāmathotthitānāṃ tu vāsudevasya paśyataḥ ..
bhittvā vāsāṃsyanarghāṇi pātreṣu patitāni tu ..34..
16.101.d:
तासामथोत्थितानां तु वासुदेवस्य पश्यतः ..
भित्त्वा वासांस्यनर्घाणि पात्रेषु पतितानि तु ..34..
16.101.m: As they rose, before the eyes of Vāsudeva, / their priceless garments tore and fell into their drinking cups, 34

16.101.s:
jaghaneṣu vilagnāni tāni petuḥ pṛthakpṛthak ..
taddṛṣṭvā tu hariḥ kuddhastāḥ śaśāpa tato'balāḥ .. 35 ..
16.101.d:
जघनेषु विलग्नानि तानि पेतुः पृथक्पृथक् ..
तद्दृष्ट्वा तु हरिः कुद्धस्ताः शशाप ततोऽबलाः .. 35 ..
16.101.m: and clinging to their hips, they slipped down one by one. / Seeing that, Hari was enraged and then cursed the women: 35

16.101.s:
yasmādgatāni cetāṃsi māṃ muktvā'nyatra vaḥ striyaḥ ..
tasmātpatikṛtām̐llokānāyuṣoṃ'te na yāsyatha .. .. 36 ..
16.101.d:
यस्माद्गतानि चेतांसि मां मुक्त्वाऽन्यत्र वः स्त्रियः ..
तस्मात्पतिकृताम्̐ल्लोकानायुषोंऽते न यास्यथ .. .. 36 ..
16.101.m: 'Since your minds, forsaking me, have gone elsewhere, O women, / therefore at the end of your lives you will not reach the worlds earned by your husband. 36

16.101.s:
patilokātparibhraṣṭāḥ svargamārgāttathaiva ca ..
bhūtvā hyaśaraṇā bhūyo dasyuhastaṃ gamiṣyatha .. 37 ..
16.101.d:
पतिलोकात्परिभ्रष्टाः स्वर्गमार्गात्तथैव च ..
भूत्वा ह्यशरणा भूयो दस्युहस्तं गमिष्यथ .. 37 ..
16.101.m: Cast down from the world of your husband and likewise from the path to heaven, / becoming utterly helpless, you will fall into the hands of robbers.' 37

16.101.s:
śāpadoṣāttatastasmāttāḥ striyo gāṃ gate harau ..
hṛtāḥ pāṃcanadaiścaurairarjunasya prapaśyataḥ .. 38 ..
16.101.d:
शापदोषात्ततस्तस्मात्ताः स्त्रियो गां गते हरौ ..
हृताः पांचनदैश्चौरैरर्जुनस्य प्रपश्यतः .. 38 ..
16.101.m: Then, due to the evil effect of that curse, when Hari went to heaven, / those women were carried off by thieves from the land of the five rivers while Arjuna watched. 38

16.101.s:
alpasattvāśca yāścāsaṃstā gatā dūṣaṇaṃ striyaḥ ..
rukmiṇī satyabhāmā ca tathā jāṃbavatī priye .. 39 ..
16.101.d:
अल्पसत्त्वाश्च याश्चासंस्ता गता दूषणं स्त्रियः ..
रुक्मिणी सत्यभामा च तथा जांबवती प्रिये .. 39 ..
16.101.m: Those women who were deficient in moral strength were ruined. / Rukmiṇī, Satyabhāmā, and likewise Jāmbavatī, O beloved, 35

16.101.s:
na prāptā dasyuhastaṃ tāḥ svena sattvena rakṣitāḥ ..
śaptvaivaṃ tāḥ striyaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sāṃbamapyaśapatpunaḥ..7.1.101.40..
16.101.d:
न प्राप्ता दस्युहस्तं ताः स्वेन सत्त्वेन रक्षिताः ..
शप्त्वैवं ताः स्त्रियः कृष्णः सांबमप्यशपत्पुनः..7.1.101.40..
16.101.m: did not fall into the hands of robbers, protected by their own moral strength. / Having thus cursed those women, Kṛṣṇa also cursed Sāmba: 40

16.101.s:
yasmādatīva te kāṃtaṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpamimāḥ striyaḥ ..
kṣubdhāḥ sarvā yatastasmātkuṣṭharogamavāpnuhi .. 41 ..
16.101.d:
यस्मादतीव ते कांतं दृष्ट्वा रूपमिमाः स्त्रियः ..
क्षुब्धाः सर्वा यतस्तस्मात्कुष्ठरोगमवाप्नुहि .. 41 ..
16.101.m: 'Since all these women became agitated upon seeing your exceedingly charming form, / therefore, may you be afflicted with leprosy!' 41

16.101.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sāṃbo lajjāsamanvitaḥ..
uvāca prahasanvākyaṃ sa smarannṛṣisattamam .. 42 ..
16.101.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सांबो लज्जासमन्वितः..
उवाच प्रहसन्वाक्यं स स्मरन्नृषिसत्तमम् .. 42 ..
16.101.m: Hearing that speech of his, Sāmba, filled with shame, / spoke laughing, remembering the best of ṛṣis: 42

16.101.s:
animittamahaṃ tāta bhāvadoṣavivarjitaḥ ..
śapto na me'tra vai kuddho durvāsā nānyathā vadet .. 43 ..
16.101.d:
अनिमित्तमहं तात भावदोषविवर्जितः ..
शप्तो न मेऽत्र वै कुद्धो दुर्वासा नान्यथा वदेत् .. 43 ..
16.101.m: 'Without cause, father, and free from any evil intent, / I have been cursed; Durvāsas, angry at me, would not speak otherwise.' 43

16.101.s:
evamuktvā tataḥ sāṃbaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ kamalalocanam ..
tato vairāgyasaṃyuktaścintāśokaparāyaṇaḥ .. 44 ..
16.101.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततः सांबः कृष्णं कमललोचनम् ..
ततो वैराग्यसंयुक्तश्चिन्ताशोकपरायणः .. 44 ..
16.101.m: Having spoken thus to the lotus-eyed Kṛṣṇa, / Sāmba, filled with dispassion and overwhelmed with anxiety and grief, 44

16.101.s:
prabhāsakṣetramagamatsarvapātakanāśanam ..
evaṃ tatkṣetramāsādya tapastepe sudāruṇam .. 45 ..
16.101.d:
प्रभासक्षेत्रमगमत्सर्वपातकनाशनम् ..
एवं तत्क्षेत्रमासाद्य तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम् .. 45 ..
16.101.m: went to the Prabhāsa sacred field, the destroyer of all sins. / Having thus reached that sacred field, he performed very severe tapas. 45

16.101.s:
pratiṣṭhāpya sahasrāṃśuṃ devaṃ pāpaniṣūdanam ..
tataścārādhayāmāsa paraṃ niyamamāśritaḥ .. 46 ..
16.101.d:
प्रतिष्ठाप्य सहस्रांशुं देवं पापनिषूदनम् ..
ततश्चाराधयामास परं नियममाश्रितः .. 46 ..
16.101.m: Having installed the thousand-rayed god, the destroyer of sins, / he then worshipped him, observing the highest vow. 46

16.101.s:
trisaṃdhyaṃ pūjayāmāsa divyagaṃdhānulepanaiḥ ..
stotreṇānena bhaktyā vai stauti nityaṃ dinādhipam .. 47 ..
16.101.d:
त्रिसंध्यं पूजयामास दिव्यगंधानुलेपनैः ..
स्तोत्रेणानेन भक्त्या वै स्तौति नित्यं दिनाधिपम् .. 47 ..
16.101.m: At the three junctures of the day, he worshipped him with divine perfumes and ointments; / with devotion, he continually praised the lord of the day with this hymn. 47

16.101.s:
.. sāṃba uvāca .. ..
namastrailokyadīpāya namaste timirāpaha ..
namaḥ paṃkajanāthāya namaḥ kumudaśatrave .. 48 ..
16.101.d:
.. सांब उवाच .. ..
नमस्त्रैलोक्यदीपाय नमस्ते तिमिरापह ..
नमः पंकजनाथाय नमः कुमुदशत्रवे .. 48 ..
16.101.m: Sāmba said: / 'Salutations to the lamp of the three worlds! Salutations to you, O destroyer of darkness! / Salutations to the lord of the lotus! Salutations to the enemy of the night-lotus! 48

16.101.s:
namo jagatpratiṣṭhāya jagaddhātre namo'stu te ..
devadeva namasyāmi sūryaṃ trailokyadīpakam .. 49 ..
16.101.d:
नमो जगत्प्रतिष्ठाय जगद्धात्रे नमोऽस्तु ते ..
देवदेव नमस्यामि सूर्यं त्रैलोक्यदीपकम् .. 49 ..
16.101.m: Homage to the foundation of the world, homage be to you, the sustainer of the world! / God of gods, I bow to Sūrya, the lamp of the three worlds.

16.101.s:
ādityavarṇo bhuvanasya goptā apūrva eṣa prathamaḥ surāṇām ..
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ puruṣo mahātmā sa paṭhyate vai tamasaḥ parastāt .. 7.1.101.50 ..
16.101.d:
आदित्यवर्णो भुवनस्य गोप्ता अपूर्व एष प्रथमः सुराणाम् ..
हिरण्यगर्भः पुरुषो महात्मा स पठ्यते वै तमसः परस्तात् .. 7.1.101.50 ..
16.101.m: Having the color of the sun, the protector of the universe, this wondrous first of the gods, / Hiraṇyagarbha, the great-souled Puruṣa—he is truly proclaimed beyond darkness.

16.101.s:
iti stutastadā sūryaḥ prasannenāṃtarātmanā ..
uvāca darśanaṃ gatvā sāṃbaṃ jāṃbavatīsutam .. 51 ..
16.101.d:
इति स्तुतस्तदा सूर्यः प्रसन्नेनांतरात्मना ..
उवाच दर्शनं गत्वा सांबं जांबवतीसुतम् .. 51 ..
16.101.m: Thus praised at that time, Sūrya, with a gracious heart, / approached and appeared before Sāmba, the son of Jāmbavatī, and said:

16.101.s:
sāṃbasāṃba mahāvāho śṛṇu govindanandane ..
stotreṇānena tuṣṭo'haṃ varaṃ brūhi yadīpsitam .. 52 ..
16.101.d:
सांबसांब महावाहो शृणु गोविन्दनन्दने ..
स्तोत्रेणानेन तुष्टोऽहं वरं ब्रूहि यदीप्सितम् .. 52 ..
16.101.m: “O Sāmba, O Sāmba of mighty arms, listen, O son of Govinda! / I am pleased by this hymn; choose the boon you desire.”

16.101.s:
.. sāṃba uvāca .. ..
kṛṣṇenāhaṃ suraśreṣṭha śaptaḥ pāpaḥ sudurmatiḥ ..
kuṣṭhāṃtaṃ kuru me deva yadi tuṣṭo'si me prabho .. 53 ..
16.101.d:
.. सांब उवाच .. ..
कृष्णेनाहं सुरश्रेष्ठ शप्तः पापः सुदुर्मतिः ..
कुष्ठांतं कुरु मे देव यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे प्रभो .. 53 ..
16.101.m: Sāmba said: / “O best of gods, I was cursed by Kṛṣṇa, being a sinner of wicked mind. / Bring an end to my leprosy, O Lord, if you are pleased with me, O master!”

16.101.s:
.. śrībhānuruvāca .. ..
bhūya eva mahābhāga nīrogastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ..
yādṛgrūpaḥ purā hyāsīrmama caiva prasādataḥ .. 54 ..
16.101.d:
.. श्रीभानुरुवाच .. ..
भूय एव महाभाग नीरोगस्त्वं भविष्यसि ..
यादृग्रूपः पुरा ह्यासीर्मम चैव प्रसादतः .. 54 ..
16.101.m: The venerable Bhānu said: / “Once again, O fortunate one, you shall become free from disease, / endowed with the very form you had before, through my grace.

16.101.s:
adya prabhṛti nekṣyāstā viṣṇubhāryāḥ kathaṃcana ..
na tāsāṃ darśane jātu sthātavyaṃ yadunandana .. 55 ..
16.101.d:
अद्य प्रभृति नेक्ष्यास्ता विष्णुभार्याः कथंचन ..
न तासां दर्शने जातु स्थातव्यं यदुनन्दन .. 55 ..
16.101.m: From this day onward, you must never look upon those wives of Viṣṇu; / you must never stand in their sight, O delight of the Yadus.

16.101.s:
tāsāmīrṣyāparītena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ..
kuṣṭhaṃ te yādavaśreṣṭha pradattaṃ hi mahātmanā .. 56 ..
16.101.d:
तासामीर्ष्यापरीतेन विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना ..
कुष्ठं ते यादवश्रेष्ठ प्रदत्तं हि महात्मना .. 56 ..
16.101.m: Overcome with jealousy toward them, Viṣṇu, the all-powerful Lord, / that great soul, inflicted leprosy upon you, O best of the Yādavas.

16.101.s:
yo māṃ stotreṇa cānena samāgatya ca stoṣyati ..
na tasyānvayasaṃbhūtaḥ kuṣṭhī kaścidbhaviṣyati .. 57 ..
16.101.d:
यो मां स्तोत्रेण चानेन समागत्य च स्तोष्यति ..
न तस्यान्वयसंभूतः कुष्ठी कश्चिद्भविष्यति .. 57 ..
16.101.m: Whoever comes and praises me with this hymn / will have no one born in his lineage afflicted with leprosy.

16.101.s:
athādityasya nāmāni samyagjānīhi dvādaśa ..
dvādaśaiva tathānyāni tāni vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ .. 58 ..
16.101.d:
अथादित्यस्य नामानि सम्यग्जानीहि द्वादश ..
द्वादशैव तथान्यानि तानि वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः .. 58 ..
16.101.m: Now learn properly the twelve names of Āditya; / and likewise the twelve others, I shall speak of them in full.

16.101.s:
ādityaḥ savitā sūryo mihiro'rkaḥ pratāpanaḥ ..
mārttaṃḍo bhāskaro bhānuścitrabhānurddivākaraḥ .. 59 ..
16.101.d:
आदित्यः सविता सूर्यो मिहिरोऽर्कः प्रतापनः ..
मार्त्तंडो भास्करो भानुश्चित्रभानुर्द्दिवाकरः .. 59 ..
16.101.m: Āditya, Savitṛ, Sūrya, Mihira, Arka, Pratāpana, / Mārtaṇḍa, Bhāskara, Bhānu, Citrabhānu, Divākara,

16.101.s:
ravirdvādaśanāmaivaṃ jñeyaḥ sāmānyanāmabhiḥ ..
viṣṇurdhātā bhagaḥ pūṣā mitroṃ'śurvaruṇo 'ryamā .. 7.1.101.60 ..
16.101.d:
रविर्द्वादशनामैवं ज्ञेयः सामान्यनामभिः ..
विष्णुर्धाता भगः पूषा मित्रोंऽशुर्वरुणो ऽर्यमा .. 7.1.101.60 ..
16.101.m: and Ravi: thus is the twelve-named one known by his general names. / Viṣṇu, Dhātṛ, Bhaga, Pūṣan, Mitra, Aṃśu, Varuṇa, Aryaman,

16.101.s:
indro vivasvāṃstvaṣṭā ca parjanyo dvādaśaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
iti te dvādaśādityāḥ pṛthaktvena prakīrtitāḥ .. 61 ..
16.101.d:
इन्द्रो विवस्वांस्त्वष्टा च पर्जन्यो द्वादशः स्मृतः ..
इति ते द्वादशादित्याः पृथक्त्वेन प्रकीर्तिताः .. 61 ..
16.101.m: Indra, Vivasvat, Tvaṣṭṛ, and Parjanya is remembered as the twelfth. / Thus are the twelve Ādityas declared individually to you.

16.101.s:
uttiṣṭhaṃti sadā hyete māsairdvādaśabhiḥ kramāt ..
viṣṇustapati vai caitre vaiśākhe cāryamā sadā .. 62 ..
16.101.d:
उत्तिष्ठंति सदा ह्येते मासैर्द्वादशभिः क्रमात् ..
विष्णुस्तपति वै चैत्रे वैशाखे चार्यमा सदा .. 62 ..
16.101.m: They always rise in succession during the twelve months: / Viṣṇu shines in Caitra, and Aryaman always in Vaiśākha;

16.101.s:
vivasvāñjyeṣṭhamāse tu āṣāḍhe cāṃśumāṃstathā ..
parjjanyaḥ śrāvaṇe māsi varuṇaḥ prauṣṭhasaṃjñike .. 63 ..
16.101.d:
विवस्वाञ्ज्येष्ठमासे तु आषाढे चांशुमांस्तथा ..
पर्ज्जन्यः श्रावणे मासि वरुणः प्रौष्ठसंज्ञिके .. 63 ..
16.101.m: Vivasvat in the month of Jyeṣṭha, and likewise Aṃśumat in Āṣāḍha; / Parjanya in the month of Śrāvaṇa, Varuṇa in the month named Prauṣṭhapada;

16.101.s:
indraścāśvayuje māsi dhātā tapati kārtike ..
mārgaśīrṣe tathā mitraḥ pauṣe pūṣā divākaraḥ .. 64 ..
16.101.d:
इन्द्रश्चाश्वयुजे मासि धाता तपति कार्तिके ..
मार्गशीर्षे तथा मित्रः पौषे पूषा दिवाकरः .. 64 ..
16.101.m: Indra in the month of Āśvayuja, and Dhātṛ shines in Kārtika; / likewise Mitra in Mārgaśīrṣa, and Pūṣan the Divākara in Pauṣa;

16.101.s:
māghe bhagastu vijñeyastvaṣṭā tapati phālgune ..
śatairdvādaśabhirviṣṇū raśmīnāṃ dīpyate sadā .. 65 ..
16.101.d:
माघे भगस्तु विज्ञेयस्त्वष्टा तपति फाल्गुने ..
शतैर्द्वादशभिर्विष्णू रश्मीनां दीप्यते सदा .. 65 ..
16.101.m: Bhaga is to be known in Māgha, and Tvaṣṭṛ shines in Phālguna. / Viṣṇu always blazes with twelve hundred rays;

16.101.s:
dīpyate gosahasreṇa śataiśca tribhiraryamā ..
dvisaptakairvivasvāṃstu aṃśumānpañcakaistribhiḥ .. 66 ..
16.101.d:
दीप्यते गोसहस्रेण शतैश्च त्रिभिरर्यमा ..
द्विसप्तकैर्विवस्वांस्तु अंशुमान्पञ्चकैस्त्रिभिः .. 66 ..
16.101.m: Aryaman blazes with a thousand rays plus three hundred; / Vivasvat with fourteen hundred, and Aṃśumat with fifteen hundred;

16.101.s:
vivasvāniva parjanyo varuṇaścāryamā iva ..
indrastu dviguṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhirbhātyekādaśabhiḥ śataiḥ .. 67 ..
16.101.d:
विवस्वानिव पर्जन्यो वरुणश्चार्यमा इव ..
इन्द्रस्तु द्विगुणैः षड्भिर्भात्येकादशभिः शतैः .. 67 ..
16.101.m: Parjanya is like Vivasvat, and Varuṇa is like Aryaman; / Indra shines with twice six, that is, twelve hundred rays;

16.101.s:
mitravacca bhagastvaṣṭā sahasreṇa śatena ca ..
uttaropakrame'rkasya vardhante raśmayaḥ sadā ..
dakṣiṇopakrame bhūyo hrasante sūryaraśmayaḥ .. 68 ..
16.101.d:
मित्रवच्च भगस्त्वष्टा सहस्रेण शतेन च ..
उत्तरोपक्रमेऽर्कस्य वर्धन्ते रश्मयः सदा ..
दक्षिणोपक्रमे भूयो ह्रसन्ते सूर्यरश्मयः .. 68 ..
16.101.m: and Bhaga is like Mitra; Tvaṣṭṛ has one thousand and one hundred rays. / During the sun’s northern course, his rays always increase; / during the southern course, the rays of the sun diminish again.

16.101.s:
evaṃ dvādaśa mūrtisthaḥ prabhāsakṣetramadhyataḥ ..
sāṃbādityeti vikhyātaḥ sthāsye manvantarāntare .. 69 ..
16.101.d:
एवं द्वादश मूर्तिस्थः प्रभासक्षेत्रमध्यतः ..
सांबादित्येति विख्यातः स्थास्ये मन्वन्तरान्तरे .. 69 ..
16.101.m: Abiding thus in twelve forms in the midst of Prabhāsakṣetra, / renowned as Sāmbāditya, I shall remain through successive manvantaras.

16.101.s:
māghasya śuklapakṣe tu pañcamyāṃ yādavottama ..
ekabhaktaṃ sadā khyātaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ naktamudāhṛtam .. 7.1.101.70 ..
16.101.d:
माघस्य शुक्लपक्षे तु पञ्चम्यां यादवोत्तम ..
एकभक्तं सदा ख्यातं षष्ठ्यां नक्तमुदाहृतम् .. 7.1.101.70 ..
16.101.m: On the fifth day of the bright fortnight of Māgha, O best of the Yādavas, / a single meal is prescribed, and on the sixth day an evening meal is declared.

16.101.s:
saptamyāmupavāsaṃ tu kṛtvā sāṃbārkasaṃnidhau ..
raktacandanamiśraistu karavīrairmahāvrataḥ .. 71 ..
16.101.d:
सप्तम्यामुपवासं तु कृत्वा सांबार्कसंनिधौ ..
रक्तचन्दनमिश्रैस्तु करवीरैर्महाव्रतः .. 71 ..
16.101.m: Having observed a fast on the seventh day in the presence of Sāmbārka, / the performer of the great observance, with karavīra flowers mixed with red sandalwood,

16.101.s:
dattvā kundarakaṃ dhūpaṃ pūjayedbhāskaraṃ budhaḥ ..
brāhmaṇāndivyabhojyena bhojayitvā'pi śaktitaḥ .. 72 ..
16.101.d:
दत्त्वा कुन्दरकं धूपं पूजयेद्भास्करं बुधः ..
ब्राह्मणान्दिव्यभोज्येन भोजयित्वाऽपि शक्तितः .. 72 ..
16.101.m: and offering frankincense, the wise one should worship Bhāskara, / after also feeding brahmins with divine food according to his ability.

16.101.s:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute samyaksāṃbādityasya pūjanam ...
samyakchraddhāsamāyuktaḥ saṃprāpsyatyakhilaṃ phalam .. 73 ..
16.101.d:
एवं यः कुरुते सम्यक्सांबादित्यस्य पूजनम् ...
सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमायुक्तः संप्राप्स्यत्यखिलं फलम् .. 73 ..
16.101.m: Whoever thus properly performs the worship of Sāmbāditya, / endowed with perfect faith, shall attain the entire fruit.”

16.101.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evamuktvā sahasrāṃśustatraivāṃtaradhīyata ..
sāṃbo'pi nirjaro bhūtvā dvārakāṃ punarāgamat .. 74 ..
16.101.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वा सहस्रांशुस्तत्रैवांतरधीयत ..
सांबोऽपि निर्जरो भूत्वा द्वारकां पुनरागमत् .. 74 ..
16.101.m: Īśvara said: / Having spoken thus, the thousand-rayed one vanished right there; / and Sāmba, freed from disease, returned again to Dvārakā.

16.101.s:
ityetatkathitaṃ devi sāṃbādityamahodayam ..
śrutaṃ harati pāpāni tathā''rogyaṃ prayacchati .. 75 ..
16.101.d:
इत्येतत्कथितं देवि सांबादित्यमहोदयम् ..
श्रुतं हरति पापानि तथा'ऽरोग्यं प्रयच्छति .. 75 ..
16.101.m: Thus has this great rising of Sāmbāditya been told, O goddess; / heard, it removes sins and grants health.

16.101.s: iti śrīskānde mahā purāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye sāṃbādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ.. 101 ..
16.101.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महा पुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सांबादित्यमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः.. 101 ..
16.101.m: Thus ends the one hundred and first chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of Sāmbāditya,” in the first part, the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.102.s:
tato gacchenmahādevi devīṃ kaṃṭakaśodhinīm ..
tasyaivottaradigbhāge dhanurdvitayasaṃsthitām .. 1 ..
16.102.d:
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि देवीं कंटकशोधिनीम् ..
तस्यैवोत्तरदिग्भागे धनुर्द्वितयसंस्थिताम् .. 1 ..
16.102.m: Then one should go, O great goddess, to the goddess Kaṇṭakaśodhinī, / situated at a distance of two bow-lengths in the northern quarter from him.

16.102.s:
mahiṣaghnīṃ mahākāyāṃ brahmadevarṣipūjitām ..
purā ye kalmaṣopetā dānavā devakaṃṭakāḥ .. 2 ..
16.102.d:
महिषघ्नीं महाकायां ब्रह्मदेवर्षिपूजिताम् ..
पुरा ये कल्मषोपेता दानवा देवकंटकाः .. 2 ..
16.102.m: She is the slayer of Mahiṣa, having a mighty form, worshipped by Brahmā, the gods, and seers. / Long ago, whatever Dānavas were tainted with sins and were thorns to the gods,

16.102.s:
yugeyuge śodhayettāṃstena kaṃṭakaśodhinī ..
āśvayukchuklapakṣe tu navamyāṃ tāmathārcayet .. 3 ..
16.102.d:
युगेयुगे शोधयेत्तांस्तेन कंटकशोधिनी ..
आश्वयुक्छुक्लपक्षे तु नवम्यां तामथार्चयेत् .. 3 ..
16.102.m: she purges them in every yuga; therefore she is Kaṇṭakaśodhinī. / One should worship her on the ninth day of the bright fortnight of Āśvayuja,

16.102.s:
paśupuṣpopahāraiśca dīpadhūpaistathottamaiḥ ..
tasyā'rayo na jāyaṃte yāvadvarṣaṃ varānane .. 4 ..
16.102.d:
पशुपुष्पोपहारैश्च दीपधूपैस्तथोत्तमैः ..
तस्याऽरयो न जायंते यावद्वर्षं वरानने .. 4 ..
16.102.m: with animal offerings, flowers, and supreme lamps and incenses; / his enemies will not arise for an entire year, O fair-faced one.

16.102.s:
yastāṃ paśyati sadbhaktyā bhūtāyā nityameva vā .. . ..
taṃ putramiva kalyāṇī saṃrakṣati na saṃśayaḥ .. 5 ..
16.102.d:
यस्तां पश्यति सद्भक्त्या भूताया नित्यमेव वा .. . ..
तं पुत्रमिव कल्याणी संरक्षति न संशयः .. 5 ..
16.102.m: Whoever beholds her with true devotion on the fourteenth day of the fortnight or daily— / the auspicious goddess protects him like a son, there is no doubt.

16.102.s:
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
devi kaṃṭakaśodhinyāḥ śrutaṃ rakṣākaraṃ param .. 6 ..
16.102.d:
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं माहात्म्यं पापनाशनम् ..
देवि कंटकशोधिन्याः श्रुतं रक्षाकरं परम् .. 6 ..
16.102.m: Thus the sin-destroying māhātmya has been declared in brief; / heard, O goddess, the māhātmya of Kaṇṭakaśodhinī grants supreme protection.

16.102.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahā purāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye sāṃbādityasamīpavartikaṃṭakaśodhinīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvyuttaraśatatamodhyāyaḥ .. 102 .. .. cha ..
16.102.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महा पुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सांबादित्यसमीपवर्तिकंटकशोधिनीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्व्युत्तरशततमोध्यायः .. 102 .. .. छ ..
16.102.m: Thus ends the one hundred and second chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of Kaṇṭakaśodhinī Situated Near Sāmbāditya,” in the first part, the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.103.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchedvarārohe kapāleśvaramuttamam ..
tasyā uttaradigbhāge suragaṃdharvapūjitam.. .. 1 ..
16.103.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेद्वरारोहे कपालेश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
तस्या उत्तरदिग्भागे सुरगंधर्वपूजितम्.. .. 1 ..
16.103.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O lady of fair hips, one should go to the excellent Kapāleśvara, / in the northern quarter from her, worshipped by gods and gandharvas.

16.103.s:
purā yajñe varttamāne dakṣarājasya dhīmataḥ ..
upaviṣṭeṣu vipreṣu hūyamāne hutāśane .. 2 ..
16.103.d:
पुरा यज्ञे वर्त्तमाने दक्षराजस्य धीमतः ..
उपविष्टेषु विप्रेषु हूयमाने हुताशने .. 2 ..
16.103.m: Long ago, while the sacrifice of the wise king Dakṣa was underway, / while the brahmins were seated and offerings were being poured into the fire,

16.103.s:
jālmarūpadharo bhūtvā śaṃkarastatra cāgataḥ .. 27 ..
jīrṇakaṃthānvito devi malavāndhūlidhūsaraḥ .. 3 ..
atha te brāhmaṇāḥ kruddhā dṛṣṭvā taṃ jālmarūpiṇam ..
kapāladhāriṇaṃ sarve dhikchabdaistaṃ jagarhire.. 4 ..
asakṛtpāpapāpeti gacchagaccha narādhama ..
yajñavedirna cārhā hi mānuṣāsthidharasya te .. 5 ..
atha prahasya bhagavānyajñavedyāṃ sureśvari ..
kṣiptvā kapālaṃ naṣṭo'sau na sa jñāto manīṣibhiḥ .. 6 ..
tasminnaṣṭe kapālaṃ tatkṣiptaṃ maṃḍapabāhyataḥ ..
athānyattatra saṃjātaṃ tadrūpaṃ ca varānane .. 7 ..
kṣiptaṃkṣiptaṃ punastatra jāyate ca mahītale ..
evaṃ śatasahasrāṇi prayutānyarbudāni ca .. 8 ..
tatra kṣiptāni jātāni tataste vismayānvitāḥ ..
athocurmunayaḥ sarve nirviṇṇāścāsya ceṣṭitam .. 9 ..
16.103.d:
जाल्मरूपधरो भूत्वा शंकरस्तत्र चागतः .. 27 ..
जीर्णकंथान्वितो देवि मलवान्धूलिधूसरः .. 3 ..
अथ ते ब्राह्मणाः क्रुद्धा दृष्ट्वा तं जाल्मरूपिणम् ..
कपालधारिणं सर्वे धिक्छब्दैस्तं जगर्हिरे.. 4 ..
असकृत्पापपापेति गच्छगच्छ नराधम ..
यज्ञवेदिर्न चार्हा हि मानुषास्थिधरस्य ते .. 5 ..
अथ प्रहस्य भगवान्यज्ञवेद्यां सुरेश्वरि ..
क्षिप्त्वा कपालं नष्टोऽसौ न स ज्ञातो मनीषिभिः .. 6 ..
तस्मिन्नष्टे कपालं तत्क्षिप्तं मंडपबाह्यतः ..
अथान्यत्तत्र संजातं तद्रूपं च वरानने .. 7 ..
क्षिप्तंक्षिप्तं पुनस्तत्र जायते च महीतले ..
एवं शतसहस्राणि प्रयुतान्यर्बुदानि च .. 8 ..
तत्र क्षिप्तानि जातानि ततस्ते विस्मयान्विताः ..
अथोचुर्मुनयः सर्वे निर्विण्णाश्चास्य चेष्टितम् .. 9 ..
16.103.m:
Śaṃkara came there, having assumed the form of a rogue,
clad in a worn rag-garment, O goddess, filthy, and grey with dust.
